chapters.title: Chapter 951: Pill Prodigy, Kent
paragraphs: "Just who are you?"
The Pill Emperor asked, staring at Kent with widened eyes.
Kent merely smiled and handed over the Ascension Token. "Tell big sister I will be back in three months for the Pill Ascension competition."
"Big sister, as in..."
Kent smiled again, "Pill Monarch Nefeli."

The Pill Emperor remained silent. He stored away the Pill Ascension Token and then retrieved a jade-like crystal. However, this one looked different from the ones for communications. When Kent’s eyes landed on it, he felt the extraordinary nature of the crystal.
So he scanned it using his Enchanted Eyes.
’Long Range Space Teleporter, huh. This must cost a fortune,’ Kent said inwardly, seeing as the Pill Emperor, who could sense the hidden eyes locking on him and Kent.
"So where will you be going?" he asked.
"I will be heading to Planet Nictus, specifically, the Heaven’s Eye sect. But I will be back before the competition."
"Okay." After a brief nod, the crystal glowed, and he vanished from sight.
Kent smiled, seeing most of the people who were keeping eyes on them start to retreat. They saw him hand the token to the man who just teleported away, so there was no need to keep waiting around.
Of course, a few stayed because they were more interested in Kent than the Pill Ascension Token. However, with the token gone, Kent was now more than ready to roam the many worlds waiting for him.
"We should get moving." Kent took Lady Azela’s hand, and they started moving toward a Transfer Channel that would take them to Planet Nictus.
[Yanki Great Pill House]
Meanwhile, Pill Saint had just arrived at the main branch of the Yanki Great Pill House.

There were many Great Pill Houses scattered across the ten Pill Worlds. These families were powerful alchemy families, with many possessing Pill Sovereigns and even a few from the top two Pill Worlds having someone who had reached the Pill Legend stage, the pinnacle rank an Alchemist could attain in the High Worlds.
The Yanki Great Pill House is one of the powerful Pill families in Aerithyne.
The current patriarch is Pill Saint Flura’s father, and she is considered one of his most loved children. This was largely due to her brilliance in alchemy.
At the moment, she just walked into a large hall where her father and a few family heads were having a meeting.
When she entered, some frowned, but her father smiled, looking at her like she was the only thing that mattered.
"Flura, why are you back so soon?" her father asked. "I thought your little challenge still had two weeks before it’s over."
Her father studied her expression and frowned slightly, "Don’t tell me you’ve lost."
Flura smiled weakly, "As a matter of fact, Father, I was defeated by a Pill Grandmaster, no less."
"WHAT!"
Even the elders, who were frowning, couldn’t help but exclaim in shock upon hearing Pill Saint Flura’s response.
"Tell me this is one of your mischievous jokes."
"I am being serious, Father. I lost to a Pill Grandmaster, but I am happy I lost because I learned a lot and gained more than I could ever wish for."
"Unbelievable, to think a genius such as you would lose to a Pill Grandmaster. Just what kind of talent would have the means to defeat you?"
"The kind that can form a low-grade grey pill ring as a Pill Grandmaster."
"WHAT!"
If Pill Saint Flura doesn’t stop, she might just cause her father and the elders to have a heart attack.
"This time, I think you are playing with us, kid." An elder glared at Pill Saint Flura, "Just who do you think we are, to think you can deceive us to cover up your failure?"
Pill Saint Flura smiled, "I am not deceiving anyone, Elder Grant. I was indeed defeated because my opponent was able to form a grey Pill Ring.

I mean, think about it, if both of us concocted a Perfect Pill, then how come I lost? Naturally, I completed first, so even if we both had the same purity, because I completed first, I was meant to be the winner.
But since I am not the winner, it means my opponent’s pill purity was higher than mine, and the only way to achieve that is through Pill Rings.

If you don’t believe me, you can go to the Alliance. The three old monsters were there and witnessed the whole thing. It was also the reason why I accepted the results, for I wouldn’t have believed that kid was a Pill Grandmaster."
"Unbelievable. Just where did this kid come from?" Elder Alban asked.
"Pyris Pill Alliance."

They were left stunned yet again. However, the patriarch was staring at his daughter, looking at the smile on her face. He could tell she wasn’t angry for losing; this only made him want to find out why.
"You said you have gained so much from your duel with this kid, care to tell us what these gains are?" he asked.

Pill Saint Flura smiled, "After the duel, Pill Grandmaster Kent gave me the pill. However, because the three old monsters were interested in it, they took it in exchange for a two-week comprehension period with the Celestial Cloud Feather."
"WHAT!"

This time, Pill Saint Flura giggled, "I wouldn’t have come back here and would have simply entered the cave right after the duel. However, since I have two weeks’ worth of time to spend comprehending my techniques using the power of the Celestial Cloud Feather, I came to ask that you allow me to learn the Nine Flame Pill Art.
With the power of the Celestial Cloud Feather, I believe I will be able to comprehend it fully, and with the Pill Ascension Realm opening, my chances of getting Primordial Flame Spirits will be high.
If I manage to add even just one Primordial Flame Spirit to my Soul Flame, with the two flames that will be at my disposal, I believe my talent will skyrocket."
"There is no doubt about that." All the elders nodded to her words. Having that much time with the Celestial Cloud Feather was like gaining the mind of a Pill Immortal.
"I will allow you to comprehend the Nine Flame Pill Art. However, you must promise me one thing."
"Anything, Father."
"The next time you meet this kid who defeated you, you must defeat him. Can you do that?"
Pill Saint Flura smiled, "I will try my best, Father."
She couldn’t say yes, for she knew Kent was no simple person. He was a prodigy among prodigies.
"You can leave now. I will get you a new Pill Ascension Token, so do well to comprehend the Nine Flame Pill Art."
Within a day, words of the Pill Prodigy called Kent had reached every Pill World, causing many to start doubting themselves.
The idea that a mere Pill Grandmaster was able to form a Pill ring was more than they could take in.

Many who were in doubt after hearing about Kent’s feat and watching the recorded videos started heading to the Yanki Great Pill House to find out if indeed the daughter had been defeated by this unknown Kent.

Of course, after the patriarch himself announced to everyone that his daughter indeed was defeated by Kent and that she lost because her opponent formed a grey Pill Ring, the name Kent went wide-reaching, even words outside the ten Pill Worlds.
And the Pyris Pill Alliance had yet again become a sensation that caused many to start wondering just how a rank 7 Pill Alliance was able to obtain a genius like Kent.

chapters.title: Chapter 952: Going to Planet Nictus
paragraphs: [Pyris Pill Alliance - A Few Hours After The Duel]
"Say that again," Pill Monarch Nefeli said, looking at the man standing not far from him with a calm expression.

"I was in shock, same as you, Pill Monarch. However, the Kent kid won the duel by concocting a low-grade Grey Pill Ring Tier 9 pill. The shocking part is that he was even able to do Triple Extraction with three major ingredients.
Just where did you get such a monster from?" Pill Emperor Hakan asked with a small smile.
Among the few Pill Emperors in the Pyris Pill Alliance, he was the only one who could behave freely around Pill Monarch Nefeli.
They were in the same sect, and she once saved him, so he respected her greatly.
"And you said those three old monsters let him go after he gave the pill to his opponent?" Pill Monarch Nefeli asked.
"Yes. However, I believe they only let him go simply because he invoked the ancient pill rules. I believe they had ulterior motives, but hearing him say the rules caused them to take a step back.
However, now that his name has reached every pill world, it is only a matter of time before people start challenging him to duels."

"I am afraid he will have a hard time in the Pill Ascension realm. Everyone will want to challenge him this time to a combat duel, and knowing he is only at the Core Formation stage, with the nature of that realm, he will struggle," Pill Monarch Nefeli sighed.
However, Pill Emperor Hakan merely smiled. "For some reason, I believe he will swim there like a fish," he said, even laughing.
Pill Monarch Nefeli studied him for a moment before asking, "You sound certain. Is there something I am missing?"

"Well, the fact that Kent was able to notice my presence before I approached him and how he stood calm when the aura of a Spirit Lord slammed into his body, I believe, unless his opponent is at the Heavenly Ascension stage, he wouldn’t have any hardships at all.
If anything, we should pity those who would come after him.
In any case, he said I should tell you he is going to the Heaven’s Eye Sect on Planet Nictus, but he will be back before the Pill Ascension competition."
Pill Monarch Nefeli nodded, and Pill Emperor Hakan left.

"What kind of troublemaker have I entangled myself with?" She couldn’t help letting a small smile appear on her face. She stood up and walked toward the door; however, before walking out, a thought occurred to her, causing her to halt in her steps.
"Don’t tell me he had something to do with the death of several disciples from the Blue Flame Pill Palace.
After all, the one they were looking for is the sect master of the Heaven’s Eye Sect, and the fact that Kent is going there with a strange lady meets all the requirements."
She shook her head and decided not to focus on that. It is Kent’s problem, so he can handle it himself.
[Planet Aerithyne - Transfer Channel to Planet Nictus]
Kent held Lady Azela’s hand as they climbed into the large ship that would be taking them to Planet Nictus.

This time, instead of receiving VIP treatment, they were merely led to the 4th floor, where they had their own room, but not as luxurious as the one they had stayed in when they were coming to Planet Aerithyne.
Kent knew he was being followed, so he didn’t use the badge that Pill Monarch Nefeli had given him. He did not want to draw attention to her.
He merely used his new Pill Saint Badge to buy a ticket for himself and Lady Azela.
A few minutes later, they entered their room and settled down.
A couple of hours later, the channel opened, and the ship entered, starting its journey to Planet Nictus. It would take them 7 days to get there.
Kent looked at Lady Azela, who held a relieved expression on her face. She was finally on her way back to her world, where her mother was worried sick about her.
’What a big old softy.’ Kent had never met a grown-up who still relied on their mother as much as Lady Azela does.
’I can’t wait to see the reason why she is that dependent on her mother.’ Kent closed his eyes and pulled his mind back into his memories of Chaos.
This time, instead of reviewing the moment when Elina died, he chose to focus on the happy moments they shared.
As if knowing she would die, she made sure she and Chaos had all the best moments she could think of, and that alone was now helping Kent clear his chaotic mind.
He didn’t come back to the past to escape his trauma. He came to build his strength, for that was the only way he could gain access to some things he wanted.
Now, he had become a Pill Saint, and judging by the requirements to become a Pill Sage, Kent knew he would soon become a Pill Sage.
After spending three enjoyable days reviewing the best moments from his past life spent with Elina, Kent chose to proceed with the next set of records from the Primordial Pill Records.
It took him a day to review all.
’Looks like I have received a pill formula for Soul Limit Breaker Pill. However, to do that, I will need the Soul Strengthening Pill, for which I now have the complete formula.
However, the main ingredients are something I can’t easily get even with the tower’s help.’ Kent sighed.
’I saw the Void Soul Flower at the store where I bought the Cauldron and the Flame Spirit. However, just one is 300 million spirit stones
I don’t need this pill because I have Limit Breaking Points, but my wives do, so I must man up and buy as many Void Soul Flowers as I can get my hands on before going back.
If I can obtain all four main ingredients for the Soul Strengthening Pill and the Soul Limit Breaker pill before I return to the future, that would be nice.
I mean, who knows how expensive this ingredient would become 370,000 years from now?’
After checking everything, Kent focused on the next requirement to become a Pill Sage.
⟪Requirements to Become a Pill Sage⟫𝐟𝐫𝕖𝗲𝘄𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝕧𝐞𝚕.𝕔𝕠𝐦
↠ Rescue the one named Yuna and deliver her to Pill Monarch Nefeli
↠ Concoct a Tier 9 with a Medium-grade Grey Pill Ring.
’Looks like they don’t want to make things difficult for me this time around.’ Kent smiled. ’In that case, I will be sure to become a Pill Sage soon so I can aim for the Pill King stage.’
The days went by quickly.
Seven days later, Kent and Lady Azela arrived on Planet Nictus. On the outside, it was a green planet with a thin ring around it.
However, on the surface, every city was built using jade. It was as if the entire world were one giant jade that people carved into large cities.
Kent used the Soul Map. He discovered that this planet was significantly smaller than Planet Aerithyne. He was able to see the entirety of the city they arrived in, as well as the next city.

"This is Jin City. We have to take the teleportation channel to Yin City. That is where my sect is located," Lady Azela led Kent to the nearby teleportation channel, and soon, they arrived in Yin City.
It took them a couple of minutes to appear at the front entrance of the sect. However, before they could enter, a caravan blocked their path.
Lady Azela’s expression changed instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 953: Puppets
paragraphs: It wasn’t just Kent and Lady Azela who were blocked from entering the sect. There are others who, judging by their outfits, appear to be disciples from the Heavens Eye sect.
There are about 12 of them, and each looked pissed.
It is clear as day that they were stopped a while ago, causing them to curse at the people manning the caravan, although they made sure to keep their distance from them.
The strongest among the twelve is a Spirit Ascension stage cultivator, making her two stages below the three Spirit Kings manning the caravan.
"Who are those losers?" Kent asked Lady Azela, whose cold gaze was locked on the three people standing in front of the caravan.

"They are lackeys from a brute who claims he is the King of the planets on this side of the universe. There are seven in total, and he has control over six of them. He is a peak Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator with powerful subordinates backing him."
Kent nodded.
He can tell that whatever this is, meddling in it will be a headache. So he planned to mind his own business.
Well, that was what he thought until a sudden ding in his head told him otherwise. Kent looked at the message, and a smile appeared on his face.
⟪New Quest Received⟫
⟪Quest Name: Contra aestus⟫
⟪Difficulty Level: Calamity⟫
↠ The so-called Planet King is the most powerful cultivator in the Primos Mini Planetary Alliance. He seeks to rule the seven planets in this alliance with an iron fist.
↠ He had already taken over six planets, with only Planet Nictus to fall under his control.
↠ Due to this, he stops at nothing to kill everything and anything that blocks his path.
↠ Many innocents have fallen to his arrogance and evil deeds.
↠ Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to kill the Six Kings, Six Generals, and the so-called Planet King.
⟪Rewards⟫
↠ 100 Million Tower Points
↠ 400,000 Limit Breaker Points
↠ Destiny Map
↠ Taming Bracelet
↠ Blood Life Seal
↠ Blood Death Seal
’Well, what was I expecting. The fact that I am here is somehow tied to my destiny. I might as well fulfil it before going back.’
Kent turns and looks at Lady Azela, who was still holding a cold look on her face. Kent knew perhaps this wasn’t the first time she had come across these people.
So, he opened the Soul Map and connected to her first; then he expanded it, penetrating the formation that covered the sect.
Far in the Core Area of the sect, her mother was glaring at three people. Two are Spirit Monarchs and one is a Spirit Sovereign.
However, what made Kent realise this wasn’t something simple was when he saw Lady Kami wasn’t making any attempt to send the three smug-looking people to the afterlife.
’She is a Peak Heavenly Ascension cultivator, yet she isn’t making any attempt to kill them. This can only mean she is afraid of the backing they have.’
Kent smiled weakly, which made Lady Azela, who had seen this, narrow her eyes at him. ’What are you thinking?’ she asked.
Kent turns toward her, ’Nothing much. I am just thinking who to kill first.’
"You would do no such thing. Do you know who you will be provoking if you do that?" Lady Azela said, amplifying her voice slightly.

Some of the disciples closer to them turn and stare at them. However, since none of them recognise either Kent or the lady beside him, they just turn away and resume glaring at the three Spirit Kings manning the caravan.

"Don’t think too much about it. Let’s go back a few kilometres. I have to handle something first. It will take less than an hour."
She nodded, and under the watchful gaze of the three men manning the caravan, they retreated. After going far enough, Kent sat down and started channelling soul essence into his soul.

’With how versatile my cultivation technique has become, I can now raise my strength in many ways. Now, all I need is to reach Tier 16 in soul cultivation, and then I will be able to break at least two more levels on my body, soul, mind, and cultivation.’
Kent sighs and smiles slightly.
’I wonder how powerful I will become after breaking two more limits.’
Lady Azela stood behind Kent, looking at his back like she wanted to devour him. As she stood behind him, she could sense Kent becoming stronger by the second.
’I don’t know how he is doing it, but I feel like he is becoming stronger, yet his cultivation base is still stagnant. Just what is he doing?’
She knew an answer wouldn’t come unless she asked, but she was hesitant to ask. In the end, she chose to hold back for now.

Kent smiles in his head, using the Soul Map to spy on her. ’All I need now is to raise my mental strength high enough to work my magic on these people. They will be the key to killing these six Kings, six Generals, and the so-called Planet King.’

Kent didn’t stop there.

’My Mind Manipulation ability has already reached a level even Spirit Monarchs and Sovereigns will find it difficult resisting. If I use soul attack in addition to mind attack, then even Spirit Lords are not safe.
This means I am ready to handle this the best way possible. After this, I will spend some time checking my soul universe to review the changes.
"Let’s go." Kent took Lady Azela’s hand, and they started walking back to the sect. On the way, Kent shared his plan with her.
"So I have decided not to kill these people. However, they wouldn’t be leaving here free either."
Lady Azela sighed, calming down a bit. If something were to happen to these people simply because they came to her sect, she knew her sect would be on a timer from today onwards.
Hearing Kent wouldn’t kill them made her happy.
However, she couldn’t help but see the last few words in Kent’s sentence as the same recipe for disaster.
"What do you plan on doing?"
Kent smiled and looked at the three people, now 100 meters away. "I am going to turn them into my puppets. Just like this."
Kent snapped his fingers, and the three people fell to their knees.
Lady Azela’s eyes widened.

chapters.title: Chapter 954: Dominance
paragraphs: Kent held the stunned Lady Azela and walked closer to the three people kneeling. The disciples standing around also held shocked expressions on their faces.
Kent held a calm expression as he approached them. When he was a meter from them, he stopped.
One is a Beastkin of Tiger lineage, one is a Flame Human, and the last is a Dwarf.

"What are your names?" Kent asked. He already knew their names simply because he appraised them using our enchanted eye, but this was a show of strength to tell the people around that a true powerhouse had arrived in the sect.
The Beastkin was the first to speak, "My name is Drazel Thornclaw, a native of planet Veylun."
"I am Kael Veyrith," the Flame Human said, keeping a respectful gaze on Kent. "I am from the trade planet Orthel."
The Dwarf was the last to introduce himself, "I am Braggor Ironfist, from planet Grondar."
Kent could tell that the strongest among the three is the Dwarf. ’I guess it is only normal considering they are beings who value strength.’
"Stand," Kent ordered, and they obeyed.
"What is your mission here?"
"We were ordered by a commander under General Veynor Zhal to come and seize the Tier 18 Soul Spirit rumoured to have been bought by the sect master of the Heaven’s Eye Sect."
Lady Azela’s body shuddered at the sound of this. She had expected only the Blue Flame Pill Palace to be the only one that would come after her for the Soul Spirit.

However, hearing that a commander directly under a general of the Planet King, and no ordinary general but the infamous one known for his strategic thinking and manipulation, she was tempted to give the Soul Spirit to them.
However, she first turned to Kent, who smiled, "Looks like words travel faster than you would expect."
He turned back to his three puppets, "Aside from you and the three inside the sect, is anyone else on this mission with you?"
"No. However, we are expected to return with the Soul Spirit, else the General will organise his army to attack the sect and take it by force."
"I see. I suppose this general is strong, right?"
"General Veynor Zhal is one of the dangerous generals directly under the Planet King. If he personally makes a move, the sect will fall."
"Not under my watch," Kent smirked and turned to the 12 sect disciples on the outside. "Not a word to anyone."

They nodded, but Kent knew they would sing like birds right when they got inside the sect. After all, why wouldn’t they? They had just witnessed a Core Formation expert turn the Three Spirit Kings obedient with a mere snap of his finger.
Who wouldn’t spread that?
Of course, Kent could wipe their memories, but he didn’t want to do that merely because he wasn’t planning on going that extreme.
Instead, he turned to Lady Azela and smiled, "Time for you to become the sect leader again."

He pressed his finger against her forehead and started undoing the restrictions he had placed on her. His soul universe stirred, and in an instant, her cultivation broke through to the Spirit Monarch, then to the Spirit Sovereign, and then, quickly, she reached the Spirit Lord stage.
Within a minute, she was back to her Peak Heavenly Ascension cultivation. Then, in the next second, like shedding her clothes, her body transformed back to its real self.
"Sect Leader," the disciples exclaimed, seeing their Sect Leader now standing before them.
Lady Azela turned to them, "Not a word to anyone. Keep what you saw to yourself. If not, I will personally punish you."
"Rest assured, Sect Leader, not a word of what we saw will leave our lips."

"Very well. You can enter the sect." The disciples nodded and ran into the sect. They weren’t exactly at the main entrance, so after a few minutes, they entered the sect, each speeding to their abode to calm their nerves down.
"So what now?" Lady Azela asked Kent.
"We have to let your mother know we are coming." Kent expanded the soul map again and created a link between himself and Lady Kami.
"Do not panic, young lady, we will be arriving at the sect soon." Kent activated the Map Share, allowing Lady Kami to see them.
When her eyes landed on her daughter, a sigh escaped her lips, but she kept her composure, making sure the three people inside the hall with her wouldn’t sense anything.
"We will be there in a minute. And don’t worry, I will handle everything from here onwards." Kent cut the connection and took Lady Azela’s hand.
When her mother saw this, her eyes narrowed, but she pulled herself back before doing anything she would regret later.

Kent smiled when he saw this. He turned to Lady Azela, who had gotten used to Kent holding her hand. However, knowing her mother was watching, a red colour appeared on her cheek, causing her to turn away from Kent.
Lady Kami sighed inwardly and instead focused on the three people standing before Kent and her daughter. However, because Kent cut the connection, she wasn’t able to ask any questions.
"You three should stay here, but remove the caravan from the road. I will let you know if I have any orders."
"Yes, Master."
Kent nodded and activated the new Soul Universe ability he had received after reaching Tier 16 in soul cultivation.
’Soul Teleport’

This new ability literally allows Kent to teleport within an 80,000 km radius of his Soul Map. This means that with just his Soul map, regardless of what formation is blocking him, as long as his soul map manages to penetrate them, he can teleport.
And now that his soul has reached Tier 16 and he has also broken three limits on his soul, the soul map is perhaps the most powerful skill in his arsenal.
Because he was holding Lady Azela’s hand, they both vanished and appeared inside the hall where Lady Kami and the three people were.
The moment they appeared, the three people stood up and retrieved their weapons.
"Sit down."
Kent’s voice was firm and absolute, leaving no room for disobedience.
They sat down instantly; even the Spirit Sovereign couldn’t withstand the Mind attack.
"Put those sticks away."
They put away the weapons in their hands, causing Kent to smile.
"Now, kneel and greet your new master."
They obeyed like the obedient subordinates they were. "We greet Master. If the Master has any orders, he should feel free to tell us. We will get it done."
"Oh, I have loads of orders. But for now, stand up and settle down. We have a lot to talk about."
"Thank you, Master."
They sat back down, each holding a respectful expression on their faces.
"That’s more like it."
Kent turned around and looked at Lady Kami, who was frozen in her seat.
"What do you think, Mother-in-Law? Does this son-in-law have what it takes to protect your daughter?"
The smile on Kent’s face bloomed, causing the mother-daughter pair to furrow their brows, unsure how to answer Kent’s question.
Kent held his smile, knowing his question would need some time to digest. But he had the time, so he chose to wait for them.

chapters.title: Chapter 955: Kent’s Decision
paragraphs: Kent didn’t know if his subtle joke would have any effect on Lady Kami.
However, looking at her expression now, it was plain as day that she took what he said seriously, and what was even worse, the red blush on her daughter’s cheeks added even more fuel to the fire.

’Interesting, looks like she is really overprotective of her daughter. Makes me wonder whether she chose to remain in a High World instead of ascending to an Immortal World simply because she couldn’t bear to leave her daughter behind.’
Kent wondered, but his mind answered his own question, ’But then again, both of them could have ascended long ago, yet they stayed.’
This made Kent start to wonder if there was more to the surprisingly cute mother-daughter relationship he was observing.
"You don’t have to think too much, Lady Kami. I was just messing with you. Though if she is still a maiden 370,000 years from today, I am sure I will surely become your son-in-law."
After saying that, Kent turned to the three people he had mind-controlled, who were now acting like puppets he could manipulate.
Looking at the three people, Kent couldn’t help but wonder just how far this so-called Planet King’s influence had reached.

One of them is a Dragonborn, one is a Dark Elf, and one is a Human, but thanks to Kent’s affinity for blood, he could tell that this human had dragon blood flowing through his body, making him a demi-human.
"I want you each to tell me all you know, starting with your names and home planet."
Kent sat down, crossed his legs, and supported his chin with his right hand.
Lady Kami, who was now holding her daughter’s hand, looked at this and couldn’t help wondering what Kent had done to these three arrogant people to make them now soft and respectful.
The Dragonborn spoke first.
He is a tall, imposing figure with crimson scales running across his arms and neck, golden slit-pupil eyes, and long white hair. He is clad in heavy crimson and black battle robes.
"I am Lord Veylan Drakkos, one of the Seven Lords under the Dragon King. I answer directly to the Dragon King and the various commanders and generals on Planet Drakthar.
I was sent here alongside my companions from the other planets to come and retrieve the Soul Spirit purchased by the Sect Master of Heaven’s Eye from the Brown Maple Auction House in Pyris City.
We have been ordered to return with the Soul Spirit. If we return empty-handed, General Veynor Zhal will personally lead his troop to this planet and obliterate the Heaven’s Eye Sect.
He will be able to get to this planet because one of the Lords of the planet is almost under the thumb of the Planet King."

Kent didn’t bother to verify if his answer was true or not. He knew for certain that all he said was true because he was in their minds. This only made him realise that if he wants to complete this quest, he must be smart about how he moves.
’Looks like this quest is indeed on the calamity level.’ He turned to the second, the Elf, who, although he didn’t look like it, was actually a Dark Elf.

"My name is Eryndor Malvek. I am from Planet Sylvaris. I was asked to come as a suicide aid. My mission is to infiltrate the inner region of the sect and detonate my core if we don’t obtain the Soul Spirit.
My death was to ensure the formation protecting this sect would be weakened when General Veynor Zhal’s troop gets here."
"Oh." Kent raised his brow, and the two ladies narrowed their eyes, hearing such a despicable plot they knew would have worked if things had panned out like the Dark Elf said.
Getting inside the sect wasn’t a problem. After all, while Planet Nictus hadn’t yet fallen under the Planet King’s control, his influence wasn’t one anybody on Planet Nictus would dare disobey.
So they managed to enter the sect, and a core detonation from a Spirit Monarch was one that would kill thousands of disciples and severely weaken the formation protecting the sect.
"That was a diplomatic yet brilliant plan. Who came up with it?" Kent asked, and Malvek answered.
"General Veynor Zhal came up with the mission. He is the chief strategist in the Planet King’s Army."
"I see. In any case, he is indeed brilliant. I will be sure to put his memories to good use," Kent smiled, already anticipating when he would claim that face into his arsenal.

He turned to the last person, the human with dragon blood running in his veins. This person seems to be the strongest among the three, simply because he was a Spirit Sovereign and also due to his dual nature as both a human and a dragon.
"What about you? What do you have to say for yourself?"
"I am High Lord Korrath Vuldren. My mission is to ensure the Soul Spirit is delivered to General Veynor Zhal."
"I see. Looks like you all have separate yet collective missions. In that case, tell me when you are expected to bring the Soul Spirit."

"Two weeks from today is the maximum time we can spend in this world. If by then we don’t see the Soul Spirit, General Veynor Zhal will deem it as defiance against the Planet King, and as such, he will attack this sect."

’There are no openings here. The only leeway here is that I have a maximum of two weeks. But who is to say I can accomplish much within these two weeks that will give me the power to counter an entire army?’
Kent looked at Lady Azela, whose expression was calm, but Kent knew what she was thinking.

’Inasmuch as I can brag and say I will be able to dominate this so-called Planet King, many will die from the ripple effect. Of course, defeating General Veynor Zhal is within my abilities, but I am afraid that it will have the same ripple effect.
However, if I were to form a Core Gate and perhaps even form a Flame Core, then perhaps I can save the sect and this planet as a whole.’
"Give me the Soul Spirit," Kent said, and Lady Azela nodded. She retrieved the disc on which the Soul Spirit was saved and handed it over to Kent.

Kent activated it, and the Soul Spirit appeared. He then used his finger and tapped into his soul universe, drawing three runes and merging them with the Soul Spirit before sending it back into the disc.
He threw it at High Lord Korrath Vuldren, who caught it. "Deliver it to this General Zhal. Afterwards, wait for my orders."
"We will wait for your orders, Master."
Kent nodded. "Go."
They left immediately and joined the three outside the sect.
When they were gone, Kent turned back to the mother and the daughter. "Don’t worry. They will receive a nice gift that none would see coming."
Kent smiled weakly, knowing that the day they would attempt to refine the Soul Spirit he had given them would be the day they would never forget.

"However, for taking your Soul Spirit," Kent retrieved the soul flag and waved it, causing the five Heaven Ascension Stage (Tier 19) Soul Spirits to appear. "Take your pick, they are all from the Forsaken Race."
This time, the mother and daughter pair were left stunned, their faces as pale as white paint.

sentences.text: Kent didn’t know if his subtle joke would have any effect on Lady Kami.
However, looking at her expression now, it was plain as day that she took what he said seriously, and what was even worse, the red blush on her daughter’s cheeks added even more fuel to the fire.
’Interesting, looks like she is really overprotective of her daughter.
Makes me wonder whether she chose to remain in a High World instead of ascending to an Immortal World simply because she couldn’t bear to leave her daughter behind.’
Kent wondered, but his mind answered his own question, ’But then again, both of them could have ascended long ago, yet they stayed.’
This made Kent start to wonder if there was more to the surprisingly cute mother-daughter relationship he was observing.
"You don’t have to think too much, Lady Kami.
I was just messing with you.
Though if she is still a maiden 370,000 years from today, I am sure I will surely become your son-in-law."
After saying that, Kent turned to the three people he had mind-controlled, who were now acting like puppets he could manipulate.
Looking at the three people, Kent couldn’t help but wonder just how far this so-called Planet King’s influence had reached.

One of them is a Dragonborn, one is a Dark Elf, and one is a Human, but thanks to Kent’s affinity for blood, he could tell that this human had dragon blood flowing through his body, making him a demi-human.
"I want you each to tell me all you know, starting with your names and home planet."
Kent sat down, crossed his legs, and supported his chin with his right hand.
Lady Kami, who was now holding her daughter’s hand, looked at this and couldn’t help wondering what Kent had done to these three arrogant people to make them now soft and respectful.
The Dragonborn spoke first.
He is a tall, imposing figure with crimson scales running across his arms and neck, golden slit-pupil eyes, and long white hair.
He is clad in heavy crimson and black battle robes.
"I am Lord Veylan Drakkos, one of the Seven Lords under the Dragon King.
I answer directly to the Dragon King and the various commanders and generals on Planet Drakthar.
I was sent here alongside my companions from the other planets to come and retrieve the Soul Spirit purchased by the Sect Master of Heaven’s Eye from the Brown Maple Auction House in Pyris City.
We have been ordered to return with the Soul Spirit.
If we return empty-handed, General Veynor Zhal will personally lead his troop to this planet and obliterate the Heaven’s Eye Sect.
He will be able to get to this planet because one of the Lords of the planet is almost under the thumb of the Planet King."
Kent didn’t bother to verify if his answer was true or not.
He knew for certain that all he said was true because he was in their minds.
This only made him realise that if he wants to complete this quest, he must be smart about how he moves.
’Looks like this quest is indeed on the calamity level.’ He turned to the second, the Elf, who, although he didn’t look like it, was actually a Dark Elf.
"My name is Eryndor Malvek.
I am from Planet Sylvaris.
I was asked to come as a suicide aid.
My mission is to infiltrate the inner region of the sect and detonate my core if we don’t obtain the Soul Spirit.
My death was to ensure the formation protecting this sect would be weakened when General Veynor Zhal’s troop gets here."
"Oh." Kent raised his brow, and the two ladies narrowed their eyes, hearing such a despicable plot they knew would have worked if things had panned out like the Dark Elf said.
Getting inside the sect wasn’t a problem.
After all, while Planet Nictus hadn’t yet fallen under the Planet King’s control, his influence wasn’t one anybody on Planet Nictus would dare disobey.
So they managed to enter the sect, and a core detonation from a Spirit Monarch was one that would kill thousands of disciples and severely weaken the formation protecting the sect.
"That was a diplomatic yet brilliant plan.
Who came up with it?" Kent asked, and Malvek answered.
"General Veynor Zhal came up with the mission.
He is the chief strategist in the Planet King’s Army."
"I see.
In any case, he is indeed brilliant.
I will be sure to put his memories to good use," Kent smiled, already anticipating when he would claim that face into his arsenal.
He turned to the last person, the human with dragon blood running in his veins.
This person seems to be the strongest among the three, simply because he was a Spirit Sovereign and also due to his dual nature as both a human and a dragon.
"What about you?
What do you have to say for yourself?"
"I am High Lord Korrath Vuldren.
My mission is to ensure the Soul Spirit is delivered to General Veynor Zhal."
"I see.
Looks like you all have separate yet collective missions.
In that case, tell me when you are expected to bring the Soul Spirit."
"Two weeks from today is the maximum time we can spend in this world.
If by then we don’t see the Soul Spirit, General Veynor Zhal will deem it as defiance against the Planet King, and as such, he will attack this sect."
’There are no openings here.
The only leeway here is that I have a maximum of two weeks.
But who is to say I can accomplish much within these two weeks that will give me the power to counter an entire army?’
Kent looked at Lady Azela, whose expression was calm, but Kent knew what she was thinking.
’Inasmuch as I can brag and say I will be able to dominate this so-called Planet King, many will die from the ripple effect.
Of course, defeating General Veynor Zhal is within my abilities, but I am afraid that it will have the same ripple effect.
However, if I were to form a Core Gate and perhaps even form a Flame Core, then perhaps I can save the sect and this planet as a whole.’
"Give me the Soul Spirit," Kent said, and Lady Azela nodded.
She retrieved the disc on which the Soul Spirit was saved and handed it over to Kent.
Kent activated it, and the Soul Spirit appeared.
He then used his finger and tapped into his soul universe, drawing three runes and merging them with the Soul Spirit before sending it back into the disc.
He threw it at High Lord Korrath Vuldren, who caught it.
"Deliver it to this General Zhal.
Afterwards, wait for my orders."
"We will wait for your orders, Master."
Kent nodded.
"Go."
They left immediately and joined the three outside the sect.
When they were gone, Kent turned back to the mother and the daughter.
"Don’t worry.
They will receive a nice gift that none would see coming."
Kent smiled weakly, knowing that the day they would attempt to refine the Soul Spirit he had given them would be the day they would never forget.
"However, for taking your Soul Spirit," Kent retrieved the soul flag and waved it, causing the five Heaven Ascension Stage (Tier 19) Soul Spirits to appear.
"Take your pick, they are all from the Forsaken Race."
This time, the mother and daughter pair were left stunned, their faces as pale as white paint.

chapters.title: Chapter 956: Decisive Decision, Reward
paragraphs: What Kent did was merely buy himself some time to prepare before starting the main quest.
He was meant to kill some powerful people, which, from what he had learned so far, would require him to face a large army.
First of all, he knew he had to prepare adequately, for that is the only way he would be able to complete the quest and go back home.
The second is merely him making sure the Heaven’s Eye Sect wasn’t suddenly razed down while he was away.

Everybody at this point knew the Heaven’s Eye Sect bought one Soul Spirit, and while others wouldn’t dare come for it, knowing they wouldn’t be able to enter the sect thanks to the formation protecting it, there was one person who would dare try.

The sect also knew these people wouldn’t pose a threat to them. However, the Planet King is different. His influence is known by all, and because of that, giving them the Soul Spirit was more like taking a strategic retreat.
Only that this retreat was on Kent’s terms.
He had made a decisive decision, and that didn’t escape the eyes of the universe.
However, now looking at the Soul Spirits hovering in the air, Kent couldn’t help but smile, telling the ladies that they shouldn’t worry.

"Take this as an upgrade from the previous ones you had, and as your future husband and son-in-law, I am even willing to give you both one each. This way, when I am away, I can rest assured no harm will come to you both."
Kent smiled in his seat, looking at the two ladies who couldn’t handle what they were seeing.
There was one thing to own a Tier 18 Soul Spirit and another to own a Tier 19 one. The fact that Kent even has Tier 18 was already shocking.
However, he now has Tier 19, and there are five of them, each from a race that promises a soul puppet will keep growing by devouring the souls of those it slays.
If that isn’t enough to make anyone turn pale from shock, then perhaps the word shock doesn’t exist.
Lady Kami looked in Kent’s direction and wondered, ’Just how powerful is he to have the soul power to sever the underworld connection with Tier 19 Soul Spirits and take possession of them?’

Throughout history, many soul masters have risen to prominence, with some even transcending their own limitations. However, all of them could attest to the fact that taking possession of Soul Spirits is something extremely difficult.
Most at best can take possession of one Tier 19 Soul Spirit, but they themselves may either have the same cultivation as the Soul Spirit or soul strength either higher or the same as the Soul Spirit.
Of course, a few exceptions came to pass with the Soul Monarch, even rumoured to possess an uncanny ability to claim even reincarnation souls and claim any Soul Spirit they wish to have.
However, the collective thought in the field of Soul Refining says that to possess ownership of a soul, one must have powerful soul strength.
This means that a Core Formation expert had no business possessing five Tier 19 Soul Spirits.

’Don’t tell me he has soul strength higher than Tier 19.’ She wiped this thought out of her mind. Even though she has a cultivation base of peak Tier 19 (Heavenly Ascension), her soul strength is only at Tier 18.

Kent was only at Tier 16. However, Kent is immune to soul attacks, and that factor influences many of the things he can do. However, none of that was the reason why he was able to take possession of this many powerful Soul Spirits.

’Mom, I think we should form a good relationship with this kid. He is not only resourceful but also very strong. I even feel like if I were to fight him, I will lose, and the worst part, his fate is something not even gods can read.’
Lady Azela said to her mother, who nodded.
’Indeed. Combat-wise, I can handle him, but when I tried reading his fate, something or someone extremely powerful warned me not to court death.
I believe he is someone with extremely good Karma. Aligning ourselves with him will be beneficial for us, especially during these challenging times.’
Lady Kami looked at her daughter, who also looked back at her. There was an unspoken agreement.
"Azela, take that one. I will take this one." Lady Azela pointed at one of the Soul Spirits, which was the leader of the Forsaken Race that attacked Planet Sonox.
She was the strongest of them. Naturally, Lady Kami gave that one to her daughter, and she picked the second strongest.
Kent smiled and waved the Soul Flag, taking back the three Soul Spirits. He waved it again, and four Tier 18 soul spirits appeared.
"I don’t know what goes into refining Soul Puppets, but since souls are fragile, take this four as a down payment for the dowry I will be paying for your daughter’s hand in marriage in the future."
Kent smiled and stood up, walking to one corner of the room and sat down. He then accessed the Tower System.
When he sent the Soul Spirit away with his new puppets, Kent heard two ding sounds in his head, causing him to wonder just what had happened.
The sound was the same as the one heard whenever he received a quest.
So Kent decided to check it out.
⟪You have an update on your quest⟫
⟪You have made a decisive decision that would save thousands of souls. Because of this, the Universe deems it okay to award you early⟫
⟪The Taming Bracelet has been released and is now inside your soul universe⟫
’Well, that is not expected but a welcome surprise.’ Kent smiled, taking out a golden metallic bracelet from his space ring.

’This looks familiar.’ Right when Kent’s eyes landed on the bracelet, he felt a sense of déjà vu. It was like he had held this bracelet before, but for as long as he could recall, this was the first time he was holding this bracelet.
Nonetheless, he slapped it on his wrist, causing a wave of information about how to use it to pour into his mind.
’Very convenient.’ Kent smiled happily, causing the still-in-shock mother and daughter to wonder what he was smiling about.
Kent didn’t even pay attention to them. ’With this, I can tame even Heaven Ascension stage beasts and higher.’
Kent was happy, but he quickly checked the second message.
⟪Update: Sword Sage Requirement Updated⟫
⟪Due to unexpected circumstances, the uncompleted Sword Sage requirements have been updated. To become a Sword Sage, you must complete the following requirement⟫
↠ Single-handedly kill the so-called Planet King in a one-on-one battle. You can use any means to kill him as long as it is a one-on-one battle.
’Only one, but why do I feel like this one will be several times more difficult than when I killed the Wandering Demon Swordsman?’
Kent didn’t know if this was a good thing or a bad one. However, he is now happy to know the road to becoming a Sword Sage was just a few sword strikes away.
If he managed to kill this bastard, he would become a Sword Sage, meaning he would be a step closer to reaching the Sword King stage. He can then ascend to a high world.
’I might as well use this time to absorb the Jade Token and upgrade my Enchanted Eye and the Sword Gaze.’𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆𝙬𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝒎
Kent retrieved the Jade Token and pressed it against his forehead. In an instant, he was enveloped in a nourishing sensation that transported his mind to the realm of enlightenment.

chapters.title: Chapter 957: The Fourth Floor - Church Of Destruction (1)
paragraphs: While Kent was 370,000 years in the past, back in the future, his wives and legion are finally gearing up to face the 4th floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon.
They have 12 years to clear the entire 37 floors of the dungeon.
They had already cleared the first three and are now ready to face the 4th floor.
Vexthra has woken up, and even Val, who nearly died during the battle against the Forsaken Race, has also recovered and is ready to face the 4th floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon with her sisters
"Are we all ready?" Vexthra asked, and her sisters, along with Kent’s legion, nodded in response.
They were finally done looking for all they could find on the third floor, so they might as well keep moving forward.

"Remember, the 4th floor is an upgrade of the previous floors, so we must be on our A game, and no matter what, none of you should get hurt. This dungeon is for us to clear, so we should do well to handle it for Kent.
Getting hurt will delay our progress"
They couldn’t agree more.

Kent’s return to save them during the Forsaken Race invasion was a wake-up call to them, reminding them that they were still weak and that if Kent were in trouble now, they wouldn’t be able to help him much.

So they want to break their limits and reach a level worthy of their rank as Core Formation experts. After all, Kent is also at the Core Formation stage, yet he was able to kill even the avatar of an Immortal.
One could argue that he was able to kill the avatar because he fought him with 2% of his Immortal cultivation.
However, the truth is that any other Core Formation in Kent’s place would have died from just one attack from the avatar. So this shows Kent’s power, and they want something like that.
"Let’s go."
Vexthra opened the portal to the 4th floor, and soon, they appeared inside. However, as soon as they appeared, they saw smoke coming from miles away.
Vexthra quickly checked the quest message.
⟦Name: Planet Killer Dungeon⟧
⟦Floor Name: Church of Destruction (4th)⟧
⟦Power Level: Core Formation - Spirit Lord*⟧
⟦Description:
↠ The Church of Destruction is a ragtag group of demon worshippers. They pray to the great Demon God Balmu, the Demon God of Savagery.

↠ From time to time, they offer a sacrifice to their god, who in turn bestows powers on them. Because of this, the Church of Destruction has, over time, accumulated great power, causing it to slowly get out of control.
↠ They started going out of control to the point that instead of one sacrifice every few months, they now offer sacrifices in the masses, killing as many as they could to please their god.

↠ The king of this world has tried to stop them but failed, causing him to instead protect those he could. Due to this, the smaller towns and villages were left at the mercy of the Church of Destruction.
↠ Your mission is to kill every last member of the Church of Destruction and free the people from years of tyranny.
⟦They have 1200 Core Formation, 400 Spirit Ascension, 300 Spirit Kings, 100 Spirit Emperors, 50 Spirit Monarchs, 10 Spirit Sovereigns, and 3 Spirit Lords. But be prepared for anything⟧
⟦Rewards⟧
↠ 10 Million Tower Points
↠ 100 Billion Soul Essence
↠ Destiny Awakening Token (Unity)
↠ Limit Breaker Key (Everybody)
"Follow me, I will tell you everything on the way," Vexthra began flying toward the location from which the smoke was coming.
Her sisters and the legion followed her.
"So our mission this time is to handle a scum of a church that kills the innocent as a sacrificial offering to their god, who is also a scum. I personally know that bastard and even slapped him once.
However, knowing he had his hand in this mission is all the more reason for us to be cautious and prepare for anything.

He is the kind of god who will stop at nothing to keep growing stronger. This Church of Destruction has for years been offering sacrifices to him, so it is only natural to say we will be facing a true challenge this time."
Vexthra paused, remembering back when she first met this Demon King Balmu. That bastard fell in love with her at first sight.
It ended for him badly, but even so, he was still infatuated with Vexthra, going to extreme ends just to become strong enough to tame the untamable goddess.
In fact, it isn’t just him who is doing this. Thousands of gods want to tame Vexthra, and due to this, they would stop at nothing to grow stronger.
’Perhaps this is a chance to sever one of his energy sources.’ Vexthra sighed.
"They have three Spirit Lords, but for some reason, I believe we should be prepared for a Heavenly Ascension stage warrior.

Thankfully, Veydris has finally reached the Core Formation stage after the upgrade. With him, Irina, Val, and Elyndra working together, we should be able to handle even a Heavenly Ascension stage warrior." They nodded.

"However, before we reveal our trump cards, Vari, Camilla, and Unity, you will face one of the Spirit Lords. Kaizo and Sylara, you will also handle a Spirit Lord, with the last one being handled by Enzi, Liora, Neomi, and Lani." The ladies also nodded.
Vexthra decided to bring Lady Enzi and Liora to challenge the 4th floor with them.

Since Kent had been exposed to some of his secrets, it meant he trusted them. And Vexthra, knowing what was best for her man, had brought them, ensuring they blended in well with the rest of Kent’s wives and legion.

"The rest will focus on the remaining members. If everything goes well, we should be done by the end of the day. But there is a chance some might escape, so Alina, you should prevent that from happening."
After a few minutes of flying, they came to a stop 300 meters from the source of the smoke.
"What the hell?" Unity muttered, looking at a city now in ruins.
"Everyone is dead, and judging by the smell of the smoke, this battle happened not long ago," Selene said, looking at the smoky city.
"This is no battle. This was a massacre," Alina muttered, looking at the charred remains of some people, some even being children.
Vexthra’s eyes turned dark, but Unity was by her side to pull her back. She sighed and thanked Unity before turning to Ingrid.
"Can you see them?" she asked, pointing in a certain direction. "They went that way."
Ingrid activated her Void Eyes and pierced through the void. In no time, she saw what she was looking for.
"They are 4 miles away from a village, 23 miles from here. If we leave now, perhaps we will be able to catch up to them before they completely massacre the village.
There are over 2000 people in the village. At least we can save some of them"
"What if you were alone to go after them? How fast can you get there?"
"I can get there, but they will reach the village faster than I. This means we can’t evacuate them."
Vexthra felt powerless despite being a goddess.
However, before she could ask anything more, Veydris flew into the air, and with one swing of his sword, the void cracked, and Ingrid, who could see through the void, widened her eyes.
"Let’s go. With this, we can stop them before they reach the village." Without wasting time, Ingrid flew into the crack. The rest of her sisters followed, with Veydris being the last to enter.

But be prepared for anything⟧
⟦Rewards⟧
↠ 10 Million Tower Points
↠ 100 Billion Soul Essence
↠ Destiny Awakening Token (Unity)
↠ Limit Breaker Key (Everybody)
"Follow me, I will tell you everything on the way," Vexthra began flying toward the location from which the smoke was coming.
Her sisters and the legion followed her.
"So our mission this time is to handle a scum of a church that kills the innocent as a sacrificial offering to their god, who is also a scum.
I personally know that bastard and even slapped him once.
However, knowing he had his hand in this mission is all the more reason for us to be cautious and prepare for anything.
He is the kind of god who will stop at nothing to keep growing stronger.
This Church of Destruction has for years been offering sacrifices to him, so it is only natural to say we will be facing a true challenge this time."
Vexthra paused, remembering back when she first met this Demon King Balmu.
That bastard fell in love with her at first sight.
It ended for him badly, but even so, he was still infatuated with Vexthra, going to extreme ends just to become strong enough to tame the untamable goddess.
In fact, it isn’t just him who is doing this.
Thousands of gods want to tame Vexthra, and due to this, they would stop at nothing to grow stronger.
’Perhaps this is a chance to sever one of his energy sources.’ Vexthra sighed.
"They have three Spirit Lords, but for some reason, I believe we should be prepared for a Heavenly Ascension stage warrior.
Thankfully, Veydris has finally reached the Core Formation stage after the upgrade.
With him, Irina, Val, and Elyndra working together, we should be able to handle even a Heavenly Ascension stage warrior." They nodded.
"However, before we reveal our trump cards, Vari, Camilla, and Unity, you will face one of the Spirit Lords.
Kaizo and Sylara, you will also handle a Spirit Lord, with the last one being handled by Enzi, Liora, Neomi, and Lani." The ladies also nodded.
Vexthra decided to bring Lady Enzi and Liora to challenge the 4th floor with them.
Since Kent had been exposed to some of his secrets, it meant he trusted them.
And Vexthra, knowing what was best for her man, had brought them, ensuring they blended in well with the rest of Kent’s wives and legion.
"The rest will focus on the remaining members.
If everything goes well, we should be done by the end of the day.
But there is a chance some might escape, so Alina, you should prevent that from happening."
After a few minutes of flying, they came to a stop 300 meters from the source of the smoke.
"What the hell?" Unity muttered, looking at a city now in ruins.
"Everyone is dead, and judging by the smell of the smoke, this battle happened not long ago," Selene said, looking at the smoky city.
"This is no battle.
This was a massacre," Alina muttered, looking at the charred remains of some people, some even being children.
Vexthra’s eyes turned dark, but Unity was by her side to pull her back.
She sighed and thanked Unity before turning to Ingrid.
"Can you see them?" she asked, pointing in a certain direction.
"They went that way."
Ingrid activated her Void Eyes and pierced through the void.
In no time, she saw what she was looking for.
"They are 4 miles away from a village, 23 miles from here.
If we leave now, perhaps we will be able to catch up to them before they completely massacre the village.
There are over 2000 people in the village.
At least we can save some of them"
"What if you were alone to go after them?
How fast can you get there?"
"I can get there, but they will reach the village faster than I.
This means we can’t evacuate them."
Vexthra felt powerless despite being a goddess.
However, before she could ask anything more, Veydris flew into the air, and with one swing of his sword, the void cracked, and Ingrid, who could see through the void, widened her eyes.
"Let’s go.
With this, we can stop them before they reach the village." Without wasting time, Ingrid flew into the crack.
The rest of her sisters followed, with Veydris being the last to enter.

chapters.title: Chapter 958: The Fourth Floor - Church Of Destruction (2)
paragraphs: Kent had already revealed the true nature of the Planet Killer Dungeon to his wives and legion, so they knew death was permanent inside.
This meant that regardless of which side dies, there would be no respawning. So knowing a village was about to be attacked made them want to kill these lackeys of the demon god even more than ever.
The villagers are innocent in the games of the gods; thus, saving them would give them good karma, something almost all of Kent’s ladies and legion have.
At the moment, the members of the Church of Destruction were 2 miles away from the village when the sky suddenly cracked, causing them to halt.
However, the next second, they all scattered, with some vaporising as Kaizo emerged from the void with his entire body coated in golden lightning.
His fist landed on the ground, sending a burst of golden lightning fueled by his bloodline power. This attack was enough to bring chaos to the battlefield in an instant.
Those closest to the impact zone were vaporised by the lightning.
The others appeared the next second, also emerging with terrifying attacks.
"Retreat, it is an ambush," one of the Spirit Lords shouted, causing hundreds of his team members to start running back in haste.
It was indeed an ambush, and Vexthra wasn’t going to let them run away.
"Alina, prevent them from escaping."
The busty Alina was already on the move. She flew into the air and formed a hand seal, manifesting a formation. Well, she manifested a skeleton of the true formation.
"Don’t allow the Spirit Lords to escape." Vexthra knew Alina needed time, so she gave the order, and her team moved.
"Glass Wall." Lady Enzi picked the target that she, Lady Liora, Neomi, and Lani would be fighting.

The Spirit Lord, who was speeding away, suddenly struck an invisible wall, causing glass to shatter. The impact was that strong. However, before he could resume his escape, Lady Enzi made her true move.
"Mirror Dimension." In an instant, the four of them, including the Spirit Lord, fell into a dimension made of mirrors.
"We have 25 minutes before this place comes down," she warned before moving, creating a glass-breaking sound. The next second, her sword clashed with the Spirit Lord, who was wielding a spear.
"A mere Core Formation nobody dares to think you can trap me." His Spirit Lord aura flared, but the ladies had been under worse, so they shook it off and charged forward.
"Lani, do your thing; we will create an opening for you," Neomi said before she moved forward, maintaining her normal form.
In fact, even Lani was using her normal form. They wanted to become strong, so they chose to fight in their normal forms and only take on their battle forms when they had no other options.
On the outside, Kaizo and Sylara had also clashed with the second Spirit Lord, taking him out of the equation.
The third one was also surrounded by Vari, Camilla, and Unity.
Unity was maintaining her distance simply because she didn’t want to miss any of her shots.
Her Primordial Spirits wouldn’t be able to help her since they were currently asleep from overexerting themselves during the battle against the Forsaken race.
However, even with them absent, she was still causing the Spirit Lords to falter.
Camilla was the main attacker, with Vari making sure the Spirit Lord was always watching his back, while Unity was going for the killing shots.
"Alina, when you are done, retreat and go ensure none of them slip away into the village." Alina nodded, drawing a few runes in the air.
After five minutes, the formation was set, and she moved away.
A few minutes later, she stood over the village, looking over the terrified expressions on their faces. Most parents were clutching their children. They all held weary looks on their faces.
When they saw Alina, the few among them who had some cultivation base launched their attacks at her. However, Alina merely brushed them aside with a wave of her hand.
"Relax, everyone, I am not here to hurt you," Alina said, looking toward the strongest in the village.
"My companions have intercepted the Church of Destruction and are handling them. I just came here to ensure none of them slipped away and entered the village."
She waved her hand, and a formation appeared. It enveloped the entire village. After a few seconds, she sighed, "I have placed a formation over the village.

It will prevent anyone aside from me or my companions from entering. It will protect you until we have taken care of them. None of you should step out, else the formation will not be able to protect you."
With that, Alina teleported and appeared beside Vexthra.
"It is done. None of them slipped into the village, and I made sure none could enter."
"Good. You can join your sisters."
Alina nodded and appeared over the battlefield. "Battle Matrix."
Alina activated her Battle Matrix formation she had started working on after they cleared the third floor. A green formation appeared and expanded, covering half of the battlefield.
Her rune knife appeared in her hand, and she started drawing runes. In no time, she added an attack array to the formation, causing it to start attacking.
Vexthra, who saw this, smiled.
"If she is in a high world, or Immortal worlds, Formation families and sects will be bowing at her feet to join them." Her smile turned into pride. "She really is intelligent."
For a goddess to admire and compliment a mortal, they might have done something even a goddess doesn’t seem to think they themselves could.
Bear in mind, Vexthra is a Rune Master herself. So she understood what Alina did, and that was why she called her a genius.
Many formation experts spend weeks, or even months, to create an attacking array as complex, beautiful, and lethal as the one Alina had created within mere minutes.

And the incredible part is that the attacking formation she added was now learning and adapting to the battlefield, making it something that will continue to grow until it becomes unstoppable one of these days.
"Until she reaches the Immortal world, I will never let her join any sect. With her talent, those bastards will take advantage of her."
While Vexthra was admiring Alina, Kaizo’s voice boomed across the battlefield.
"Die, scum!" Sylara stabbed her claw into the chest of the Spirit Lord they were fighting and threw him, crashing to the ground.
RUMBLE
The cloud turned golden as lightning and thunder surged within.
"Titan Overbearing Fist!"
Kaizo came crashing toward the Spirit Lords, whose gazes turned hazy for a moment. "Eat my fist, scum!"
BOOM
Kaizo’s fist landed on his head, exploding it like a watermelon. The ground where the Spirit Lord stood exploded, sending shards of stone flying everywhere.𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
"That takes care of it." Kaizo moved into the chaos and resumed slaughtering the members of the Church of Destruction.
Sylara also moved, and the next second started gutting the Spirit Sovereigns and those below. She, in fact, had become a menace after forming the Blood Hunger Seal.
If it were up to her, they would be having bloody battles like this always. After all, with every bloody battle, her hunger grew. And as her hunger for blood increased, so did her strength.
Naturally, unless the Blood Hunger Seal is destroyed, she will keep growing stronger.
Of course, she still had a secret that even Kent didn’t know.
But if her plan worked out in the end, she would reveal everything, which would be something that was promised to send her and those around her on a journey of massacre and bloodbath.

chapters.title: Chapter 959: The Fourth Floor - Church Of Destruction (3)
paragraphs: "Mirror Distortion," Lady Enzi muttered, causing the space around the Spirit Lord to twist.

"Blinding Dagger," Lady Liora followed up by throwing her dagger, which vanished from sight. The next second, she also vanished and appeared behind the Spirit Lord, stabbing her second dagger into his shoulder.
She was aiming for his neck, but he managed to shift his body slightly, causing the dagger to stab his shoulder.
"Die, bitch."
He swung his spear, attempting to strike Lady Liora away. However, mid-attack, he sensed a dagger appear before him, causing him to abandon the attack.
But he couldn’t move away because the glass under his feet gave out, and he fell, falling alongside Lady Liora.
Lani, who appeared before him, preventing him from attacking Lady Liora, laughed, stabbing her dagger at the Spirit Lord’s head.
But her target is no simple warrior. He is a Spirit Lord.
Thankfully, he was able to block it with his hand. But the dagger went through his arm, causing him to scream like a baby who had touched fire.
"All of you should just die," he exploded his aura yet again, causing the three ladies to move back. However, they all smiled when they saw a blur move past them.
The next second, a head shot into the air.
Neomi, the mother of Killers, swung her sword, wiping the blood that appeared on it.
"So cool," Lady Enzi muttered, looking at the back of the beauty who had timed it perfectly and took advantage of the chaos to kill the Spirit Lord.
"Tch, what a showoff," Lani smirked, though she couldn’t help but admire her sister’s finesse when it came to killing.
"Well done, you two. You have proven to be capable warriors. No wonder Kent is obsessed with you both," Neomi said, taking out a spear now.
Naturally, she wields the spear, but for this kill, she used a sword, proving just how lethal she can be with a weapon in her hands.
"Thanks for the compliment, but we are still lacking compared to you ladies," Lady Liora said with a small smile.

"True, but don’t worry. Kent will hook you up with a fix soon." Lani giggled. "The price for that, of course, will be revealed by our big sister who already has your destinies arranged and your fate sealed in stone."
Lady Lani and Liora raised their brows, feeling a chill run down their back.
"Don’t panic, she is a goddess, so you are in good hands..."
"We should join the others," Neomi smiled, looking at the expression on Lady Enzi and Liora’s faces.
Lady Enzi blinked a few times and then deactivated the Mirror Dimension, bringing them back to the battlefield.
Right when they appeared, the third Spirit Lord was killed by an arrow through the head.
The moment the third Spirit Lord fell, the rest started to scatter. However, how could they leave that easily when Alina held them as prisoners?
"Finish them off," Vexthra said, already looking forward to the conclusion of the quest.
"Big sister, something is not right," Alina said, flying toward Vexthra.

"What is wrong?" she asked, and Alina pointed at the members of the Church of Destruction. "From what you said, there should be 2,063 of them on the battlefield. However, counting the dead and alive, there are only 1,563 of them.𝐟𝐫𝕖𝗲𝘄𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝕧𝐞𝚕.𝕔𝕠𝐦
We are still missing 500 of them, the majority of them being Spirit Monarchs and Sovereigns."
"I figured as much. For now, we can eliminate these ones and handle the rest later. I am afraid this mission wouldn’t be ending today."
Alina nodded and flew back to the battlefield.
"I knew something wasn’t right from the moment we arrived on the 4th floor. However, now that I’m here, I can’t help but sense that something terrible will be happening soon.
I’d better take extra measures to ensure no harm comes to any of them."
With the Spirit Lords dead, the battle came to an end within 55 minutes. Every last member of the Church of Destruction was killed.
Vexthra quickly gathered her team and informed them of Alina’s discovery.
"So we have 500 still at large?" Lani asked.
"Indeed. However, if I were to guess, they can be found at their church," Vexthra answered.
"Then, how about we storm there and bring everything down?" Kaizo proposed, but Vexthra shook her head.
"No. Doing that will be suicide." Vexthra looked at everyone’s expression change.
"I think it is time you all learn something about us gods." They all opened their ears and were ready to listen.
"The reason why I said attacking their church is a bad idea is that doing so can be considered as directly attacking their patron god.
You see, the church is something blessed by their god since he receives their sacrifice. So if we were to attack that place, he has every right to intervene.
Of course, he can’t come down himself, but he can bless any of them, bestowing godly powers on them. We gods hold our worshippers dear, for they are our source of strength.
Of course, not all gods require the power of faith to grow, but this particular Demon God requires one, and I know with certainty he would use it against us."
"Can you stop him? I mean, you once slapped him, I am sure you can do that again," Anna asked, having complete trust in her big sister.
Vexthra pinched her cheek and smiled. "I am afraid I can’t stop him unless he sends down an avatar or he descends himself.
I am not just any god, my dear sisters. I am a god with my own Dao. This means I didn’t need the power of faith to grow stronger. I never required that since the day I ascended to godhood.
This means I can’t bestow my power on any of you. If I were to be just any god, then turning you all into my worshippers would have allowed me to bestow my powers on you.
Of course, if Kent were to be here, I would have been able to bestow a sliver of my power on him, but even that would cause more damage to him than good."
"Then it seems we are at a loss here," Elyndra, the strongest Undead in Kent’s legion until Sylara formed the Blood Hunger seal, said, shaking her head.
"Not entirely. While it is true that attacking them in their church is a suicide move, attacking them outside the church is possible; we just have to lure them out."
Vexthra, however, smiled at her own words. "Though I am afraid that wouldn’t be possible, for I am sure their god has already informed them of what happened and even told them what to do."
"Well, that is just great," Zareth shook his head.
"All this about gods and faith is making my head bleed." Kaizo gave up and sat down. This caused some of his friends to sigh and also sit down.
However, Vexthra kept a smile on her face as she looked at them.
Anna, who was paying close attention, saw through Vexthra’s smile, causing her to ask, "There is another way, right?"
Vexthra nodded. "There is indeed a way. However, only three of you can do it. This means only three of you can attack the church and kill the 500 remaining members of the Church of Destruction."

I mean, you once slapped him, I am sure you can do that again," Anna asked, having complete trust in her big sister.
Vexthra pinched her cheek and smiled.
"I am afraid I can’t stop him unless he sends down an avatar or he descends himself.
I am not just any god, my dear sisters.
I am a god with my own Dao.
This means I didn’t need the power of faith to grow stronger.
I never required that since the day I ascended to godhood.
This means I can’t bestow my power on any of you.
If I were to be just any god, then turning you all into my worshippers would have allowed me to bestow my powers on you.
Of course, if Kent were to be here, I would have been able to bestow a sliver of my power on him, but even that would cause more damage to him than good."
"Then it seems we are at a loss here," Elyndra, the strongest Undead in Kent’s legion until Sylara formed the Blood Hunger seal, said, shaking her head.
"Not entirely.
While it is true that attacking them in their church is a suicide move, attacking them outside the church is possible; we just have to lure them out."
Vexthra, however, smiled at her own words.
"Though I am afraid that wouldn’t be possible, for I am sure their god has already informed them of what happened and even told them what to do."
"Well, that is just great," Zareth shook his head.
"All this about gods and faith is making my head bleed." Kaizo gave up and sat down.
This caused some of his friends to sigh and also sit down.
However, Vexthra kept a smile on her face as she looked at them.
Anna, who was paying close attention, saw through Vexthra’s smile, causing her to ask, "There is another way, right?"
Vexthra nodded.
"There is indeed a way.
However, only three of you can do it.
This means only three of you can attack the church and kill the 500 remaining members of the Church of Destruction."

paragraphs: Hearing there is indeed another way to complete the mission lifted their morale. However, with only three of them qualifying to participate in the last phase of the battle, this left them wondering just who would be the lucky ones.
Naturally, Kaizo was looking forward to being one of the three; however, he was disappointed when Vexthra called out the three names.
