"Veydris, I understand he has the makings to face a god. However, while I am not looking down on any of them, how are Sylara and Neomi the only ones who qualify to face these scums?" Nara asked, and Vexthra explained.
"The reason is simple. Neomi has the power of faith, while Sylara literally has the powers of a primordial."
"WHAT!"
"I never knew Neomi had the power of faith," Anna said, and so did her sisters. Hearing Neomi has the power of faith took them aback.
Vexthra smiles, "Well, she does, but she doesn’t even know."
Velyra, who was standing not far from Neomi, looked at the lady she once recognised as the Mother of Killers, and she still does.
She and her kind worship the Mother of Killers, and to this day, they continue to do so.
They pray to her always, and now that they know she lives among them, their faith in her has strengthened even more.
"Does this have something to do with the Bloodvein tribe?" Velyra asked, seeking clarification.
"Indeed. When I first descended, I sensed the power of her faith in her. Back then, I didn’t know where it originated. However, after meeting your tribe, I finally saw the source of her faith power.
Their unyielding belief in her has translated into the power of faith and has been nourishing her for a while now."

"So, how is her power of faith going to help us win? I mean no offence, but how can the faith of one tribe give her the power to fight against a god? She is not even a god yet," Kaizo asked, but Vexthra shook her head.

"She is indeed not a god, nor does she have more than one source of faith power. However, her followers have something that even most gods don’t, and that is their unyielding belief and loyalty." Vexthra paused and turned to Velyra and asked.
"If someone were to tell you to deny your goddess and renounce her, what would be your reaction?" she asked.
Velyra’s eyes turned cold merely hearing the question. Even without speaking, everyone could tell what she would do if that were to happen.
"You see." Vexthra turned back to Kaizo. "Although she doesn’t have more followers than a god, she has a couple of them who completely have faith in her, and that alone is enough.
Of course, she is no goddess, but the heavenly laws are just, and as such, the moment the power of a god descends, she will also awaken her godlike powers.
This means we will be banking on the demon god to bless his people, which will activate Neomi’s powers. But even if that doesn’t happen, she is still the Mother of Killers and Rakshasa."
Everyone seemed to grasp what Vexthra had said, making them wonder the same thing.
"What about Val then?" Elsa asked. "Among us, she is the only one who could literally become a goddess. Shouldn’t she be included in the mission?"
"No." Vexthra’s response was firm. "Including her will be a recipe for disaster. In fact, including her will be like offering her to the demon god."
"How?" Lilian asked.
"Because Val is like an unclaimed egg. The current hero merely has the means to channel godlike powers for a limited time.
If she were to be discovered, not only would the demon god have a reason to come down, he would also have it within his dominion to invoke the authority of the heavens, forever making Val his slave."
"WHAT!"
"You all don’t know yet, but after you get to the immortal world, you will understand most of these things. The heavenly Laws are weird in a way, yet just.
However, for now, please be aware that Val can’t join the mission."
"Okay. However, about Sylara, how does she factor into all this?"

"Sylara is, in fact, the main weapon in this mission. The reason is simple, she is the strongest among you all." Vexthra smiled, and Sylara narrowed her gaze, looking at Vexthra to see if she had discovered her secret.
"Even Veydris can’t contend with her if she puts her mind to it."
"How?" Zareth asked, looking at the Undead Evil Vampire lady standing beside her. "How is she stronger than all of us?"
"That’s because she possesses something that will give her unrestricted power for a limited time."
"The Blood Hunger Seal," Kaizo muttered, and Vexthra nodded.
"The Blood Transformation ability she possessed once belonged to a powerful primordial being known as the Slaughter King. Of course, the true technique is not called Blood Transformation.

However, despite being a knockoff of the real deal, this technique is one that can be possessed by one person every generation. Unless the current owner dies, no new person will be able to possess it.

Long story short, the technique is something dangerous. However, Sylara learned it and even formed a Blood Seal out of it. Though she had only formed one, it was the one we truly needed at the moment.
From what I know, the Blood Hunger Seal absorbs the blood of those killed. As it grows stronger, so does the person using it.
Right now, per the standards of a Supreme High World, Sylara is no weaker than a Spirit Emperor. However, we don’t need the strength of a Spirit Emperor.
What we need is the strength of a Spirit Sovereign or even a Spirit Lord.

So even though this will cost you dearly, if you were to burn the stored essence of the Blood Hunger Seal, then not only would you become unstoppable, you would also break the shackles binding you." Vexthra winked at Sylara.
"If you know what I am talking about."
The evil demoness nodded with a smile, "I am willing to do anything to get the job done."

"Wonderful." Vexthra seemed happy. "If you indeed manage to pull this off, then not only would you three finally break those limits you so desperately seek, but you all will walk away with amazing benefits."
"I am so jealous right now," Kaizo said, lying on his back as he gazed at the sky. "I will be staying here for a while."
Vaelros and Zareth joined him. They knew their job was done, so they might as well sleep and wait for good news from Sylara and her team.
Vexthra just smiled and turned to Ingrid, "Can you see where their church is located?"
"No. But I can track their aura toward that direction." She pointed toward the north.
"I will track them and inform you once I locate the church," Elyndra, the beautiful undead who could manipulate space and time, offered, and Lani chose to escort her.

"The rest of us should head to the village and wait for them there. It will be a few days before the next and final battle happens." They nodded and soon approached the village, Alina leading the way.

chapters.title: Chapter 961: Heavenly Jade Eyes
paragraphs: While Kent’s legion and wives were handling their business in the future, back in the past, Kent was also making moves of his own.
Only five hours had passed since his ladies arrived on the 4th floor; however, to Kent, it felt like five days had passed.
He was still seated in the same place he was five days ago. His eyes were closed, and the nourishing energy around him seemed to have grown much thicker and stronger.
Lady Azela and her mother, Lady Kami, were standing guards.
They didn’t want to leave his side until he woke up.
Thankfully, a few hours into the 5th day, Kent woke up from his enlightened state with terrifying changes.
He had just attained enlightenment, making it his 5th in the sword path. He still had 6 more to go. However, this particular enlightenment was one that Kent never saw coming.
The Jade Token he absorbed was one of the rewards he earned when he killed the Wandering Demon Swordsman. He was meant to absorb it a while back, but he was preoccupied with many things.
Now that he did, the change that happened was one he never expected. His Enchanted Eyes and the Sword Gaze merged, forming a mutation called Heavenly Jade Eyes.

Initially, he had two different sets of eyes: The Enchanted Eyes and the Sword Gaze. However, now he had just one after the two merged, and it was a set so powerful that he could barely begin to tell what he couldn’t do.
’So with this fusion, not only can I appraise anything I want, I can even see through many formations provided they are below Tier 16.’
Kent smiled.
He knew that with the Soul Map, seeing through Tier 16 formation and even bypassing it wasn’t that hard. However, seeing that he could now do that with just his gaze, he was more than happy.

’Aside from that, with a mere gaze, I will be able to see through the structure of any Array, formation, or restriction. Basically, even if I can’t see through them, I will be able to see what they are made of and then work to break them.’
’Isn’t this similar to Weaver’s Eye that Gaia told me about a while back?’
Kent didn’t know what to make of this unique ability of his eye. ’With this, I will be practically invincible unless, of course, the formation is Tier 19.’ He smiled.
’Even I have my limits.’
He then turned to the combat aspect of it, and just as a Sword Gaze does, he could attack using his Sword Gaze skills. All his sword gaze abilities have become stronger.
However, something had changed.
’Heavenly Jade Sword Art, huh?’ Kent read through a technique he had received out of the blue. It was a sword technique that functioned similarly to the Heavenly Transcendence Sword technique.
However, this one allowed him to form jade swords from his eyes and attack with them.
’The perfect sneak attacking skill. I will treasure it.’
Kent stood up, feeling like he was ready for the next phase of his plans. He had already made one progress and is now down for the next.
He turned around, and His eyes landed on the mother and daughter.
"Thanks for protecting me," Kent said, walking toward them.

Lady Kami retrieved a jade token and threw it at him. "My daughter told me you asked for the Soul Puppet Refining Art. I have recorded everything onto the jade token. You just have to channel your energy into it, and the information will imprint on your mind."
"Thank you."
Kent stored the jade token in his space ring without even checking what was placed on it. Naturally, he knew the ladies wouldn’t deceive him.
"So, where do you intend to go from here?" Lady Azela asked. She was already aware Kent would be leaving after delivering her to her mother. Now that he had done that, it was time for him to leave.
"I need somewhere I can train. A friend recommended a place called Flame Sea, but I’m unsure of its location. If you ladies can point me in the right direction, I will be very happy."
"This..."

Both Lady Azela and her mother’s expressions changed at the mention of the Flame Sea. They looked sceptical, unsure whether they should tell him about the Flame Sea or save his life by saying nothing.
"What is wrong?" Kent asked, seeing that they wanted to hold back on him. "If you are worried I will be in danger, then don’t.

If I were to go to a place filled with flame energy, it would not only be beneficial to me, but I might just gain the power to kill this Planet King. So tell me what I need to know because whether you like it or not, I will be going there."
Kent said with a small smile.
He had already received a quest, and he intended to complete it. Of course, he knew it wouldn’t be easy, so he planned to first raise his strength.

One way of doing that was to form his flame veins and, if possible, a flame core. He knew forming a flame core would raise his strength by several fold. So, he couldn’t afford to miss out on visiting a place called Flame Sea.
Lady Kami and her daughter saw the resolute look in Kent’s eye and knew that saying nothing would be bad for him. So they wanted to make sure he knew the danger before going there.
"Listen well, Kent," Lady Kami said. "In the Primos Planetary System, there are 120 planets. The ten Pill Worlds aren’t the strongest, though they are the wealthiest planets.
However, when it comes to strength and danger, even Planet Nictus surpasses them. However, there is a reason why we are hesitant to tell you about the Flame Sea.
It is located on Planet Cosima. It is a beast world dominated by some of the strongest beasts in this planetary system. Many even consider it the strongest planet in the Primos Planetary System.
The reason they think that is because of the Seven Flame Beast Monarchs located on the planet. They are beyond your understanding.
In fact, twenty Peak Heavenly Ascension stage warriors gathered to hunt just one of them, but only two of them returned barely alive."
Kent raised his brow.
"Not only would the flame on the planet reduce you to nothing, but the monarchs there aren’t at all simple for you to be roaming there."
Kent smiled. "I have no business roaming that place. I just want to train in the flame for a few weeks and then be on my way."
Knowing that not even twenty Peak Heavenly Ascension stage warriors managed to bring one down, Kent knew he had to be extra careful.

’I am afraid this time, I might just be meeting a true powerhouse of a Supreme High World. I’d better be prepared to not throw away my life before I get to see what forming a Flame Core will feel like.’
"How far is Planet Cosima from this planet?"
"Two weeks if you take a normal ship. One and a half if you pick the VIP ones. Those ones are safe and peaceful to travel in, though it might cost you extra."
"I don’t mind the cost. If I can get what I am looking for on the planet, then it will all be worth it."
"If you say so."
Kent spent a few minutes learning more about the Flame Sea. Once he had had enough, he left the sect and began travelling to the city where the Transfer Channel was located.

chapters.title: Chapter 962: Arriving On Planet Cosima
paragraphs: Kent stood before a man whose appraising gaze was already enough to shatter the resolve of even a Spirit King. However, despite being under such a gaze, Kent remained unfazed, even looking back at him.
"Did you just say you want to go to Planet Cosima?" the man asked, and Kent nodded in response.
"Are you perhaps looking for the most painful way to die, or did your parents abandon you at birth and you seek to look for them in that godforsaken planet?"
"Neither. I am merely going to train," Kent responded, making sure the man knew what he was after and that he should stop asking too many questions and sell him the ticket.
"Look, I am just a worker, but I feel like you are making a huge mistake. Planet Cosima is a place only Spirit Lords and Heavenly Ascension stage warriors dare to go to.
You are just a delicate human, a mere cultivator at the Core Formation stage. Throwing your life away is not worth it. You still have so many years ahead of you."
Kent smiled and shook his head, "You shouldn’t judge a book by its cover. Mr. I know the risks, and after weighing them, I know I will survive that place and even return with some goodies."
The man looked at Kent for a few more minutes, ignoring the shouts from those standing in line. Kent could tell the man was genuinely concerned about his safety.
However, he didn’t mind that. After all, he had already made plans to get to the planet one way or the other.

"Fine. However, be sure to purchase life-saving treasures upon arrival on Planet Cosima. Of course, you should know this transfer channel will take you to the Moon on Planet Cosima, and you will have to buy a teleportation talisman to teleport to one of the seven regions on Planet Cosima.

Kent closed his eyes and first analysed the information he managed to gather from Lady Kami.
"According to Lady Kami, the weakest beasts there are at the Spirit Sovereign stage, but even so, I should treat them as Spirit Lords.
Thankfully, they are only found in the outer regions. Also, those beasts are not affiliated with any of the Seven Flame Monarchs so killing them wont incur their wrath.
Not that I care about that. My mission is to first form the flame veins and then hunt later if I have time.
However, even so, appearing in the outer section will require me to have high flame resistance," Kent sighed to that.
"Thankfully, I have super flame resistance and comprehension." A proud smile appeared on his face.
"This means I can go much deeper into the outer region. But to step into the Inner Region, I need to use my Tier 12 Soul Flame to limit the amount of heat that will enter my body."
Kent sighed again, "If only I had the Ice element too. But since I don’t, then I can only pray that as I form more Flame Veins, my resistance will also grow much faster."

All he needed to do was stay in the flame, and thanks to his automated cultivation technique, the Flame Veins, resistance, and other aspects would continue to improve. However, he didn’t know just how fast that would be.
"Why am I even thinking, with the 5000% boost I have on my cultivation technique, this should be easy enough."
Kent laughed.
"The issue is when I finally step into the Inner Region. Naturally, I need to have Perfect Resistance to be able to traverse there.
According to Lady Kami, the reason why the 20 Heavenly Ascension stage cultivators failed was that they couldn’t withstand the heat despite using Tier 15 Flame Resistance pills.
I don’t have such pills, so I must be sure I have the body to resist this flame before venturing in. The endgame is to become strong, not to turn into a charred human."
While Kent was planning his moves, the ship rose into the air and entered the transfer channel.
"Also, under no circumstances should you go near the Ashfall Range. If the Black Flames don’t kill you, then the Black Flame Dragon Monarch will do," Kent muttered under his breath.
"That was the last warning Lady Kami gave me before I left. According to her, it was rumoured that the strongest of the Seven Flame Monarchs is the Black Flame Dragon Beast.
His domain is dangerous, and he himself is a menace. In fact, the beasts there are not weak in any way. If one were to find themselves there, then the only thing that awaits them is death."

Kent smiled and lay his head down, "Why am I even worried. Finding myself this far in the past is a testament to fate at work. Though mercy on that dragon if he comes across me. I will be sure to tell him what true menace feels like."
With that said, Kent sent his mind back to his memories and started reliving them over and over again.
[Meanwhile, Core of the Universe - Lady Universe and The Enchantress]
"Are you sure about this?" Lady Universe asked, looking at Kent’s sleeping face on the screen projected before her. Beside her, a projection of the enchantress could be seen.
"I don’t know," the enchantress answered. "However, if we don’t do something, he is going to hate us." She sighed and then continued.
"You heard what he said. He expected Elina to be living a good life by now, but we both know her life is anything but rainbows and sunshine.
Of course, we can’t change that, as it would cost the deaths of billions if we did. However, we can point him in the right direction.
I looked at the timeline and examined his fate, and so far, this is the only way we can point him in the direction where he can find one of his destinies."
Lady Universe nodded, but she wasn’t happy about this arrangement. "But isn’t this too dangerous?"𝙛𝒓𝓮𝙚𝔀𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝒐𝒎

"It is indeed dangerous, but I trust him, and I know he will be able to pull through. Of course, if he manages to pull through, then not only would he return much stronger, but his Karma will also grow, which I know you have been secretly plotting over the years to help him with."
A guilty expression appeared on Lady Universe’s face, causing her to smile. "Okay. I will listen to you. However, I won’t watch, so you are alone on this. I need to keep an eye on her."
"Do what you want. But remember, you cannot under any circumstances change anything."
"I know, sister, I will be careful."
The enchantress nodded, and her projection vanished.
Lady Universe looked at Kent’s handsome face for a few minutes before a sigh escaped her lips, "I am sorry, Chaos. I really am, but this is fate, and all I can do is watch it play out."
The screen changed to a young lady with a slave collar around her neck, sweat streaming down her body, as she worked tirelessly to mine Spirit Stones and Crystals.
Nine days later, Kent arrived on the Moon of Planet Cosima. When he alighted, he found himself in the midst of hundreds of powerhouses.

chapters.title: Chapter 963: I am built differently
paragraphs: "Hey, are you lost?" an Elven man asked, looking at Kent from head to toe. Kent had just stepped into his store.
"I am not," Kent answered, looking back at him.
"If you are not lost, then what are you doing in this godforsaken place? Do you perhaps have a death wish?"
Kent laughed, "I believe I am still too young to die. In fact, a man even told me on my way here that I still have so many years ahead of me, so death is not an option."
"I see. Then why did you come here?"
Kent turned toward the red planet in the distance, "I came because of that planet. I am here to train."

"Well, can’t say I didn’t expect that. But are you really sure this is something you wanted? I mean, look around, the weakest person here is a Spirit Monarch, and even they are looking to form a team with Spirit Lords for safety."
Kent looked around, and truth be told, he felt intimidated. Just within a 1000-meter radius alone, he could sense dozens of Heavenly Ascension stage warriors of different races and sizes.
However, he wasn’t scared easily. He was not going to give in that easily.
"I am built differently," Kent said, looking at the items displayed in the man’s store with a smug smile on his face.
He could see some life-saving treasures of varying nature and strength. However, his focus was rooted in the Teleportation Talisman.
The man was paying attention to Kent, and while he was certain Kent wouldn’t be returning alive from the Flame Sea, he couldn’t help but admire the brave look on Kent’s face.
"I was told that to get to the surface of Planet Cosima, I need to buy a Teleportation Talisman. Mind telling me more about how they work?"
The man sighed and decided to focus on his job instead of worrying about somebody’s life-or-death situation.

"We have seven different colours of Talisman, each designed to send you to the outer region of one of the seven regions. Since you are here, I assume you are aware that there are seven monarchs on Planet Cosima.
The white-colored Teleportation Talisman takes you to Lotus Inferno Lake, the region ruled by the Crimson Lotus Empress.
I don’t know if you have heard, but 20 Heavenly Ascension went after this monarch, and she singlehandedly killed 18 of them.
I wouldn’t recommend visiting her domain if you value your life. Of course, staying in the outer region is safe, but the beasts around will be a headache for someone like you."
Kent just smiled at the man’s words and continued to pay attention to the rest of the Talismans.
"The Scarlet Talisman will take you to Cinderhorn Plains, the domain of the Scarlet Flame Minotaur Monarch.
The Blue will take you to Scorched Skies, the domain of the Blue Flame Roc Monarch. A nasty bird that I would stay away from if I were you."
Kent nodded.
"The Violet will take you to the Serpent’s Coil Valley, the domain of the Violet Flame Serpent Monarch. People say he is much more lively, but I won’t recommend venturing there.
Those who saw him and managed to live said his head alone is bigger than a mountain."
"Bigger than a mountain, huh. I wonder if he will taste good," Kent said, almost drooling at that thought. The man looked at him and shook his head.
’I guess he is just too tired of living.’
He picked the next Talisman, which had a crimson colour, "This one leads to Molten Abyss, the domain of the Crimson Flame Titan Monarch."

He picked a golden Talisman, "This leads to the Eternal Nest, domain of the Golden Flame Phoenix Monarch, the second strongest beast right after the Black Flame Dragon Monarch, who lives in the Ashfall Range."
"So which one will you be buying? Each goes for 2000 Spirit Stones, with the return Talisman going for 10,000 Spirit Stones."
"I will take the one leading to the domain of the Violet Flame Serpent Monarch. I feel like I share a destiny with her."
"How do you know it is a her and not a he?" the man asked.
"Because serpents are usually ladies, and well, I kinda have a thing for serpents, so I might as well venture there first."
Kent laughed, but the man merely shook his head and retrieved a Violet Talisman and a Yellow one meant for him to use to return to the Moon.

"Know that for the return Talisman to work, you must be safe from danger for at least a minute. If you use it while on the run or fighting for your pitiful life, you will be transported to a random place. You might even find yourself in any of the seven core regions."
"Thank you for telling me all this. If I were to return, I would be sure to bring you a couple of gifts."

The man merely laughed, "One last thing, Cosima is extremely large as you can see, so don’t be in a hurry to move from one region to another. Just moving from one region to another can take weeks, sometimes even months."
Kent nodded and walked out of the man’s store. He looked toward another store that sold food.
Although he could go months without food, Kent chose to buy some just in case.
’I will be spending two and a half months there. If all things go well, I should be walking out a different person.’
With that thought in mind, Kent channelled his energy into the Teleportation Talisman and, like smoke, he vanished.
Inside the store where he bought the Talisman, the man sighed, seeing Kent vanish down to the planet everybody calls Hell.

It was extremely hot there, and just the thought of facing beasts, combined with the fact that without strong flame resistance, dying from just being there was extremely high, made everyone want to call this planet literal hell.

However, thousands of people visited there on a regular basis. Aside from training their flame resistance, the planet itself held some powerful treasures that, if obtained and sold, would fetch them a considerable fortune.
At the end of the day, everything is up to one’s fate.
Kent, whose fate had taken him from 370,000 years in the future, had just arrived in the outermost region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley.
The moment he appeared, a series of messages appeared in his vision.
⟪Your flame resistance has improved slightly⟫
⟪Your comprehension of the flame has improved slightly⟫
⟪Your Soul Flame grows stronger⟫
⟪Flame Source detected. Current Quality is not enough to begin forming Flame Veins.⟫
⟪Move deeper into the heart of the flame, absorb a richer form of the Flame Source.⟫
"We are in business," Kent smiled, opening the soul map.
In an instant, the 80,000 km was within his reach. He surveyed the area, and a sigh came from his lips.

"Looks like this place is indeed dangerous. Just the outer region is already this crowded." Kent noticed the various beasts lurking within the extremely large valley; he couldn’t even start to measure its end.
"With the soul map, I can avoid unnecessary battles and focus more on getting stronger." Kent moved and started heading deeper into the outer region.
He was lucky to have appeared in the outermost part of the Serpent’s Coil Valley. Many couldn’t say the same thing, considering most deaths happened within the first few minutes upon arrival.
Two hours later, a new message appeared, causing Kent to grin.

chapters.title: Chapter 964: Soul Explosion
paragraphs: ⟪You have formed your 1001 Flame Vein⟫
’And we are off,’ Kent said inwardly as he came to a sudden halt.
He wasn’t feeling any discomfort or weirdness despite getting far deep into the outer region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley.
So far, he had avoided the beasts, killing only two. His priority is to find a place to sit and let the flame veins form. Everything is automated for him, so all he had to do was sit and relax.
Of course, if he were to actively channel the flame essence himself, the process would be much faster.
But without that, he had already formed one flame vein, making him feel like he had accomplished something.
So until he felt the heat getting to him, he wouldn’t stop but keep moving forward.
However, before advancing further, Kent first paused and chose to observe a battle between a Boar and an Elephant beast.
They each are Tier 18 (Spirit Lord), and judging by the shockwave they are creating, ordinary Spirit Lord humans wouldn’t last a minute against them.
Kent, however, was already prepared to intervene when one of them was about to die and send both of them on their way.
After all, he was after their flame cores.

"Don’t do it, Elves. The moment they notice your presence, they will attack you instead." Within the 80,000 km radius inside the Soul Map, Kent could see three Peak Spirit Lord Elves sneaking around, heading toward the beasts.
They have no idea he was looking at them, and he had no reason to stop them from courting death.

"Right now, I can’t even see the entirety of this valley, not even the outer region is within my range. However, if these beasts were to attack these three, just 30,000 km away, there are four more beasts that can intercept them."
Kent clicked his tongue, knowing the outcome would be decided soon between the beasts, and if these Elves didn’t leave, they might just cause unwanted trouble.
"Okay, they stopped," Kent said as he activated the audio aspect of the soul map, allowing him to hear the Elves.
"We can’t get close, guys," one of them, a dark-haired Elf, said, holding a device in his hand.
The device had something akin to an hour hand on a watch. At the moment, it was moving erratically as they slowly approached the location of the beast battle.
"Why can’t we get close?" The second Elf, a green-haired young man, asked.
"Because my device is sensing powerful beasts closing in on this location."
"I don’t trust this compass of yours, Elion. It malfunctioned two days ago, causing us to miss a Tier 17 Flame core.
This time, there is a chance to secure two Tier 18 flame cores. I am not missing this chance," the green-haired Elf said, focusing on the beast battle.
"Me too. I think we should capture this chance and be two Tier 18 flame cores richer," the third Elf said, causing Elion to sigh.
"I will maintain my distance then." Elion still believed in his compass, which had saved his life several times already.
"Suit yourself," the green-haired Elf said, adding, "Just know that the money will be shared based on contribution."
Elion scoffed and chose to maintain a distance of 20 meters from his team.
Kent saw and heard their conversations through the soul map, and all he could do was sigh.
"Greed is a powerful curse." Kent took out his soul flag and waved it, taking out the two Soul Spirits of the beasts he had killed on his way into the outer region.
"Mess with them, but don’t kill them." The command was simple, but the two Soul Spirits moved and, within seconds, closed the gap between them and the Elves.
Kent observed everything through the soul map.
In the distance, the three Elves came to a sudden halt when they sensed two Tier 18 presences approaching at a speed several times their own.
"Run!"
Elion warned before speeding away, not daring to look back. His friends hesitated for a moment before running after Elion. However, they were too slow.
One of the beasts Kent killed was an ant-type beast that could use Earth magic.
Although now a soul spirit, just as it closed in on the two, it created a boulder made of earth and hurled it at them.
However, instead of letting the boulder strike them, it exploded just when it was a couple of meters from them, sending a powerful shockwave.
The second soul spirit, a millipede beast, burst from the ground and, using the momentum from the shockwave, blasted the two away, separating them.
It picked the green-haired Elf, and the Ant picked the other Elf.
"Elion, help!" the green-haired Elf called out as the millipede lunged at him...
Elion, who was 1 km away, stopped and turned to his friends, who were now locked on by the two Soul Spirits.
"Haunted souls," Elion muttered, looking at the Ant push his friend back.
"Damnit. I warned you fools, but you opted for greed over caution." Although he said that, his bow appeared, and he lunged an arrow at the Ant.
Sensing an incoming attack, the Ant backed away, allowing the Elf to distance himself.

"Run, Pyso," Elion shouted, causing the Elf he had just bought a second to run toward him. An arrow flew past his head, striking the millipede on the side, allowing the green-haired Elf to also move.𝓯𝓻𝓮𝙚𝙬𝓮𝙗𝒏𝙤𝒗𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝒐𝓶
Elion stored his bow and retreated, moving at a speed several times faster than before.
Kent held a smile on his face as he watched the three Elves retreat. When they were nearing the range of his soul map, he called back the Soul Spirits, allowing the Elves to successfully escape.
"That was fun," Kent muttered, looking at the Soul Spirits of the millipede and the Ant beasts he had killed appear before him.
"Although I can only use them inside the soul map range, if I need to make a move against some people, they will come in handy." Kent smiled.

"Of course, it wouldn’t work against Heavenly Ascension stage warriors." That was a bummer for him, as he knew things would have been much better if he could use this unique ability of the Soul Universe against Heavenly Ascension stage warriors.

"Then again, aside from the soul map that I can use to sense, hear, and teleport, I can also explode Soul Spirits." A wicked expression appeared on Kent’s lips as he looked at the two beasts fighting.
"If I explode a Tier 18 Soul Spirit, I am sure even Heavenly Ascension stage warriors will be wounded badly or even die on the spot."

He observed the two beasts, and the evil smile on his face spread. "Why don’t I experiment?" He put away the two Tier 18 Soul Spirits and took out a humanoid forsaken Soul Spirit that was only Tier 14.
"They both are wounded, so Tier 14 should be enough. Especially after nourishing it in my Soul Universe."
"Go."
Kent pointed forward, and the forsaken Soul Spirit moved. In an instant, it appeared 2 meters from the two beasts, who came to a sudden stop sensing the foreigner.
However, they only had a moment of silence before Kent made his move.
"Soul Explosion." He snapped his finger, and the forsaken Soul Spirit exploded, creating a devastating blast that consumed the two beasts in an instant.
"Damn."
Kent muttered, feeling the air around him grow chaotic as the shockwave, although not strong considering he was 40,000 km away, blew past him.
"What kind of terrifying ability have I just unlocked?"
A new message appeared...
⟪You have formed your 1002 Flame Vein⟫

He wasn’t feeling any discomfort or weirdness despite getting far deep into the outer region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley.
So far, he had avoided the beasts, killing only two.
His priority is to find a place to sit and let the flame veins form.
Everything is automated for him, so all he had to do was sit and relax.
Of course, if he were to actively channel the flame essence himself, the process would be much faster.
But without that, he had already formed one flame vein, making him feel like he had accomplished something.
So until he felt the heat getting to him, he wouldn’t stop but keep moving forward.

They each are Tier 18 (Spirit Lord), and judging by the shockwave they are creating, ordinary Spirit Lord humans wouldn’t last a minute against them.
Kent, however, was already prepared to intervene when one of them was about to die and send both of them on their way.
After all, he was after their flame cores.
"Don’t do it, Elves.

The moment they notice your presence, they will attack you instead." Within the 80,000 km radius inside the Soul Map, Kent could see three Peak Spirit Lord Elves sneaking around, heading toward the beasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 965: Unfortunate Incident
paragraphs: "Good Harvest"
Kent vanished from 40,000 kilometres away and appeared beside the glowing flame core. He waved his hand, and it vanished into his space ring.
He vanished and appeared beside the second flame core, which was 2 km away from where the first core was.
⟪You have formed your 1003 Flame Vein⟫
Another message appeared, but Kent didn’t mind and immediately used the Teleport ability of the soul map, which took him 80,000 km deep into the outer region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley.
⟪You have formed your 1004 Flame Vein⟫
The moment he arrived, Kent felt the heat in his surroundings touch his skin, telling him that even with Super Flame resistance, he was reaching his limit.
However, he didn’t panic; instead, he spotted a cave nearby. He quickly moved inside.
"Damn, the heat here is much stronger than I expected." Kent felt his body sweating instantly. However, he didn’t give in by retreating. Instead, he sat down and closed his eyes.

In that instant, aside from three more messages announcing he had formed flame veins, he also received one telling him that his flame resistance had improved greatly, and his comprehension also improved considerably.
But that wasn’t all, his Soul Flame was also improving slightly.

This shows that although he is currently in a region filled with so much flame essence that even a Super Flame resistance couldn’t necessarily block, his Tier 12 soul flame is no weak flame, so the flame essence was only improving it slightly.
Kent closed his eyes and decided to let his body do its thing. His focus now was on checking to see how forming flame veins would improve his flame resistance.
Five minutes later, 100 flame veins formed, making it 1100 out of 20,000 he needed to form before he could attempt to form his first flame core.

"I might as well use this chance to train my mind by checking through Chaos’s memories," Kent sighed and then dove back into his memories. Since he doesn’t require active cultivation, his body was doing all the work.
[Meanwhile, back at the explosion site]
The soul explosion was more devastating than Kent expected. He knew Tier 14 was no simple soul spirit, but compared to Tier 18, he expected Tier 14 to be less devastating.
However, he was wrong.
The explosion caught the attention of many people, prompting various groups, lone wanderers and beasts to move toward the site of the explosion.

Of course, the people who got there first saw nothing but bits and pieces of beast bodies. However, as they continued to look around, they sensed that the explosion was the result of a powerful soul attack.
This got them wondering just who had this much soul power to unleash such an attack.
Of course, the sensible ones started to wonder just what kind of soul attack could deal physical damage.
Then, after some managed to narrow it down to soul spirits, the next question was who would be rich enough to explode a soul spirit.
Perhaps this realisation was what made them all want to find this person and, if possible, steal a few soul spirits from him.
However, Karma has a way of striking when you least expect it.

Since the explosion drew Humans, it wasn’t too hard to know it would draw the attention of the beasts, too. Some managed to run, but a few were caught in the fierce charge of dozens of Tier 18 beasts.
BOOM
An arrow exploded in the face of a 300-meter snake whose entire body was covered in flames. The explosion was powerful, but it did little to nothing to push back the snake.
The person who fired shot clicked her tongue and retreated, looking sideways to see if her team was faring any better.
However, she saw one of them get thrown away by a Bull and another impaled in the hand by a bone-mouth scorpion.
"We shouldn’t have come here," she said, regretting the decision made by her team to come to the site of the explosion.
In her team, there are 3 Spirit Lords, including herself and 5 Spirit Sovereigns. If this were an ordinary place, their team would have been considered a powerful group.
However, three of the Spirit Sovereigns had died, and the other two were barely hanging on. Even the Spirit Lords, including herself, were struggling.

"I need to buy them a minute so they can escape using the Return Talisman," she muttered, but looking at three powerful beasts surrounding her team and the unkillable snake she was facing, she didn’t know if that could even be possible.𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶

She looked toward one of her team members, who was locked in fierce combat with a Bull. "Even if I can’t save all of them, I must ensure Lowell makes it. I can’t die knowing he wouldn’t be meeting his daughter."
She charged forward, taking out a sword from her space ring. When she was nearing the snake, she waved her hand, and a net appeared, catching the snake off guard.
The net caught it, but she didn’t wait to land a killing blow. She knew that if she stayed to try to kill the snake, she might just end up missing the chance to free Lowell.
So she charged directly at the Bull, and when she was close, she unleashed a sword strike, sending a blinding light at the Bull.

"Lowell, move back and escape. You have a minute." She landed on the ground, sending spikes shooting from the ground. This spike further pushed the Bull back while the snake was still struggling to free itself from the Enchanted net.
"Commander, you—"

"Run, Lowell, you have a daughter on the way. Be there for her... please," she commanded, and Lowell, who hesitated for a moment, saw the concerned look on her face, causing him to bite his lips and retrieve an item from his space ring.
He activated it and, like the wind, he was gone.
However, the lady knew what had happened, so she made sure her battle with the Bull didn’t move to where Lowell stood.
The item he used was a one-time life-saving treasure that made one invisible for a minute. Within that one minute, they could not move or breathe.

Lowell needed a minute to escape safely, so he stood in one place, observing his commander, who had led them through the thick and thin, battling it out with the Bull while the snake slowly burned through the net trapping it.
Thirty seconds passed, and the snake was still struggling to burn through the net. However, the lady was bleeding all over as the Bull continued to do a number on her.
She was a long-range fighter, a skilled archer with a peculiar affinity for the Earth element, thanks to her lineage as an Earth Human.
However, to protect her comrade, she had to switch to close combat, which at the moment had proven to be a bad move.
Thankfully, her resolve was rather strong, so until she saw that light vanish, she would never give in.
ROAR!
Just when the clock hit 55 seconds, the snake broke free and charged directly at Lowell, who was invisible, yet he knew the snake was coming for him.
"NO," the lady shouted; however, the distance between them was too wide to do anything. She could only watch as the snake charged, and when it was close, it unleashed a powerful flame beam.
However, just when the beam was 2 meters from Lowell, one of her teammates burned his core to erect a powerful barrier around him.
BOOM
A loud explosion occurred, and the shockwave sent everyone flying. However, before she could pass out, she saw a golden light shoot toward the sky and vanish into the clouds.
With a smile on her face, she passed out, unsure where her body would land.

chapters.title: Chapter 966: Verdant Flame of Renewal
paragraphs: From the time the soul explosion happened to when the first team appeared on the scene was exactly 5 hours.

The explosion drew them, but everyone was cautious about coming directly to the scene in fear that the attacker was still around. However, some came, but many left before the attack from the beast arrived.
Some ran and were chased.

Some died before the battle even began, with some even killing themselves using life-saving treasures that promised to send them to safety, but they would lose one stage of their cultivation, and it would be twice as hard to recover it.
However, Commander Agnes’s team was unfortunate. They were caught in the assault of four deadly beasts, each a powerhouse that no mere Spirit Lord could handle.
Perhaps, if they were attacked by only one beast, they would have killed it like they had many times over. However, this time things were different, and they each had to fend for themselves.
They did, but things went downhill from there.

However, before the explosion that sent both the beasts and the remaining members of Commander Agnes’s team flying in different directions, Lowell managed to use the return talisman, taking him back to the moon.
However, the rest of the team, including Commander Agnes, was blown away, unsure of what awaited them if they didn’t die upon impact.
Commander Agnes was thrown through the air like she weighed nothing.
She sped across the landscape like a rag doll.
In no time, she travelled several thousand miles deeper into the outer region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley.
However, just when she was about to hit the ground, a person appeared and caught her. The person then vanished in an instant, appearing inside a cave filled with a potent amount of flame essence.
"Set her down there," a Tier 18 Forsaken Soul Spirit set Commander Agnes’s body to the side. Kent flicked his hand, and a golden flame appeared on his palm.
"Meeting me is your fortune, lady. However, coming back from the dead will depend on your will to live."

The flame flew from his hand and landed on her forehead. In an instant, the golden flame turned into a green-colored flame that enveloped the lady, whose injuries were immediately healed, and her clothes were reduced to nothing.
The flame engulfed her, sealing her private parts.
Not that Kent was interested in her goodies. He had seen that of goddesses, and so a mere mortal was of no interest to him.
"There is still so much flame essence here. If I stay for a few days, I am sure forming close to 5000 flame veins won’t be impossible."
Kent closed his eyes again and went back to his memories, unaware of the eyes he had called on himself by using the Verdant Flame of Renewal to heal the lady and nourish her body.
The Nine Flames of Nirvana that Kent used to create his body when he attained Nirvana through body cultivation all had unique aspects.
The green flame, which was recognised during the primordial era as the Verdant Flame of Renewal, had healing and rebirth aspects.

It can mend wounds, purify toxins, and restore vitality. In fact, its essence was what the Phoenix race inherited, which granted them rebirth, allowing them to rise from the ashes and advance to higher stages.
With the Verdant Flame of Renewal, Kent was basically immortal, for it would take more than killing him to actually kill him.
Of course, when he merely had the flames in his core, killing him was possible. However, after Nana helped him merge them with his Chaos Soul flame, his healing speed increased significantly.

However, it wasn’t just him who could benefit. If he wanted, he could share it with others. He shared it with the lady who was currently healed of all external wounds and was undergoing internal healing.

However, temporarily using the flame, even though he didn’t know it yet, a pair of scarlet eyes opened deep within the core region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley, looking for something they sensed yet couldn’t see.
[Core region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley]
Inside the core region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley, there is a mountain made purely from a special stone known as Immortal Flame Stones.
They are said to contain traces of immortal qi. Though faint, cultivating the flame essence from it promises to, even if not recognisable, temper the body with immortal qi.
The mountain is 20 km tall.
At the centre of this mountain is a large cave that has been carefully carved with attention to detail.
The door frames are made from black stones, and standing guard are two Tier 19 (Peak Heavenly Ascension stage) Nagas.
They each have their eyes open. One is wielding a staff made from wood, and the other is wielding dual flame-forged sabres

Inside the cave, it was decorated with jade stones and various items that suggest a human lives there. However, the lady inside the beautiful cave, with scarlet hair, ember tattoos glowing across her skin, and cute red eyes, was no human.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖
These items used in the decorations were salvaged from wanderers they had killed.
She had her eyes open and was looking into the distance. One could tell she was looking for something; however, after a few minutes, she sighed.
"I sensed something extremely powerful inside my domain; however, it seemed to be too far from me," she muttered before calling out to her guards.
The two Nagas appeared.
"Niraya, Vashara, go to the inner region and look for something for me," the lady said, looking her two trusted guards in the eye.
"Whatever the Monarch commands, we will get it done."
"Good. Head to the inner region and look for something or someone out of place. If you find them and you can capture them, do so and bring them to me.

If you can’t, then use the bracelet. I will come to you. Of course, if you need assistance in searching for the thing, use the three rulers of the inner regions as you see fit. Kill all who dare resist."
"We will get it done, Monarch."
She nodded, "You can leave, and I expect results."

The two Nagas left and soon vanished into the distance, heading to the inner region to search for something that, if their Monarch got her hands on, would allow her to not only finally break the 30th limit on her body, but she would also awaken her Innate Beast Body, allowing her to ascend to an Immortal whenever she pleases.
Meanwhile, Kent remained in the cave, just 120,000 km away from the inner section, unaware that danger was heading toward him.
If only he knew that saving the lady would bring bad news to him, he wouldn’t have done so. However, since the danger hadn’t located him yet, he could only sit in silence and form his flame veins.
Two days went by, yet the flame essence in the cave didn’t seem to be thinning down anytime soon.
"I have already formed 3500 flame veins. Adding to the 1000 I already have, that is 4500." Kent smiled, "At this rate, I will be nearing 5000 in a day."
Commander Agnes still hadn’t woken up yet.
Three more days later, making a total of five days, the lady woke up, and the first thing she did was lunge at Kent with a dagger she had retrieved from her space ring.
However, it was caught between Kent’s fingers just when it arrived before his face.
"Looks like you are awake," Kent smirked.

sentences.text: From the time the soul explosion happened to when the first team appeared on the scene was exactly 5 hours.
The explosion drew them, but everyone was cautious about coming directly to the scene in fear that the attacker was still around.
However, some came, but many left before the attack from the beast arrived.
Some ran and were chased.

Some died before the battle even began, with some even killing themselves using life-saving treasures that promised to send them to safety, but they would lose one stage of their cultivation, and it would be twice as hard to recover it.
However, Commander Agnes’s team was unfortunate.
They were caught in the assault of four deadly beasts, each a powerhouse that no mere Spirit Lord could handle.
Perhaps, if they were attacked by only one beast, they would have killed it like they had many times over.
However, this time things were different, and they each had to fend for themselves.
They did, but things went downhill from there.

However, before the explosion that sent both the beasts and the remaining members of Commander Agnes’s team flying in different directions, Lowell managed to use the return talisman, taking him back to the moon.
However, the rest of the team, including Commander Agnes, was blown away, unsure of what awaited them if they didn’t die upon impact.
Commander Agnes was thrown through the air like she weighed nothing.
She sped across the landscape like a rag doll.
In no time, she travelled several thousand miles deeper into the outer region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley.
However, just when she was about to hit the ground, a person appeared and caught her.
The person then vanished in an instant, appearing inside a cave filled with a potent amount of flame essence.
"Set her down there," a Tier 18 Forsaken Soul Spirit set Commander Agnes’s body to the side.
Kent flicked his hand, and a golden flame appeared on his palm.
"Meeting me is your fortune, lady.
However, coming back from the dead will depend on your will to live."
The flame flew from his hand and landed on her forehead.
In an instant, the golden flame turned into a green-colored flame that enveloped the lady, whose injuries were immediately healed, and her clothes were reduced to nothing.
The flame engulfed her, sealing her private parts.
Not that Kent was interested in her goodies.
He had seen that of goddesses, and so a mere mortal was of no interest to him.
"There is still so much flame essence here.
If I stay for a few days, I am sure forming close to 5000 flame veins won’t be impossible."
Kent closed his eyes again and went back to his memories, unaware of the eyes he had called on himself by using the Verdant Flame of Renewal to heal the lady and nourish her body.
The Nine Flames of Nirvana that Kent used to create his body when he attained Nirvana through body cultivation all had unique aspects.
The green flame, which was recognised during the primordial era as the Verdant Flame of Renewal, had healing and rebirth aspects.
It can mend wounds, purify toxins, and restore vitality.
In fact, its essence was what the Phoenix race inherited, which granted them rebirth, allowing them to rise from the ashes and advance to higher stages.
With the Verdant Flame of Renewal, Kent was basically immortal, for it would take more than killing him to actually kill him.
Of course, when he merely had the flames in his core, killing him was possible.
However, after Nana helped him merge them with his Chaos Soul flame, his healing speed increased significantly.
However, it wasn’t just him who could benefit.
If he wanted, he could share it with others.
He shared it with the lady who was currently healed of all external wounds and was undergoing internal healing.

However, temporarily using the flame, even though he didn’t know it yet, a pair of scarlet eyes opened deep within the core region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley, looking for something they sensed yet couldn’t see.
[Core region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley]
Inside the core region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley, there is a mountain made purely from a special stone known as Immortal Flame Stones.
They are said to contain traces of immortal qi.
Though faint, cultivating the flame essence from it promises to, even if not recognisable, temper the body with immortal qi.
The mountain is 20 km tall.
At the centre of this mountain is a large cave that has been carefully carved with attention to detail.
The door frames are made from black stones, and standing guard are two Tier 19 (Peak Heavenly Ascension stage) Nagas.
They each have their eyes open.
One is wielding a staff made from wood, and the other is wielding dual flame-forged sabres
Inside the cave, it was decorated with jade stones and various items that suggest a human lives there.
However, the lady inside the beautiful cave, with scarlet hair, ember tattoos glowing across her skin, and cute red eyes, was no human.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖
These items used in the decorations were salvaged from wanderers they had killed.
She had her eyes open and was looking into the distance.
One could tell she was looking for something; however, after a few minutes, she sighed.
"I sensed something extremely powerful inside my domain; however, it seemed to be too far from me," she muttered before calling out to her guards.
The two Nagas appeared.
"Niraya, Vashara, go to the inner region and look for something for me," the lady said, looking her two trusted guards in the eye.
"Whatever the Monarch commands, we will get it done."
"Good.
Head to the inner region and look for something or someone out of place.
If you find them and you can capture them, do so and bring them to me.
If you can’t, then use the bracelet.
I will come to you.
Of course, if you need assistance in searching for the thing, use the three rulers of the inner regions as you see fit.
Kill all who dare resist."
"We will get it done, Monarch."
She nodded, "You can leave, and I expect results."

The two Nagas left and soon vanished into the distance, heading to the inner region to search for something that, if their Monarch got her hands on, would allow her to not only finally break the 30th limit on her body, but she would also awaken her Innate Beast Body, allowing her to ascend to an Immortal whenever she pleases.

chapters.title: Chapter 967: Progress & Decision
paragraphs: Kent held the dagger between his middle and index fingers, a smug expression painting his face.
Under normal circumstances, for his safety, he was supposed to remove the lady’s space ring and return it when she was awake, ensuring she posed no threat to him.
However, Kent is no simple person.
Especially after how strong he had become over the past five days, he wasn’t about to fear a Spirit Lord.
"Maybe you should put on some clothes before trying to stab your saviour in the back," Kent said with a smile.
The lady, though surprised that Kent managed to catch her dagger so effortlessly, turned and looked down at her body, hearing Kent’s words.
When she saw that she was completely bare before Kent, she let go of the dagger and immediately covered her chest with her right hand and her nether spot with her left.
"You-"
She tried to speak, but looking at the smug smile on Kent’s face, her heart skipped a beat. She quickly checked her body but saw no harm had come to her.
Her worry was lowered by a few percentage points
Kent stood up and stretched. "I will be waiting for you on the outside." He walked away, a chuckle playing on his lips.
When she made sure Kent was truly out of the cave, the lady sighed.
However, it quickly hit her.
"I am completely healed. Both on the inside and outside."
She looked at her body closely this time, then her eyes narrowed.
"How?" she asked, but then Kent’s image appeared in her mind. "Don’t tell me he was the one who healed me."
Her mind flashed back to her last moment during the battle against the four beasts with her team.
"I should have died," she muttered. "That impact from the explosion should have killed me. However, not only am I completely healed, even my body has also become much stronger than before."
"Just what has that person given me that manages to not only save me but also helps me become much stronger?"
She looked toward the entrance of the cave that Kent had gone through. She sighed in regret, knowing if this person was indeed her saviour, then trying to kill him was a grave offence.
Just the thought compelled her to dress up and go check if she could salvage the situation.
Meanwhile, Kent stood 3 meters away from the cave, feeling the warm air blow past his face. A smile appeared on his face.
"After 5 days, I have formed 8500 flame veins before the flame essence in this place had thinned down. Now, I can barely even feel the heat."
Kent extended his hand and manifested a ball of golden flames.

"Although my comprehension and resistance to the flame are still at the Super stage, I can tell how strong my body has become. With these developments, I can enter the inner region without even using my Soul Flame."
Kent looked out into the distance, and as it stretched forward, he could literally see the horror waiting for him.

"Though dangerous, I need to form at least 20,000 flame veins and form a flame core. Agni told me that having powerful flame cores is the first step to becoming Lord of Flames" Kent scratched the back of his head...
"I don’t have much time to hunt for enough flame cores. Although I have become stronger yet again, I know my limits, and I recognise danger when I see one.
This place is dangerous, so I can’t go rogue like I did in the Valley of Torture."
However, while Kent said this, a crazy look appeared in his eyes... "Then again, if I were to refine the blood essence of all the beasts I kill, wouldn’t that make me much stronger?

I have only cultivated 7% of the Primal Body Tempering Art. However, while I can extract the blood essence to cultivate it, I don’t know if focusing on that or focusing on the Blood Life and Death Seals."
Kent scratched his head, feeling awkward.
"Most look for ways to become stronger; however, here I am struggling to select which technique to focus on."
A laugh escaped his lips.
"But on the bright side, the seals are strong, and after the end of this quest, I will earn one each.
However, the Primal Body Tempering Art promises not only to improve my bloodline but also to allow me to harness more of my bloodline.
Perhaps focusing on that is ideal. I will use the time I have after forming at least 20,000 flame veins to hunt and gather as many cores and blood essence as I can.
Once I leave here, I must complete the quest and come back to spend the rest of my days here before going back to the future."
Just when Kent was making plans in his head, the lady walked out, now clad in a cloak-like armour. She narrowed her eyes at Kent when she saw him looking at her.
"I am Commander Agnes. I would like to thank you for saving me," she said with a slight bow.
Kent smiled, "Don’t worry about it, Commander Agnes. Saving beauties from going splat on the ground is one of my many hobbies.
And you can call me Chaos."
"Chaos?" The lady asked, her brow furrowed.
"What? Is it not a good name?" Kent frowned slightly. Of course, he was just faking the frown to see her reaction.
As expected, Commander Agnes panicked. "No. It is not what you think at all. Chaos is a nice name. It is just that this is my first time meeting someone named Chaos."
She put on a small smile to tell Kent she meant no disrespect. "It is an unusual name, that’s all."
"Well. It is my name and I like it, so whatever." Kent smirked, "In any case, I was only waiting for you to wake up so I could leave. Now that you are awake, we must part here."
Kent turned around, "Good luck and may fortune smile on you."
"Wait," Commander Agnes called out just when Kent was about to leave. He stopped and turned toward her.
"Please, aside from me, have you seen somebody else?" she asked.
"No. Just you."
"Then can you tell me how long I have been out?"
"Five days."
"Five days." A dark expression appeared on her face. "Even if they survive, they wouldn’t be able to survive this torturous place."
Commander Agnes muttered and took a deep sigh. "Thank you for everything, Chaos. In the future, if you need anything, you can find me on Planet Nictus. I will do my best to help you."
"I will keep that in mind." Kent turned and started to walk away. After a few steps, he stopped and turned to the lady...
"From the way you spoke, I have a feeling you are someone very important. So, although it is none of my business, for everyone’s sake, please return home and never come back here ever again.
I don’t know why you came here, but like I said, it is none of my business. However, take my advice and leave before it is too late."
After saying that, Kent hastened his steps. As the distance between them widened, the gaze locked on him by Commander Agnes only seemed to intensify.
"It doesn’t matter anyway," Commander Agnes muttered. "Even if I return, so what. General Brinna needs the Soul Flame Fruit, so even if it is impossible, I must get it. I must try my-"
Before Commander Agnes could complete her sentence, Kent appeared before her with a smug smile,
"Uhm, I couldn’t help but overhear you say something in the lines of Soul Flame Fruit."

chapters.title: Chapter 968: Soul Flame Fruit
paragraphs: In the world of cultivation, any treasure that has to do with the soul is invaluable.
In fact, even a soul berry fruit is something that, if it were to appear in an auction house in a high world, a great bidding war would occur.
However, even such a fruit pales in comparison to a Soul Flame Fruit. In fact, comparing the two is a grave insult that can cause one to lose their head.
That is how valuable a Soul Flame Fruit is.

When it comes to its use, consider a normal soul flame for a moment. If one were to consume a Soul Flame Fruit, then, depending on how old the fruit is, they can gain something like a rank up on their soul flame, aspect unlock, strengthening, mutation, transformation, and many more.
If one doesn’t have a soul flame, they will naturally awaken one.

Away from that, if the Soul Flame Fruit is 10,000 years plus, then even if your flame resistance is at the Perfect stage, it will rank up by one stage and even gain either a flame defence or offence skill.
That is Perfect Flame Resistance up to Transcendent Flame Resistance.
It has many uses to the point that if a Soul Flame Fruit reaches 100,000 years, its name changes to Dao Flame Fruit.
Legend has it that a Soul Flame Fruit is blessed by the Flame Dao, and as such, it is a must-have treasure.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
However, in Kent’s case, he needed one for his Flame Core. Agni told him the names of many treasures that can aid in forming a Flame Core. The top of the list has the likes of the Soul Flame Fruit.
So Kent, who was planning to head deeper into the outer region and hopefully make it into the inner region, had to change his mind when his Soul Map helped him pick up Commander Agnes’s words.

"Don’t get me wrong. I don’t care what you think of me, provided you don’t call me a pervert. However, if you have to call me a pervert just so you can tell me the location of the Soul Flame Fruit, then I wouldn’t mind.
However, bear in mind that based on your information, two things can happen," Kent said, raising one finger.
"First, I will either turn around and leave, making sure not even my body aura is left behind."
He raised the second finger, making two fingers.
"Second, I will help you get the Soul Flame Fruit and even help you tame a Tier 19 beast. So what do you think, Commander Agnes?"
Commander Agnes narrowed her eyes at Kent. As to how he managed to overhear what she muttered, she wasn’t concerned about that.

However, just the fact that a mere Core Formation brat dares to claim he can help her get something Heavenly Ascension stage cultivators couldn’t and even help her tame a Tier 19 beast made her want to snap his neck.
However, remembering he had saved her, she calmed down.

Kent smirked and said, "I know what you are thinking." Kent laughed. "Just how can a mere Core Formation brat help me get what not even I and my team had no confidence in obtaining?" Kent just held a smile on his face.
"Perhaps, before you think that—if you haven’t already—remember the saying, don’t judge a book by its cover or the writings on it,"
Kent chuckled, recalling a lecturer of his back on Earth, adding the last bits to that quote.
Back then, he was the only one who laughed, which caused the lecturer to take a liking to him.
"Ask yourself, if I am that simple, then what the hell am I even doing here in the Flame Sea, and in the domain of the Scarlet Flame Serpent Monarch of all beasts?

The answer is simple, I am not a weakling, and unless my opponents numbered in the dozens, then even a Tier 19 beast is no opponent I would have to worry about," Kent exaggerated a bit, but it was necessary.
"That said, I have the means to help you get the Soul Flame Fruit. As it occurs, I also need one, so why don’t we work something out, Commander Agnes?"
The offer was enticing, and to be frank, Commander Agnes wanted to say yes. However, she didn’t know if she could trust Kent.
There was just something about his smile that kept freaking her out, and that alone was making her hesitate.
The location of the Soul Flame Fruit was something only she knew.

After all, the mission to come to the Flame Sea was to obtain it for one of the three generals of Planet Nictus, who was poisoned using a soul-type poison after a clash with one of the generals of the Planet King.
If she died, then the days for Planet Nictus falling under the Planet King authority would be numbered. So this mission was extremely important to her.

"Having trust issues, huh?" Kent said, sitting on a nearby stone. "I can just tell you three reasons to trust me. However, since we both are in a hurry, how about I tell you just one, Commander Agnes, or do you prefer I call you Princess Autumn?"
Commander Agnes’s body shuddered, hearing Kent call her by a name nobody, not even her most trusted subordinate, knew.
In fact, on Planet Nictus, only the King, Queen, the three Princesses, the two Princes, and the Royal Pill Monarch knew that Commander Agnes’s true identity was actually Princess Autumn.
However, out of nowhere, a random person she had met in her time of need just exposed her secret—and in a casual way too.
Looking at the relaxed look in Kent’s eyes, she couldn’t help but wonder if she should just kill him and be done with it, or play along and capture him later for interrogation.
"Killing me is impossible, and catching me is even worse than impossible," Kent said with a smile. "And no, I am not reading your mind. I can read all you are thinking on your faces.

And hey, a word of advice. The next time you disguise yourself, don’t pick a pleasing and beautiful face. It makes it impossible to look away, and the more one looks at you, the closer they get to discovering your deepest, darkest secrets.
That said, I know the real you, so if you have any doubt, know that I can break my talisman now and go spread your secret to everyone.
However, that won’t get me closer to killing the Planet King. The Soul Flame Fruit, however, will do. So perhaps we should focus on that instead."
The saying, ’being intelligent is how you use your intelligence and not how your intelligence uses you,’ is what could be used to describe Kent at the moment.

With just one glimpse into the lady’s profile, Kent was able to weave a complex web of subtle manipulation that, as Commander Agnes continued to digest his words, would lead her to raise numerous questions, ultimately culminating in a single conclusion: their shared enemy, the Planet King.
She will then come to the following conclusions.
If she managed to get the Soul Flame Fruit, General Brilla, who held the key to defeating the Planet King, would be saved.
Then again, if Kent managed to help her get the Soul Flame Fruit, then it meant Kent was indeed no simple person, and as such, she would be able to pull him to her side.
Again, he might just be able to gain a Tier 19 (Heavenly Ascension) stage beast as her mount.
Without Commander Agnes knowing it, she had fallen into Kent’s scheme. Looking at the smile on his face now, one could perhaps say that the mind is the strongest weapon a person can ever wield.
