"First, I will either turn around and leave, making sure not even my body aura is left behind."
He raised the second finger, making two fingers.
"Second, I will help you get the Soul Flame Fruit and even help you tame a Tier 19 beast.
So what do you think, Commander Agnes?"
Commander Agnes narrowed her eyes at Kent.
As to how he managed to overhear what she muttered, she wasn’t concerned about that.

However, just the fact that a mere Core Formation brat dares to claim he can help her get something Heavenly Ascension stage cultivators couldn’t and even help her tame a Tier 19 beast made her want to snap his neck.
However, remembering he had saved her, she calmed down.
Kent smirked and said, "I know what you are thinking." Kent laughed.
"Just how can a mere Core Formation brat help me get what not even I and my team had no confidence in obtaining?" Kent just held a smile on his face.
"Perhaps, before you think that—if you haven’t already—remember the saying, don’t judge a book by its cover or the writings on it,"
Kent chuckled, recalling a lecturer of his back on Earth, adding the last bits to that quote.
Back then, he was the only one who laughed, which caused the lecturer to take a liking to him.
"Ask yourself, if I am that simple, then what the hell am I even doing here in the Flame Sea, and in the domain of the Scarlet Flame Serpent Monarch of all beasts?

The answer is simple, I am not a weakling, and unless my opponents numbered in the dozens, then even a Tier 19 beast is no opponent I would have to worry about," Kent exaggerated a bit, but it was necessary.
"That said, I have the means to help you get the Soul Flame Fruit.
As it occurs, I also need one, so why don’t we work something out, Commander Agnes?"
The offer was enticing, and to be frank, Commander Agnes wanted to say yes.
However, she didn’t know if she could trust Kent.
There was just something about his smile that kept freaking her out, and that alone was making her hesitate.
The location of the Soul Flame Fruit was something only she knew.

After all, the mission to come to the Flame Sea was to obtain it for one of the three generals of Planet Nictus, who was poisoned using a soul-type poison after a clash with one of the generals of the Planet King.
If she died, then the days for Planet Nictus falling under the Planet King authority would be numbered.
So this mission was extremely important to her.
"Having trust issues, huh?" Kent said, sitting on a nearby stone.
"I can just tell you three reasons to trust me.
However, since we both are in a hurry, how about I tell you just one, Commander Agnes, or do you prefer I call you Princess Autumn?"
Commander Agnes’s body shuddered, hearing Kent call her by a name nobody, not even her most trusted subordinate, knew.
In fact, on Planet Nictus, only the King, Queen, the three Princesses, the two Princes, and the Royal Pill Monarch knew that Commander Agnes’s true identity was actually Princess Autumn.
However, out of nowhere, a random person she had met in her time of need just exposed her secret—and in a casual way too.
Looking at the relaxed look in Kent’s eyes, she couldn’t help but wonder if she should just kill him and be done with it, or play along and capture him later for interrogation.
"Killing me is impossible, and catching me is even worse than impossible," Kent said with a smile.
"And no, I am not reading your mind.
I can read all you are thinking on your faces.
And hey, a word of advice.
The next time you disguise yourself, don’t pick a pleasing and beautiful face.
It makes it impossible to look away, and the more one looks at you, the closer they get to discovering your deepest, darkest secrets.
That said, I know the real you, so if you have any doubt, know that I can break my talisman now and go spread your secret to everyone.
However, that won’t get me closer to killing the Planet King.
The Soul Flame Fruit, however, will do.
So perhaps we should focus on that instead."
The saying, ’being intelligent is how you use your intelligence and not how your intelligence uses you,’ is what could be used to describe Kent at the moment.

With just one glimpse into the lady’s profile, Kent was able to weave a complex web of subtle manipulation that, as Commander Agnes continued to digest his words, would lead her to raise numerous questions, ultimately culminating in a single conclusion: their shared enemy, the Planet King.
She will then come to the following conclusions.
If she managed to get the Soul Flame Fruit, General Brilla, who held the key to defeating the Planet King, would be saved.
Then again, if Kent managed to help her get the Soul Flame Fruit, then it meant Kent was indeed no simple person, and as such, she would be able to pull him to her side.
Again, he might just be able to gain a Tier 19 (Heavenly Ascension) stage beast as her mount.
Without Commander Agnes knowing it, she had fallen into Kent’s scheme.
Looking at the smile on his face now, one could perhaps say that the mind is the strongest weapon a person can ever wield.

chapters.title: Chapter 969: Location of the Soul Flame Fruit
paragraphs: In the end, Commander Agnes decided to trust Kent, with some reservations, of course.
She first retrieved an item from her space ring and presented it to Kent.
"This is a Blood Oath stone," Commander Agnes said. "Before we continue, you must sign a blood contract that you will not betray me after sharing what I know with you.
Also, in the event that we manage to retrieve the Soul Flame Fruit, you must keep my true identity a secret and also help me tame a Tier 19 beast like you promised.
Should something happen and this alliance can’t continue, we will go our separate ways, and this oath will be void.
However, if you go against your words, then you will die an agonising death, one that you don’t wish to experience."
"Wow, we haven’t known each other for long, and you are already pulling out a marriage contract," Kent joked, looking at the Blood Oath stone in Commander Agnes’s hands.
"I have to applaud how meticulous you are. However, how do I know you wouldn’t betray me?" Kent asked.
"Take the stone and state your claim. Once we get everything in order, we can then sign the oath." Commander Agnes handed the stone to Kent, who received it with a raised brow.
He could sense the power coming from the stone, and even though he knew he wouldn’t go against his words, the power he felt told him to be careful.
This is also the reason why he decided to make sure the lady doesn’t hold one over him.

"Should the case we manage to get the Soul Flame Fruits, however many we get, they will be shared equally among us. Also, if we get only one, I will hold on to it and deliberate who gets to have it once we leave this place.
Of course, if I were to steal it, the oath should claim my life. Also, if you were to plot against me after we leave here, the oath should destroy the fruit."
Commander Agnes raised her brow, hearing how precise Kent was in stating his claim.
If he were betrayed, the only thing that would make him a target is the fruit, so Kent wanted it destroyed, and both parties would lose what they were after.
"Lastly, if things go sideways, we both should take the loss and go our separate ways.
Whoever breaks this oath, if not killed by the Blood Oath, may the wrath of the goddess of hatred and resentment descend on them."

This time, Commander Agnes’s expression changed. She could sense how serious Kent was, and thus she couldn’t help but wonder just what kind of existence he was to have the audacity to invoke the wrath of a god.
If only she knew somewhere in the heavens, a pair of eyes looked down on Planet Cosima, and for a moment, an amused expression appeared in the eyes of this person.

However, a minute later, a mind-numbing confusion struck, and this goddess, who had always been bored and angry at everything, started to take notice of a handsome purple-haired brat who held a smug smile on his face.
’I wonder if Vexthra will remember today.’ Kent coughed, masking his laughter. ’I will ask her when I go back to the future.’
"So, are you ready to sign the oath?" Kent asked, and Commander Agnes nodded.

They both put their blood on the stone, and it glowed red for a few seconds before returning to normal. Then it dispersed and divided into two red dust particles, entering both Kent and Commander Agnes’s foreheads.
"Before we start, should I continue calling you Commander Agnes, or should I use Princess Autumn?" Kent asked.𝒻𝑟𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝑛𝘰𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝘤𝘰𝘮
"Commander Agnes will do. And please, don’t tell anyone my identity even after this alliance ends."
"Alright." Kent didn’t have to be told to know that some secrets are meant to be kept quiet. "On that note, why don’t you tell me what you know about this Soul Flame Fruit?"

"120 years ago, before his world was taken over by the planet king, a general from Planet Veylun found a map when he was adventuring in the inner region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley, in a part called Hydra Chasms.
On the map, he discovered that in the innermost part of the Hydra Chasms, a Soul Flame tree could be found.
According to what I know, he attempted to venture deeper into the region. However, after numerous battles and losing half his team, he saw the Soul Flame tree.
However, before he and his team could get close, they were attacked by the overlord of the Hydra Chasms.
According to his records, a three-headed serpent resides there, whose attack power is so formidable that even Peak Heavenly Ascension stage warriors cannot handle it.

In the end, only he managed to make it out, but he couldn’t make it out of this place. When he met a general from Planet Nictus, who happened to be the strongest on Planet Nictus, he entrusted all he knew to her before he passed away.
We have tried many times to get fruit from that tree, but all have ended in failure.
This is our last mission; however, before we could even get anywhere, my team and I were ambushed, and at the moment, aside from me, only one of us made it out."
"I see. Then all we have to do is go to the Hydra Chasms, kill a three-headed serpent, pluck a few fruits from a tree, and be on our way."
Kent smiled. "Seems easy enough."
Commander Agnes looked at Kent’s smug expression, and a look of annoyance flashed across her face.
However, before she could say anything, Kent pointed behind her, and a sword flashed out of nowhere and flew past her head, drawing a hole through the head of a beast that was sneaking up on them.
Commander Agnes jumped up in fright. She had no idea a beast was sneaking up on her, and had it not been for Kent, by the time she had found out, things would have ended badly for her.
However, looking at the dead beast now, she sighed in relief and turned to Kent.
"Thank you," she said.
However, as if struck by a meteor, it struck her. She turned and looked at the dead beast.

’Although it was just a Spirit Sovereign stage beast, it was still far from what could be killed with just one attack. However, even if it could be achieved with a one-shot kill, a Core Formation cultivator had no business doing that.’
She turned away from the beast and looked to Kent with a shocked expression.
Kent smiled and repeated the words he said. "Like I said, we just have to go to this Hydra Chasm, kill a three-headed serpent, pluck a few fruits from a tree, and be on our way."

Although Kent wasn’t flaring his aura at the moment, the aura he had around him as he stood on the stone, his purple aura flowing in the air, and a beautiful smile on his face made him appear like an immortal.
Commander Agnes looked at his posture and swallowed.
At the moment, even though Kent was merely a Core Formation stage warrior, she felt that standing behind him was the safest she could ever be.
’If he can casually kill a Tier 17 beast, then killing a Tier 18 and even a Tier 19 is not impossible.’

chapters.title: Chapter 970: Commander Agnes’s Motivation
paragraphs: "A question," Kent said, walking toward Commander Agnes, "How do you plan to survive the heat in the Inner region of this valley?"
"I have perfect flame resistance, so I will be fine. However, even if the heat is beyond me, I also have a Tier 14 flame resistance pill that lasts for days."

"I see. In any case, we can’t go directly to our target yet. We need to prepare—well, I need to prepare—so we first head deeper into the Inner region, then twenty days from now, we focus on the Soul Flame Fruit."
Commander Agnes couldn’t argue, considering she would be depending on Kent, who she still couldn’t believe was a mere Core Formation stage cultivator.
She tried probing him, but all she discovered was Kent’s clean and cut Core formation stage cultivation base.
"Whatever you say. In any case, I have been in this place for a month already, so waiting twenty more days isn’t too much of an ask."
"I like insightful people. They are easy to work with," Kent smiled. "We can leave now."
Shortly after, they left and started heading deeper into the Outer region, heading closer to the Inner region.
Kent struck up a conversation after they had moved a couple of kilometres. "So why would a Princess wish to become an Army Commander?
Many ladies out there wish to be born into royal families where they will be pampered and looked after by thousands of maids and guards.
I mean, who wouldn’t want that? However, here you are, risking your life in the most dreadful place I have ever been, and trust me, I have been to quite a select few dreadful places.
Why don’t you quench my curiosity by telling me the reason behind your decision to become a warrior instead of a pampered Princess?"
Commander Agnes turned and looked at Kent, unsure if she should open up to him or not. Still, even after the blood oath, she was finding it difficult to trust Kent.
’There is just something about his smile that keeps freaking me out. Perhaps this is fear, but since he is merely a Core Formation cultivator, my body interprets it as him freaking me out.
However, opening up to him is not an easy thing to do. I know nothing about him, and telling him my deepest, darkest secret is something I can’t do so easily.
However, if I don’t tell him anything, he might think I don’t trust him. The last thing I want now is to lose his assistance when he is the only hope I have left.’
Kent kept quiet, pretending not to care whether she told him about her decision to become a warrior or not. He made it appear as if he wasn’t interested, but deep down, he wanted to know.
His Enchanted Eyes, which had mutated to become Heavenly Jade Eyes, could see some things, but not all.
So to know such a thing, this time, Kent knew he had to be human and ask. So he did, but the question was much heavier than anticipated.
Commander Agnes wrestled with her emotions for a couple of minutes before choosing to say something. Not everything, but something to at least quench Kent’s thirst.
"I chose to become a warrior because of my mother," she began. "When I was 18, she died protecting me from bandits while on a trip to Planet Zephyros to attend a Pill conference.
My mom was an Alchemist, a good one, but she was no warrior. However, when it came to it, she fought, and even while outnumbered, she gave her life in exchange for me.
I survived because she was brave. From then on, I chose to become brave. I refused to remain a pampered Princess who sits and lets maids and guards do everything for her.
I decided to become a warrior who fights and protects the weak.
So here I am, doing what I signed up for."
Kent nodded. "I see. For what it’s worth, I think you are a better warrior than you would have been a pampered Princess."
Commander Agnes smiled slightly, knowing Kent was merely trying to make her feel better. Even so, she couldn’t help feeling proud of herself.
"She will be proud of you," Kent suddenly added. "Choosing to fight for the weak and innocent is something only the brave can do.
So every minute of the day, whenever you pull your bowstring and shoot an arrow, know that she is always with you and will forever be with you."
Commander Agnes nodded.
Kent smiled weakly as his mind moved back to his life on Earth. Back then, he was ready to give up on life because he couldn’t understand why his life had turned out the way it had.

He was born a handsome man with a big ass dick, but fate deprived him of feeling pleasure or using his majestic asset. That was a low blow to his ego as man, and for years, he felt the need to end it all.
However, his mom stood by him, and until she breathed her last breath, she made sure he always knew she was there for him.
Perhaps, because of her, after she died, Kent chose to keep moving forward regardless of the unfortunate situation he had been thrust into since birth.
So, hearing Commander Agnes had made a decision to face danger instead of living a peaceful life, all because of her mother, he felt some respect for her.
’Mothers are the best,’ Kent said inwardly.
The rest of the journey was in silence, but even so, the two felt like they had connected on some level, allowing the sceptical Commander Agnes to finally start to trust Kent.
[Meanwhile, Inner Region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley - Venomous Gorges]
Inside the Inner region of Serpent’s Coil Valley, in a domain called Venomous Gorges, nestled between two mountains, the domain of the Flame Cobra King Zorath could be found.
He is a dark-skinned man with a cobra tattoo spiralling his torso.
He has long, black hair that is streaked with red, and eyes that seem to contain the flames in his surroundings, glowing with an ember-like intensity.
If a Heavenly Ascension stage warrior from Planet Nictus sees him, they will run with their tails coiled between their legs.
However, such a powerful being stood respectfully before two Nagas, each a danger that he wouldn’t dare provoke.
"How can I be of help today, ladies?" Zeroth, the Flame Cobra King, asked, maintaining a polite smile.
Although all three of them were Tier 19 beasts, Zeroth had only broken 22 limits, unlike the two Nagas, who had already broken their 25th.
In terms of danger, Zeroth pales in comparison to them. So, as a beast with intelligence (Spirit Beast), he knew he had to be polite if he wanted to keep his head.
Niraya, one of the Nagas, spoke. "The Monarch sensed something strange within this area, and she sent us to come and investigate.
Deploy your men to search for anything out of place. If they find anything and they can capture it, they should bring it to us. Otherwise, they should alert us.
We will be heading to the Iskar and Rahven domains next. Remember, this is a direct order from the Monarch, so failure is not an option."
"Rest assured, ladies, I will get right on it," Zeroth answered, and the ladies nodded.
"We expect good news, Zeroth."
They left the next second, finally allowing Zeroth the room to breathe.
"They keep getting scarier every time you meet them," Zeroth sighed and sat down. Later, he issued a command and deployed thousands of beasts under his command to start looking for the unknown.
Two days later, Kent and Commander Agnes entered Zeroth’s domain, unsure what awaited them.

However, such a powerful being stood respectfully before two Nagas, each a danger that he wouldn’t dare provoke.
"How can I be of help today, ladies?" Zeroth, the Flame Cobra King, asked, maintaining a polite smile.
Although all three of them were Tier 19 beasts, Zeroth had only broken 22 limits, unlike the two Nagas, who had already broken their 25th.
In terms of danger, Zeroth pales in comparison to them.
So, as a beast with intelligence (Spirit Beast), he knew he had to be polite if he wanted to keep his head.
Niraya, one of the Nagas, spoke.
"The Monarch sensed something strange within this area, and she sent us to come and investigate.
Deploy your men to search for anything out of place.
If they find anything and they can capture it, they should bring it to us.
Otherwise, they should alert us.
We will be heading to the Iskar and Rahven domains next.
Remember, this is a direct order from the Monarch, so failure is not an option."
"Rest assured, ladies, I will get right on it," Zeroth answered, and the ladies nodded.
"We expect good news, Zeroth."
They left the next second, finally allowing Zeroth the room to breathe.
"They keep getting scarier every time you meet them," Zeroth sighed and sat down.
Later, he issued a command and deployed thousands of beasts under his command to start looking for the unknown.
Two days later, Kent and Commander Agnes entered Zeroth’s domain, unsure what awaited them.

chapters.title: Chapter 971: The Fourth Floor - Church Of Destruction (5)
paragraphs: Vexthra was seated on a stone in the outskirts of Yilo Village.

It is the village she and her team saved from the Church of Destruction. Although they haven’t yet cleared the 4th floor of the planet Killer Dungeon, they managed to save a village of 2000 inhabitants.
After Lani and Elyndra left to go track down the location of the Church of Destruction, they decided to ensure the villagers were okay.
Vexthra later left to have some fresh air after handling what had to be handled.
At the moment, she was seated, looking up at the stars in the sky. None of her sisters was around her.
Of course, they aren’t too far away.
Suddenly, a smile appeared on her face, which quickly turned into a chuckle.
"So that’s how far back you have travelled, huh?" The image of Kent appeared in her mind, brightening her smile.
"What a troublemaker," Vexthra chuckled, "To think you will mess with me 370,000 years before meeting you. I need to punish him when he gets back."
"Punish who?" Unity asked, walking toward Vexthra. The rest of her sisters, except Lani, who is still not yet back, walked toward their big sister.
Vexthra looked at her sisters and smiled lovingly, "Who else would I punish if not that troublemaker of ours?"
"Kent..." The ladies laughed.
They knew that if someone had the power to frustrate Vexthra, then it would only be Kent. He has his way of making even a goddess feel helpless.
"What has he done?" Vari asked, sitting beside Vexthra. The rest of her sisters also sat down around their big sister.
"Well, he had travelled back to the past and, as usual, was causing trouble there."
The ladies furrowed their brows, hearing something so ridiculous, yet they knew it was true. "How was he able to travel to the past? And how far back did he go?" Ingrid asked, feeling intrigued.
"I don’t know how he managed to go to the past, but I know he is 370,000 years in the past. I know this because he used my name to form an oath with someone."
"Who is this person? Is she a woman? Is she beautiful? Compared to Alina, who has a bigger butt," Selene asked, already thinking stuff none of her sisters would even think of.
All they could do was stare at the Sword Saintess, who held a smug smile on her face. Even Vexthra couldn’t help looking at her with an amused expression.
"She is a female princess who disguised herself to become a commander of an army. Kent saved her life, and in order to help each other obtain a treasure, they formed a blood oath.
However, the sneaky Kent knows I will remember that day today. And what better way to play a prank on me than to invoke my divinity 370,000 years before I met him and became his woman.
Back then, I was surprised that a mere mortal dared to use my name for something so trivial. However, while I should have taught him a lesson, I became rather intrigued by his boldness."
"What is he doing there?" Mara asked.
"I only looked at his life for a few months, but all I saw made me wonder just what kind of monster he is. I mean, the location he is at the moment is no place for a Core Formation stage cultivator."
"Is he in trouble?" Unity asked.
"No. I think he is fine. It’s been a long time, and I haven’t placed much focus on him, but from what I saw back then, I think wherever he is now, he will be fine."
Vexthra giggled, "However, you ladies should be prepared for some serious competitions in the future."
The ladies looked at their big sister and wondered just what she was hinting at. Selene, being the spoiled one, was able to read what Vexthra said, making her smile from ear to ear.
"I wonder how many sisters he will be adding to this harem."
Her sisters picked up on her words, making them also wonder the same thing. "But why would they be our competition, big sister?" Nara asked, and Vexthra giggled.

"Just that 370,000 years is a long time. If they hadn’t reached the God stage, then they certainly will be at the Immortal stage, and let me tell you, ladies, once you reach the Immortal stage, just a few hours of sex with Kent will not be enough.
You will need to go for days, sometimes weeks, or even months.
But that isn’t the serious part. You see, once you reach the Immortal stage, as a lady, your yin essence becomes immortal energy for your man, and his yang essence becomes immortal energy for you.
So tell me, who do you think will get the most priority to have sex with Kent? You, the Spirit Kings and Lords, or the Immortal Kings and Lords?"

Vexthra laughed, "Even you ladies, thanks to how much you love Kent, will push him to spend more time with them, so that he will become strong. Once that happens, the time he will be spending with you ladies will be limited."
Vexthra continued to smile, looking at the frown on the faces of her sisters.
Although she exaggerated a bit, from what she knew, Kent would have his hands full in the future simply because of the choices he had made in the past.
"I say we will cross the bridge when we get there. However, knowing we will be having immortal sisters makes me feel safe." Selene laughed, "No offence, big sister."
Vexthra smirked, "No need to apologise, Selene. I am a god; naturally, messing with events in high or immortal worlds is beneath me.
However, if having immortal sisters makes you safe, then I am happy too. I mean, we all want what is best for Kent, so being safe is what we should focus on."
The ladies nodded.
They had already made plans on what to do when they ascended. Most of those plans involved them growing much stronger than they are now, so they can protect their man when it comes down to it.
"If we were to get immortal sisters, then clearing this dungeon will be much faster," Elsa also added a reason why having immortal sisters would be best.
In the end, Vexthra only smiled and looked forward to the day they would reach immortal worlds and meet their sisters they couldn’t wait to meet.
The ladies continued to ask their sister more questions about what Kent was doing in the past.
Vexthra knew she couldn’t say everything she saw, but being experienced as she was, she managed to tell them something that left them happy.
As to how Kent managed to get to the past, she didn’t even want to know.
Her only concern now was that nothing bad seemed to be happening to the timelines, considering everything Kent was doing in the past was significant enough to alter the future.
’It’s like history has been written already, and whatever he was doing was merely playing a role.’ She said inwardly.
’If that is the case, then does it mean Kent can do anything he wants and it will fit perfectly into history?’ This thought prompted her to ponder something personal to her...
’If he can do that, then can he go back and prevent—" Vexthra paused her words when a voice suddenly entered her mind.
’Don’t, Vexthra. The past is the past, we can’t get it back, so the best we can do is focus on the present and hope for a better future.’
Vexthra nodded and wiped the thought from her mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 972: Inner Region
paragraphs: [Inner Region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley - Kent and Commander Agnes’s POV]
Without knowing a manhunt had been issued for his head, Kent and Commander Agnes arrived in the Inner region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley, in a place called Venomous Gorges.
The main reason for coming was for Kent to utilise the superior flame essence there to form his flame veins much faster.
He still had quite a few Flame Veins to form after the initial 8500.

Commander Agnes knew this was just a temporary stop, so she said nothing and continued to follow Kent. Thankfully, because Kent could see quite a large distance around, they were able to enter the Inner region without any battle.
"We will be staying here for at least 20 days," Kent said, seated in a lotus posture. "The moment we leave here, we will head straight for the location of the Soul Flame Fruit."
Commander Agnes nodded.
Kent said nothing again and sat with his eyes closed, forming flame veins much faster now.
Of course, the reason was that he had now arrived at a place where the flame essence was much denser and more potent. The more powerful the flame essence, the faster the formation of the flame veins.
Provided his body could handle the heat, then forming his flame veins wasn’t a problem.
The second reason was that the more flame veins he formed, the faster he could absorb the flame essence, increasing the speed at which he formed the flame veins.𝒻𝑟𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝑛𝘰𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝘤𝘰𝘮
’It had only been a day, but I have already formed 2500 flame veins, which is much faster than back in the Outer region,’ Kent said inwardly, a smile playing on his lips.
However, he couldn’t help frowning about something.
’Since the moment we entered this region, I couldn’t help but notice the beasts within a 30,000km radius are moving with a purpose in mind.

It is almost as if they are searching for something or somebody.’ Kent deduced that, knowing the next couple of days, if they maintained the same strange behaviour, he would figure out why before taking any action.
’Although most are Tier 18 Beasts, there are thousands of them, and even if I am a monster, handling a couple of hundreds would be a headache, let alone thousands. I must handle this with care.’
Three days later, Kent took a bold step.

"Commander Agnes, since we are now allies, I will trust you with a secret of mine," Kent said before using the Map Share to share the Soul Map with Commander Agnes, whose eyes widened the next second.

Kent was using the 80,000km wide view of the Soul Map, focusing more on the Inner region. At the moment, thousands of beasts, mostly snake types, were in groups searching all over the Venomous Gorges, looking for something or someone.
However, what shocked Commander Agnes was the fact that she could now see a vast distance around them.
She kept wondering just how Kent managed to lead her into the Inner region without meeting even a single beast.
Initially, she pegged it as Kent being a good guide, allowing him to enter the Inner region without any hindrance.
However, now she could see the reason.
"No need to look shocked. People around me tend to forget the word insanity after a few days, so you might as well join the bandwagon and be free from shocks in the coming days."
Kent smiled and then focused on the main reason why he shared the Soul Map with Commander Agnes.
"As you can see, there are thousands of beasts, each behaving in a peculiar way. If I am not mistaken, then they are searching for me."
"Why would they be searching for you?" Commander Agnes asked. She could indeed see the beasts, and she saw how they were moving about, but there was nothing to suggest they were looking for Kent.
"I really thought long and hard about it. However, aside from me using my Soul Flame to heal you, I have done nothing special to suggest this much scrutiny.

So, this can only mean one thing: the ruler of this domain of the Flame Sea sensed my precious Soul Flame, and they want it for themselves, or they sensed something extremely precious but don’t know what it is, so they sent their lackeys to search for anything out of place.
I know I would do the latter if I were in her place."
"Humour me, but how can one use Soul Flame to heal?" Commander Agnes asked. Throughout her many years of living, this was her first time hearing such a thing.
Kent smiled and shook his head. "I can’t tell you the main reason, mainly for your own safety. However, my Soul Flame can heal, and it was what I used to heal and bring you back from the dead.
That is the only reason anyone would become this frantic. However, do not panic, we will be getting the Soul Flame Fruit regardless of what is happening."

Commander Agnes nodded, unsure if this was something she could handle. Facing just 4 Tier 18 beasts was already enough to cost her team. Seeing thousands of them, with even a few Tier 19s, didn’t inspire confidence.
"No need to look down, young lady. Although I can’t kill thousands of them, rest assured, we will be getting what we came for, and in no time, you will return home with a smile on your face."
Commander Agnes looked at Kent long and hard before asking a question. "Are you really at the Core Formation, or have you disguised your true realm?"
Kent laughed. "Does it really matter? Ultimately, the question is whether we will obtain the Soul Flame Fruit or not. The rest can wait until we get what we came for."
Commander Agnes nodded.
Just like that, ten days had gone by since they arrived in the Inner region. Within these ten days, a great deal had happened to Kent, bringing him great joy.
⟪You have formed your 23,000th Flame Veins⟫
This was the message after ten days inside the Inner region of the Serpent’s Coil Valley.
’Agni said I can start forming the Flame Core after I create at least 20,000 Flame Veins. However, now that I have, why do I still feel like I’m lacking in the number of Flame Veins required?
Also, although I can sense the next step, which is Flame Core, I need more flame-rich treasures and a place with much denser flame essence before I can attempt forming a Flame Core.’
Kent stood up.
’This means I must hunt for Flame Cores, Flame Spirits, and even treasures having rich flame essence in them. If possible, even the Soul Flame Fruit would be required.’
Kent maintained a calm look on his face, though his mind was moving in overdrive.
’The only disadvantage we have now is fighting power. I may have become powerful, but I cannot fight my way to the Soul Flame Fruit.’
Kent looked at Commander Agnes and sighed inwardly.

’She can’t help much, meaning I will be doing most of the heavy lifting. However, this is the Inner region; killing just one beast will alert the ruler of this domain, according to what Lady Kami told me.
This means instead of killing, I must subdue them. However, if the Monarch were to appear, then escape will be futile.’
While Kent was thinking, ten Tier 18 beasts were making their way toward them, causing Commander Agnes to start to panic.
However, knowing the beasts can’t sense them unless they come within a 5,000 km distance made her calm down a bit.

chapters.title: Chapter 973: Optional Side Quest
paragraphs: "You will stay here and wait for me to clear a path," Kent said, walking out of a cave they had been in for the past ten days.
"Once I clear a path, I will use a skill to teleport you to my side. But for now, stay here."
"Are you sure?" Commander Agnes asked, a little puzzled. She sensed no malice from what Kent said, meaning he wouldn’t be abandoning her.
However, knowing he would be going deep into enemy territory, even though she couldn’t help him, made her feel concerned.
"Although I can’t kill Tier 18 or 19 beasts faster than you could, I can at least distract them."
Kent just smiled. "No need for that. I plan to investigate something in the inner part of this region and will return as soon as possible if what I find doesn’t inspire confidence.
But even so, provided I manage to locate what I am searching for, we will be heading to the location of the Soul Flame Fruit next."
Kent waved his hand, and ten Tier 14 Forsaken Soul Spirits appeared, causing the look on Commander Agnes’s face to change.
"It was you," she muttered. "You were the one who caused the explosion 15 days ago."
"Yeah. And please, this is one of my secrets, so be sure to keep it from slipping," Kent pointed at the Soul Spirits, not looking at the complicated look on Commander Agnes’s face.

After all, she lost almost her entire team because of an explosion from a Soul Spirit. Discovering that the one responsible was the same person she had formed an alliance with evoked complex emotions in her.
"These Soul Spirits will act as bombs to deter or destroy any beast that finds its way to you. Of course, if you don’t want to be located easily, then be sure to suppress your aura.
But don’t worry, I will be within the 80,000 km radius, so be assured I am nearby and will come to your aid at any moment."
Kent looked deep into the distance and vanished, appearing 5,000 km away.
One hundred meters away, a Tier 17 Ember Lion sensed Kent’s presence, lunging at him. Its movement was swift and precise. In no time, a massive claw appeared before Kent.
However, Kent held a smile on his face as flame essence moved through his flame veins, causing him to see the Ember Lion move like it had been slowed down.
Kent grabbed its claw and, with power surging through him, slammed it into the ground, creating cracks.
The Ember Lion was knocked out cold.
"Knocked out a Tier 17 beast just like that. Just what kind of monster is he?" Commander Agnes muttered, watching Kent through the soul map.
Kent, who heard her speak, smiled.
He looked at the massive body of the Ember Lion he had knocked out, and an idea popped into his mind.
’Looks like now might just be the best time to see what this Taming Bracelet can do,’ Kent touched the bracelet on his hand.
’According to the description, there are many ways to tame a beast. The first of the two ways I can use now has something to do with asking them to become my beast companion.
If they agree, I can add them. This method is the most effective since it yields the greatest benefit.
The second is to add their blood to the bracelet, which will then add them to my beast subordinates. It is less merciful and can sometimes cause the beasts to hate their master.
However, I can change that later after some form of trust has been built between us.’
Kent smiled, sensing that this method bore a resemblance to slavery. The only upside was that, regardless of the method used, both the master and the servant would earn significant benefits.
’Thankfully, there is the No Harm rule that prevents me from ordering my beast companions to do things outside their limits.
An example is ordering them to explode their bodies to save my skin. Of course, if they willingly want to do it, then fine, but I can’t order them.’
Kent smiled, knowing this was perfect for him. There were many benefits he and his beast companion would gain. In a way, the beast would be earning more than even the master.
So they can only be thankful if, after being knocked out, they wake up as surbodinates of the Chaos Dragon.
"In that case, why don’t a plant spy in the form of an Ember Lion?" Kent smiled and waved his hand, taking a drop of blood from the Ember Lion.
He made it fly and land on the bracelet. The moment the blood touched it, it glowed, and Kent sensed a powerful connection form between them.
At the same time, a message appeared before him.
⟪You have added your first Beast Companion: Ember Lion. Trust Level: 2%⟫
⟪The Following benefits have been triggered for the Ember Lion⟫
↠ Give it a name (200% permanent boost to all flame-type skills)
↠ Create a Living Space (+38% Trust Level Boost)
↠ Bestow a skill (200% permanent boost to Flame Resistance)
Note: These benefits will be bestowed on both the master and the servant. Also, the higher the trust level, the more benefits you will receive.
"Well, isn’t this great?" Kent smiled, gazing at the body of the beast he had tamed, which was sleeping soundly.
"The name is rather simple. From today onwards, you shall be known as Ember," Kent said, and he heard a ring in his mind telling him he had received the first benefit.
"As for the second, I just need to create a living space inside the Taming Bracelet for Ember." Kent closed his eyes and sent his consciousness into the bracelet.
He appeared in a large grassy land. He already knew how to enter the bracelet. However, just when he entered, he learned how to create a living space for his beasts.
"Hmm, looks like I only have 50 slots in here, meaning I can only add 50 beasts. However, once I reach the Spirit Ascension stage, more slots will be made available."
Kent didn’t waste time and created space using one slot. He received the second benefit.
"As for the third benefit, once Ember wakes up, I will get on that." Kent waved his hand, and the Lion vanished into the bracelet.
Commander Agnes’s expression was calm, but the shock she was going through was more than enough to tell that she was having a hard time processing what Kent was doing.
’He tamed a beast just like that. I mean, is that even how beast taming is done?’
Kent was looking at her through the soul map, so he knew she was having a hard time coming to terms with what she was looking at.
However, Kent didn’t have the time to focus on that.
Just when he sent Ember away, he received a new quest. This time, however, the quest was different...
⟪You have received a side quest⟫
⟪Side Quest: Sovereign Tamer⟫
↠ Using the Taming Bracelet, tame the Seven Monarchs, twenty-one Kings/Queens, and the 14 Guards.
↠ Tame seven other Beasts to max out the available slots in the Taming Bracelet.
⟪Rewards⟫
↠ 500,000 Limit Breaker Points
↠ Ascension Crystal (Beast Kingdom Immortal World)
↠ Supreme Beast Contract (10x)
[Do you want to accept this quest?]
↠ Y/N
’Well, there is nothing better than getting paid for something you intend to do in the first place.’ Kent smiled weakly.

chapters.title: Chapter 974: Kent made his Move
paragraphs: "With this quest, it seems I have to make some adjustments to my plans." Kent didn’t expect to receive a quest for something he planned on doing in the first place.
Of course, he wasn’t aiming to tame all seven Monarchs. In fact, he only planned to tame the various rulers of the inner regions. However, now he knew his plans had to change.
Naturally, this was a good change.
"However, this is also bad." Kent sat down as his body worked on forming more flame veins.

"If what Lady Kami said is true, then the Monarchs here are not going to easily bend the knee and accept becoming my subordinates. I am also sure they wouldn’t take kindly to threatening them, either.
This means things had to change by becoming something akin to a monarch myself"
The mere fact that he could use their blood to tame them was also good. However, seeing that they must first trust him before he could use them made him wonder if that was a good or a bad thing.
If he were to tame a Monarch, using him or her to intimidate and tame the other ones would be next to impossible.
After all, there must be some form of trust between them before he could command them. And commanding a monarch he tamed through intimidation is something impossible.
"I guess hating slavery has a price I must pay," Kent laughed.
Beast tamers aren’t required to have some form of trust between them and their beasts before they can command them.
In fact, the moment they formed the contract between them and their beasts, the beasts had no say in whatever they were commanded to do.
Kent could easily do that.
However, because he hated slavery, he didn’t want to use that method. However, now that he had been awarded a good way, the downsides were also staring him in the face.
"Being a good person is such a bad thing," Kent sighed and then teleported, appearing beside Commander Agnes.
"Change of plans," Kent said, "I will be hunting down the ruler of this region and make him tell me what the heck they want from me."
"But you didn’t know it was you they were looking for," Commander Agnes said, but Kent shook his head.

"It’s me. I have already read the memories of the beast I tamed. They are looking for something or perhaps someone. The order came down from the Monarch, so I believe the only thing they are after is my soul flame."
"But why that?" Although Kent chose not to tell her the main reason, she asked again.
"I will tell you after everything is done. That said, you have to stay here for now. Once I get my answer, I will come back for you. And don’t worry, I will really come back for you."
"Okay."
Surprisingly, Commander Agnes agreed without dragging her feet. This caught Kent off guard, but he played it off as if it were no big deal.
’Looks like she has accepted my reality.’
Kent walked toward her and pressed his index finger against her forehead. When he removed it, a crossbone tattoo appeared.

"I have given you temporary control over these ten soul spirits. In case you need help, order them to explode. Then, when you are free from danger but can’t stay here for long, you can wait for me back on the moon.
Of course, with the Blood Oath, I will not betray you, so just trust me. You can keep one of the soul spirits alive just to know I am still alive."
This time, Commander Agnes stood there for a few seconds before nodding.
After a few more seconds, tying up all loose ends, Kent left.
Commander Agnes entered the cave and restricted her energy to allow her to remain almost invisible to the beasts.
After Kent left, he started teleporting deeper into the inner region. The deeper he went, the more terrifying the beasts got.
Eventually, Kent chose to make his presence known. After all, he planned to gather Flame Cores and Essence Blood for his Flame Core Formation and Primal Body Tempering Art.
The moment he started killing, the ruler of the domain he was in would notice and come to him.
His first targets were a group of Ashcoil Pythons, five of them, each about 170 meters long.
The moment they saw Kent, all five of them attacked, spraying fire from their mouths. Kent waved his hand, and his flame resistance manifested into a shield around him.
The attacks landed on the shield, which held firm.
However, that wasn’t all.
The moment the fire attacks ended, one of the Ashcoil Pythons struck with its long tail, aiming for Kent’s neck.
Swing
The tail coming at Kent was separated from the main body, causing the Ashcoil Python to let out a painful roar.
However, Kent merely stood there as three swords hovered behind him. There was blood on one of the swords, showing it was the one he used to cut the tail off.
Naturally, as intelligent beasts, the other four Ashcoil Pythons moved back, distancing themselves from the one whose tail came off.
"No need to panic, death is just the start of a beautiful, as most used to say." The soul flag appeared, and then the space around them shook when Kent raised his finger and pointed up.
Five streaks of fire, almost like a meteor falling from space, appeared, causing thousands of beasts in the Venomous Gorges to look up.
Kent gestured down with a cold snort.
"Meteor shower."
The five lights moved, and the very ground shook violently.

The five Ashcoil Pythons felt their bodies frozen in place. Naturally, one wouldn’t see what was causing that, but someone with enhanced eyesight would see soul threads linking each python to a meteor.
So when they fell, they landed directly on the bodies of the snakes, killing them instantly.
Kent waved his hand, and five flame cores flew and entered his space ring.
He opened the Soul Map, so he knew he had called some attention to himself.
But that was what he wanted.
He knew that if the King of the Venomous Gorge didn’t appear, the beasts that would come would attack him, which would give him an excuse to kill.
But until then, growing stronger was now part of his plans.
He waved his hand, and flames surrounded the body of the five Ashcoil Pythons. In no time, the flames reduced their bodies to five drops of golden blood.
They flew and entered Kent’s Soul Universe.
Since the system storage was not accessible, Kent had decided to use the Soul Universe as his storage space for items like essence blood, which could easily be damaged if stored raw in space rings.
Kent smiled, "With this, forming my first Blood Gate and reaching a much higher level in Primal Body Tempering Art can easily be achieved."
Kent chose to advance deeper into the inner region. The more he killed, the stronger he became, so he might as well utilise this chance to grow stronger.
Five days went by in a flash.
Within these five days, Kent killed over 500 beasts, each ranging between Tier 17 and 18. He had only used the flying swords and the smaller meteors he had created as his weapons.
He didn’t bring his sword, so he can only use the flying swords.
However, while Kent had been on a winning streak over the past five days, having only met Tier 17 and 18 beasts, that streak ended today.
Naturally, facing him now, 24 beasts, three of which Kent knew he couldn’t underestimate.
"So you are the one the Monarch is looking for?" Zeroth, the Flame Cobra King, asked, his arms crossed over his chest.

chapters.title: Chapter 975: Out Of Place
paragraphs: Although Kent was surrounded by 24 Tier 19 (Heavenly Ascension) stage beasts, his focus was on Zeroth and the two Nagas.
They were the only ones he knew would pose a threat. Though the other 21 Tier 19 beasts could easily kill him, he knew that with his abilities, he would survive them.
However, the three were extremely dangerous.
’The smug-looking guy is Zeroth, the king of this place. He had already broken 23 limits on his body.’ Kent, note down the Zeroth profile that he managed to glean using his Heavenly Jade Eye.
’That is quite impressive for a beast,’ he added.
’Vexthra said the highest limit one can break while in a high world is 30. Breaking 23 while only 35,000 years old is impressive. He will make a fine addition to my Beast Legion.’

’However, these two Nagas are even more impressive. Twenty-five limits broken, no wonder this place is dangerous. Just one of them can kill all the Heavenly Ascension stage cultivators I came across so far.’
Zeroth smirked, watching Kent’s eyes move from him to the two Nagas.
"So you are the one the monarch is looking for," he asked, but Kent merely raised his brow.
"I don’t know what you meant. However, I do have a question for you," Kent responded, and Zeroth, who, in his eyes, Kent was already as good as dead, chose to indulge him.
"Ask away."
"You wouldn’t happen to know a thing or two about why these two ladies are staring at me like I have stolen their fish?"
The question caught Zeroth off guard.
However, before he could process it, a fireball flew toward Kent.
"Hey, I merely asked a question." A sword appeared in Kent’s hand, and with one quick slash, the fireball was cut in half.
However, he didn’t have a moment of rest since a flaming sabre appeared before his face. Kent was forced to move back, narrowly evading the attack.
10,000 flame veins were activated, filling his body with energy, evading another fireball, only for the second flaming sabre to appear before him again.
’Damn, they are fast.’
The two Nagas attacked Kent instantly, giving him no time to react. However, thanks to Kent’s reflexes, he managed to evade their first three attacks.
"Ladies, perhaps we can solve this amicably before things escalate," Kent said, but he was forced to jump high into the air just when the ground he stood on exploded.
"Bind him," Vashara, the Scarlet Flame Naga Warrior, shouted, and the Scarlet Flame Naga Priestess, Niraya, waved her staff, conjuring a net made of fire energy to trap Kent mid-air.
Thankfully, Kent was quick to react, summoning five swords. They flew and cut the net before it could get to him.
"Buddha’s Palm."
A large flaming palm appeared in the air, sending a dreadful feeling toward Niraya. However, just when Kent was about to attack with it, a spear shot through it, causing him to cough up blood.
He turned and looked down, meeting the smug gaze of Zeroth, whose spear flew back to him.
Kent didn’t even have time to glare at him when a flaming whip suddenly appeared from behind, crackling with hot and burning fire.
’Damn, looks like I need to get serious.’
Kent activated the rest of his flame veins, allowing all 23,700 to come to life.
"Flame Wheels."

Right when the two flame rings appeared around his foot, Kent felt time slow down. His speed surges, but even so, he can tell the Nagas and a few beasts around aren’t slowing down like the avatar of the immortal he killed.
’This is an eye-opener. I will never look down on anyone ever again’ Kent smirked, knowing he had been cocky lately.
"Although I can’t kill you three, mainly because I don’t want to, the rest aren’t safe from me." Kent moved, and a head flew into the air.
The moment Zeroth saw this, his expression changed.
"Venomous Gorge Formation."
The ground shook, and green toxic mist appeared. The ground began to turn watery in an instant.
However, that wasn’t all; just when the water appeared, it lit up with green flames, causing the surrounding flames to change colour.
"Ladies, I think we have to end this now. You already have your proof, so end this, or else I will be forced to kill him."
Kent was blinded for a second. However, his Heavenly Jade Eyes kicked in, freeing him from the toxic mist.
And with that advantage, Kent moved in for three more kills.
Vashara and Niraya, who could see clearly in the mist, saw that Kent wasn’t slowing down.
"Trap him," Vashara said, moving toward Kent. When she was 3 meters away, a shadow moved past her and whispered into his ear.
"Let’s talk after I kill them first."
Two heads fell down before she could even get close to Kent’s afterimage.
"Niraya, do it now."
"Flaming Prison."
Right when Kent severed the head of another beast, the ground exploded where he stood, and bones rose from the ground, trapping him in.
"Flame Chains... Bind him." Chains burst from the ground and latched onto Kent’s arm.
"Die for me!"
Zeroth shouted, jumping up into the air, his spear aimed at Kent.
"Stop, Zeroth," Vashara shouted; however, losing 8 Tier 19 subordinates just like that had enraged the Flame Cobra King, so he didn’t obey her command.
"Die!"
He threw his spear, which streaked forward like a shooting star and stabbed through Kent’s chest.
"No!" Niraya shouted, deactivating the flame prison.
She rushed to Kent’s side to check if he was indeed dead. They had orders to bring him in alive.
However, just when she was getting close, Vashara appeared and grabbed her just when Kent’s body exploded.
"Nice save, lady." Kent’s voice appeared 2 meters behind one of Zeroth’s subordinates. He swung his sword, taking its head off.
Although it was a mere flying sword, in Kent’s hands, it claimed the lives of nine beasts.
Zeroth’s face turned red as he transformed into his 400-meter-long cobra form. He moved and appeared before Kent. However, Kent teleported and appeared atop Zeroth’s head.
"Down." He stomped on his head, sending him crashing down.
"Stay down," Kent commanded, but the next second, a giant flame spear appeared alongside two flaming sabres.
Both Vashara and Niraya attacked. However, Kent evaded the spear and used his sword to block the sabre attacks.
He stomped on the ground, and doom shards burst out, lunging at the two Nagas.
"Die!"
Zeroth’s voice appeared again as the green mist was sucked by the Cobra King, which he then transformed into a large spear.
When the spear was aimed at Kent, he felt his body freeze in place. However, he willed himself to move.
However, right when he moved, a rope made of fire latched onto his leg.
One of Zeroth’s subordinates, still alive, came to their king’s aid.
"Zeroth, don’t. If you kill him, the Monarch will have your head."
Zeroth paused and turned to Vashara and Niraya and then spoke in a cold and angry tone, "We don’t know if he is the one or not."𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝐰𝚎𝕓𝐧𝚘𝘃𝗲𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝕞
"He is the one," Niraya replied. "He had already proven he is the one by killing nine Tier 19 beasts."

"We don’t know that." The green spear shot from Zeroth’s mouth and flashed toward Kent. The flame rope was holding him in place, so all he could do was defend against the spear he knew had the means to kill him.
’What a headache. Even with this many flame veins, I still can’t handle two dozen Tier 19 beasts.’ Kent smiled and then chose to become even more serious.
"Killing me is not that easy, bug."
Kent’s pupils shifted to golden red, and then his claws appeared, catching the green spear effortlessly.
’But then with my bloodline, I am unstoppable.’
Kent transformed into his demi-dragon form and then roared, shaking the hearts of the beasts.

They were the only ones he knew would pose a threat.
Though the other 21 Tier 19 beasts could easily kill him, he knew that with his abilities, he would survive them.
However, the three were extremely dangerous.
’The smug-looking guy is Zeroth, the king of this place.
He had already broken 23 limits on his body.’ Kent, note down the Zeroth profile that he managed to glean using his Heavenly Jade Eye.
’That is quite impressive for a beast,’ he added.
’Vexthra said the highest limit one can break while in a high world is 30.
Breaking 23 while only 35,000 years old is impressive.
He will make a fine addition to my Beast Legion.’
’However, these two Nagas are even more impressive.
Twenty-five limits broken, no wonder this place is dangerous.
Just one of them can kill all the Heavenly Ascension stage cultivators I came across so far.’
Zeroth smirked, watching Kent’s eyes move from him to the two Nagas.

However, I do have a question for you," Kent responded, and Zeroth, who, in his eyes, Kent was already as good as dead, chose to indulge him.
"Ask away."
"You wouldn’t happen to know a thing or two about why these two ladies are staring at me like I have stolen their fish?"
The question caught Zeroth off guard.
However, before he could process it, a fireball flew toward Kent.

’Damn, they are fast.’
The two Nagas attacked Kent instantly, giving him no time to react.

Kent activated the rest of his flame veins, allowing all 23,700 to come to life.

"Venomous Gorge Formation."
The ground shook, and green toxic mist appeared.

Two heads fell down before she could even get close to Kent’s afterimage.
"Niraya, do it now."

Right when Kent severed the head of another beast, the ground exploded where he stood, and bones rose from the ground, trapping him in.
"Flame Chains...
Bind him." Chains burst from the ground and latched onto Kent’s arm.

chapters.title: Chapter 976: Bloodline Suppression
paragraphs: Perhaps, because Kent hadn’t faced this many odds before, he seemed to have underestimated his opponents.

However, now, after using all 23,700 flame veins, yet he was having a hard time resisting the onslaught from the Tier 19 beasts, he recognised that perhaps he shouldn’t look down on Supreme High worlds... yet.
Kent always knew that when it comes to cultivation, there is always someone better.
He might be able to suppress everyone using just his flame veins. However, there may come someone he cannot easily suppress.
Of course, if he were to form a Blood Core gate, Flame Core, and other things, he could suppress that person, too.
But yet again, a time might come when yet another person will come, and all these things will not be enough to suppress them.
Naturally, that is when his bloodline will come in.
Currently, he has awakened 18% of his bloodline and can harness up to 9% of it. That is impressive, but as his last trump card, he is inclined to use it only when he truly needs to.
’This is so embarrassing,’ Kent said inwardly as he caught the green spear with his clawed hands.
’To think I will be forced to use my bloodline by these beasts.’ It pained his heart that he was forced to use his bloodline.𝕗𝐫𝚎𝗲𝘄𝐞𝕓𝐧𝕠𝘃𝕖𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝚖
Of course, he wasn’t putting everything on the line simply because he didn’t want to kill three of the beasts.
If he were to use ’Soul Explosion,’ the likelihood of him killing them is high. Then again, if he were to use ’Blood Chaos Aura’ or ’Blood Sword Aura,’ the attacks would be too fatal.
That is not his endgame, so suppressing them is the most logical course of action.
But his current strength had proven inadequate.
However, now with just 2% of his bloodline unleashed, all the beasts around him fell to their knees, including the two Nagas.
Zeroth’s colossal body fell hard on the ground, and he quickly turned back to his human form to minimise the damage.
"You-you are a dragon," Vashara said, her face pale.
"Please don’t insult me." Kent sneered, an arrogant expression painting his face, "Calling me a dragon is an understatement. I am a True Primordial, do well to remember that."
Perhaps due to his bloodline currently at 18%, his arrogance started to surface. Of course, there is the part where he began spending most of his time reviewing Chaos memories.
Perhaps that was also having an effect on him. However, although he sounded arrogant, he does have the power to claim he is a True Primordial.
"Sorry for offending this senior. But we were just following orders," Niraya said, holding her left hand. Kent saw this and knew what she was doing.
"I know you are just biding time for your monarch to appear. Naturally, that is what I also wanted. So tell her to hurry.
I will wait for her."
Kent stood with his hands crossed behind him. His bloodline was suppressing the bloodline of the beasts, so none posed a threat to him.
Of course, Kent knew the longer it remained that way, the more adaptive they would become. However, he still has 7% more he can use, so for now, they can bide their time and hope for the best.
After all, one could only hope.
Deep in the Core region, Sylvara, the Scarlet Flame Serpent Monarch, moved out of her cave abode and sped toward the inner region.
Aside from being summoned by her two subordinates, she sensed a terrifying presence appear inside her domain.
This prompted her to move toward the source much faster.
In the other two regions inside the Serpent’s Coil Valley, the other two Kings and 12 Tier 19 subordinates each also sensed the danger, so they moved toward it.
They knew it was coming from the Venomous Gorge, but knowing that a danger in the domain they ruled was under attack caused them to move toward the danger.
Better to handle it as a group than to wait for it to come back and bite them in the ass individually.
It would take the Monarch 5 minutes and the Kings a little over 7 minutes, but knowing the danger was there was forcing them to hurry.
[The Ashfall Range - Ignarok]

Meanwhile, inside the most dreadful place in the Flame Sea, the Black Flame Dragon King, known by all his subordinates and rivals as Ignarok, the Ashen Tyrant, was having a normal day like every other beast when his hair suddenly stood on end.
"What in the hell?" His face paled instantly.
The reason for this reaction was that his bloodline had just reacted to something he never knew was possible.
It is a known fact that in all of the Flame Sea, Ignarok is the strongest and the most dangerous Monarch. He also has terrifying subordinates.
For such a beast to feel this reaction and even pale said everything.
"I am feeling fear. But that is impossible. There is nothing in this world or outside that can make me feel fear."
Ignarok frowned, looking toward the direction of the Serpent Coil Valley where the feeling was coming from.
If he were to move toward the location Kent was at, it would take him a month, even if he were to move at top speed.
The Flame Sea is vast and extremely dangerous. He may be a Monarch, which in this case will cancel out the danger. But he can’t magically get to the domain of the Scarlet Flame Serpent Beast.
He had to fly there, and that would take too long.
"Serythra, come here." Ignarok, instead, chose to send one of his personal guards instead.
A graceful woman with silver-black hair that flowed down like ash smoke, wearing pale skin, walked into the room. She knelt before the Dragon Monarch...
"You called, Monarch."

"Yes. Go to the domain of that Serpent bitch and investigate the feeling you are sensing at the moment. If anyone dares block your path, kill them, and if their Monarchs dare make a fuss about it, report to me immediately."
Serythra nodded and walked away. When she was outside, her dragon wings appeared, and she flew away, heading into the distance.
Once she was gone, Ignarok sat back in his bone throne and sighed...

"Whoever this thing is, they must be handled soon, or else I can’t feel at peace in my own domain." As a dragon who prided himself on being the peak existence in the Flame Sea, his status could not be shaken, not by the unknown.
Naturally, he wasn’t the only one who made this move.
All other Monarchs inside the Flame Sea who sensed this presence sent someone to investigate.
They all felt that primal fear. It was as if an apex predator had appeared, causing all of them to feel their positions as Monarchs threatened.
There may be people outside of Planet Cosima who can rival them. However, inside the Flame Sea, they are the rule, and the rule cannot be threatened that easily.
If only they knew the danger they sensed was but the tip of the iceberg.
Kent may be restricted at the moment simply because he planned on fulfilling his quest of taming the seven Monarchs, 14 guards, and 21 Kings and Queens.

If he were there to kill, as he initially planned, then once his Blood Core gate formed, which he would recognise as someone who had refined their core, perhaps then they would have felt what fear is.
Kent is slowly growing stronger, and soon, he will become undisputed even in a Dragon-dominated Supreme High World.

chapters.title: Chapter 977: An Apex Predator
paragraphs: Kent took the blood essence and core of the beasts he had killed, causing Zeroth to wish Kent would be struck by an asteroid where he stood. He wanted Kent dead.
Of course, Knet didn’t burn their bodies.
It was his way of telling Zeroth he meant no offence.
He simply retrieved the core, blood essence, and left the bodies for Zeroth to do with them as he pleased.
It had only been two minutes since Kent unleashed his bloodline. Still, none of the beasts was able to stand up.
So while he waited for the main target, Kent chose to experiment with his bloodline. He sat down and focused on the three main targets: Zeroth and the two Nagas.
He focused on Zeroth and chose to keep his blood pressure concentrated in specific locations on his body.
His first target was Zeroth’s arm.
He applied the pressure, and like a twig, his arm broke.
"Oh." Kent smiled despite Zeroth screaming his lungs out.
"Sorry about that. I was just experimenting with something, and you look like a specimen to me."
Zeroth glared at Kent but said nothing. He only gritted his teeth but remained calm.
"You don’t have to worry, I will compensate you later for all of this." The next arm broke afterwards, and this time, Zeroth cursed at Kent.
"I will kill you. The least chance I get, I will kill you."
Kent laughed, "You are funny, Zeroth. If I wanted you dead, I wouldn’t have used 2% of my bloodline. So keep quiet and endure"
The faces of Vashara and Niraya turned even paler, hearing Kent’s words.
’Just 2% and we are already at our limit. Just what kind of monster is he?’ Vashara said to her sister through telepathy.
’Not even Lord Ignarok will make us this helpless,’ Niraya also said, and Vashara nodded.
They had felt the aura of the strongest monarch in the Flame Sea before, but even he paled in comparison to Kent. Perhaps he could suppress them too, but not as severely as Kent had.
’Does it mean he is even stronger than Lord Ignarok?’ Niraya asked, and Vashara could only turn and look at Kent, who had yet again broken Zeroth’s body, this time, one of his legs.
The more they looked at Kent, the more afraid they became.
There is one thing to suppress someone using your bloodline, and another to use the pressure to hurt them. What Kent was doing was too much for a person to handle.
Suddenly, a terrifying pressure came from deep within the inner region.
Kent turned and looked in that direction. A smile appeared on his face.
"She is here."
The pressure that appeared in the inner region soon began to approach Kent. In no time, a redhead beauty appeared, locking her cold gaze on Kent.
"You must be the monarch." Kent stood up and walked away from Zeroth.
"Who are you?" Sylvara asked in a much colder tone.
Perhaps, as she looked at her two guards, suppressed and on their knees, her anger began to overwhelm her senses. However, she could also feel a primal fear from just being around Kent.
This fear, she felt it deep within her bones. This made her hesitate, which, without her even knowing, was the only thing saving her from Kent’s Chaos Dragon bloodline.
"You can call me Kent." Kent waved his hand, and the pressure bearing down on the beasts vanished.
"I came here to hunt, but it turns out you wanted my head. Makes me wonder what I did to you," Kent said with a subtle smirk.
"So it was you whom I sensed days ago?" Sylvara asked, and Kent nodded.
"You didn’t exactly sense me. You sensed this." Kent lit his soul flame and allowed the Verdant Flame of Renewal to activate.
The moment Sylvara saw this, her body tensed, and a hint of hunger flashed across her face. However, she held herself back.
Kent smiled when he saw this.
"May I ask why you want this?"

Sylvara looked at the green flame and answered, "If I were to swallow this flame, the chances of me breaking the 30th limit are high. I have already broken 29 and just need one to be able to go back home."
"Oh, very ambitious." Kent raised his brow. He hadn’t really looked at Sylvara’s profile, so hearing she had broken 29 limits made him see her in a new light.
’I will need 7% of my bloodline to match her strength if I were to fight her,’ Kent said inaudibly. However, he also knew if things were to escalate, he could easily kill her with the Soul Universe.
"Though I have to ask, why do you want to go back home? Isn’t this home?"
"No. I am not from this place."
"I see. In any case, I wouldn’t ask since I know you wouldn’t tell me. However, you should also know that I can’t give you my soul flame."
The aura around Sylvara changed, hearing Kent’s words.
"However, I have a way to help you."
"How?"
"Simple, become my subordinate and I will not only help you break your 30th limit, I will also help you awaken your Innate Beast Body and other innate talent abilities, aspects, and so on."
The cold look in the Serpent Monarch’s eye turned even colder.
Kent knew it was a big ask, but he wanted her to know what he was after before things got out of hand...
"Look, my soul flame is linked to me. This means to get it, you must kill me. However, I am not somebody you can easily kill.
You know that, and I know that. So think long and hard about it. You can take pride in thinking that becoming my subordinate is beneath you.
However, if you truly know who I am, you will even beg me to make you my slave.
Unfortunately, I hate slavery, so becoming my subordinate is a mercy someone at my level of standing will offer you.
So relax and think long and hard about it. I might even give you a way to ascend to an immortal world."
Kent sat back down, but his guard was up. He didn’t trust the beasts, and even with his bloodline, he knew the monarch was different. Breaking 29 limits is no easy feat.

Just when Kent thought he had made headway, he sensed the presence of two more dangerous beasts, each arriving with 12 powerful Tier 19 beasts.
"Looks like I will have to fight my way out of this," Kent muttered, standing up.

So take my advice and—"

Kent dodged and distanced himself.
"Fine. If words can’t knock some sense into you, then I must become an Apex Predator and suppress you bugs."
Kent let loose, and the beasts felt the danger... However, it was already too late to retreat.

sentences.text: Kent took the blood essence and core of the beasts he had killed, causing Zeroth to wish Kent would be struck by an asteroid where he stood.
He wanted Kent dead.
Of course, Knet didn’t burn their bodies.
It was his way of telling Zeroth he meant no offence.
He simply retrieved the core, blood essence, and left the bodies for Zeroth to do with them as he pleased.
It had only been two minutes since Kent unleashed his bloodline.
Still, none of the beasts was able to stand up.
So while he waited for the main target, Kent chose to experiment with his bloodline.
He sat down and focused on the three main targets: Zeroth and the two Nagas.
He focused on Zeroth and chose to keep his blood pressure concentrated in specific locations on his body.
His first target was Zeroth’s arm.
He applied the pressure, and like a twig, his arm broke.
"Oh." Kent smiled despite Zeroth screaming his lungs out.
"Sorry about that.
I was just experimenting with something, and you look like a specimen to me."
Zeroth glared at Kent but said nothing.
He only gritted his teeth but remained calm.
"You don’t have to worry, I will compensate you later for all of this." The next arm broke afterwards, and this time, Zeroth cursed at Kent.
"I will kill you.
The least chance I get, I will kill you."
Kent laughed, "You are funny, Zeroth.
If I wanted you dead, I wouldn’t have used 2% of my bloodline.
So keep quiet and endure"
The faces of Vashara and Niraya turned even paler, hearing Kent’s words.
’Just 2% and we are already at our limit.
Just what kind of monster is he?’ Vashara said to her sister through telepathy.
’Not even Lord Ignarok will make us this helpless,’ Niraya also said, and Vashara nodded.
They had felt the aura of the strongest monarch in the Flame Sea before, but even he paled in comparison to Kent.
Perhaps he could suppress them too, but not as severely as Kent had.
’Does it mean he is even stronger than Lord Ignarok?’ Niraya asked, and Vashara could only turn and look at Kent, who had yet again broken Zeroth’s body, this time, one of his legs.
The more they looked at Kent, the more afraid they became.
There is one thing to suppress someone using your bloodline, and another to use the pressure to hurt them.
What Kent was doing was too much for a person to handle.
Suddenly, a terrifying pressure came from deep within the inner region.
Kent turned and looked in that direction.
A smile appeared on his face.
"She is here."
The pressure that appeared in the inner region soon began to approach Kent.
In no time, a redhead beauty appeared, locking her cold gaze on Kent.
"You must be the monarch." Kent stood up and walked away from Zeroth.
"Who are you?" Sylvara asked in a much colder tone.
Perhaps, as she looked at her two guards, suppressed and on their knees, her anger began to overwhelm her senses.
However, she could also feel a primal fear from just being around Kent.
This fear, she felt it deep within her bones.
This made her hesitate, which, without her even knowing, was the only thing saving her from Kent’s Chaos Dragon bloodline.
"You can call me Kent." Kent waved his hand, and the pressure bearing down on the beasts vanished.
"I came here to hunt, but it turns out you wanted my head.
Makes me wonder what I did to you," Kent said with a subtle smirk.
"So it was you whom I sensed days ago?" Sylvara asked, and Kent nodded.
"You didn’t exactly sense me.
You sensed this." Kent lit his soul flame and allowed the Verdant Flame of Renewal to activate.
The moment Sylvara saw this, her body tensed, and a hint of hunger flashed across her face.
However, she held herself back.
Kent smiled when he saw this.
"May I ask why you want this?"
Sylvara looked at the green flame and answered, "If I were to swallow this flame, the chances of me breaking the 30th limit are high.
I have already broken 29 and just need one to be able to go back home."
"Oh, very ambitious." Kent raised his brow.
He hadn’t really looked at Sylvara’s profile, so hearing she had broken 29 limits made him see her in a new light.
’I will need 7% of my bloodline to match her strength if I were to fight her,’ Kent said inaudibly.
However, he also knew if things were to escalate, he could easily kill her with the Soul Universe.
"Though I have to ask, why do you want to go back home?
Isn’t this home?"
"No.
I am not from this place."
"I see.
In any case, I wouldn’t ask since I know you wouldn’t tell me.
However, you should also know that I can’t give you my soul flame."
The aura around Sylvara changed, hearing Kent’s words.
"However, I have a way to help you."
"How?"
"Simple, become my subordinate and I will not only help you break your 30th limit, I will also help you awaken your Innate Beast Body and other innate talent abilities, aspects, and so on."
The cold look in the Serpent Monarch’s eye turned even colder.
Kent knew it was a big ask, but he wanted her to know what he was after before things got out of hand...
"Look, my soul flame is linked to me.
This means to get it, you must kill me.
However, I am not somebody you can easily kill.
You know that, and I know that.
So think long and hard about it.
You can take pride in thinking that becoming my subordinate is beneath you.
However, if you truly know who I am, you will even beg me to make you my slave.
Unfortunately, I hate slavery, so becoming my subordinate is a mercy someone at my level of standing will offer you.
