chapters.title: Chapter 978: Conspiracy
paragraphs: BOOM
Zeroth was slammed into the ground, creating a large crater.
His chest caved in as blood flew from the corner of his mouth.
Vashara was also bleeding, with her left arm cut off from her body, while Niraya lost her left arm and right leg.
They are regenerating.
14 Tier 19 beasts died either from getting their heads severed from their bodies or their guts ripped out.
The two kings who had come were also bleeding all over, with the only person relatively less injured being the Serpent Monarch.
She held her flaming whip, staring daggers at Kent, who, aside from the blood of his opponent that had painted his claws, did not even have a cut appear on his body.
"I already told you, become my subordinate, and all of this madness will end. I am offering you something gods will plead to have," Kent said, looking coldly at Sylvara.
It had already been five minutes since they attacked Kent; however, it had already become plain as day that he had the upper hand.
Kent didn’t want to use all of his strength, but he changed his mind when all three kings, two guards, and the monarch got serious.
Thankfully, with 9% of his bloodline, he was able to suppress them.
"I will never bow to a filthy mongrel."
Kent’s gaze turned colder. "You dare call me a mongrel." His tone was even more chilling...
"I will be sure to teach you some manners."

His claws were coated in a red aura as he looked at Sylvara. Being called a mongrel clearly struck a nerve. However, Kent wasn’t that unreasonable to kill Sylvara, who was merely protecting her domain.
"I will kill you."
Looking at her two trusted guards, now broken and in pain, her anger was overflowing. Thus, she turned into her beast form.
She transformed into an 800-meter-long serpent with crimson scales. The moment her true form appeared, Kent sensed her power rise. However, he wasn’t afraid.
He flew into the air and let the Blood Chaos aura coat his claw. "I don’t want to hurt you, but since you gave me no choice, then be prepared for a world of pain."
Kent swung his claws, and four red arcs appeared, streaking toward Sylvara.
Her body shuddered, releasing flaming scales that formed into a large defence. The blood arcs landed on it, and a loud explosion erupted.
However, before she could retaliate, Kent landed on her body and, using his claw, scratched a painful wound on her crimson scaly body.
ROAR
Her roar filled the entirety of the Serpent Coil Valley. Many adventurers still around froze for a moment.
Kent distanced himself and attacked her body again with the Claw Strike he created just for this battle. This time, Sylvara was late to create a defence.
However, before the attack could land on her, Vashara appeared, transforming into her complete beast form. The attack landed on her body, cutting four large wounds into her body.
She passed out immediately, and blood gushed out.
"Vasha," Sylvara called out, her voice filled with concern.
"Shit," Kent muttered, not expecting the Naga warrior to jump in front of his attack.
He teleported and appeared beside Vashara, preventing Sylvara from getting to her.

She swung her tail, which turned into a whip, in an attempt to send the bug standing between her and her best friend flying. However, Kent waved his hand, and a hand made of fire grabbed hold of her tail and swung her away.
Due to the enormity of her body, a large part of the forest was cleared.
However, she got back up and dashed toward Kent, who stomped on the ground, and a large part of the battleground turned into a flame ring.
The flaming ring surrounded her, trapping her.
"Stand down, lady."
Kent commanded, waving his hand as ten meteors appeared in the air.
Sylvara felt her body locked onto, but she attacked, sending a fire beam from her eyes at Kent.
A flame wall rose before Kent, defending against the fire beam. However, the next second, Niraya appeared and waved her staff at Kent.
"Flame Sanguine." The battlefield shuddered, and Kent was immediately consumed in flame.
This gave Iskar, the Ember Fang King, the opportunity to attack.
"Die."
He stabbed his sword at Kent, who was consumed by the fire. He was one of the three kings in the Serpent Coil Valley, so his fighting power was extremely high.
However, even using one of his powerful attacks, the "Infernal Venom Stab," Kent’s claws grabbed the sword and broke it in half.
"Get out of my way."
A kick landed on Iskar’s chest, sending him flying away.
Luckily, Zeroth caught him mid-air.
Kent ignored them and instead conjured his soul flame, letting it envelop Vashara’s body. It turned green, showing he had activated the Verdant Flame of Renewal, the healing Nirvana flame.
Visibly, the wounds that appeared on Vashara started to heal.
Kent turned and looked at Sylvara, who was trapped in the flame ring he created using yet another Nirvana flame, the Umbral Flame of Oblivion.

It was black in colour, and its unique aspects were destruction and erasure. Although not strong enough to kill Sylvara, it could hurt her, and that alone was enough to make her hold back from being reckless.
"Look, I know things could have gone better; however, you beasts just don’t sit down and reason.
If you had sat down and analysed my proposal, you would have found out just how a mere Core Formation demi-dragon was able to kill Tier 19 beasts so easily.
It doesn’t make sense, and you know it.
This is why I ask you to relax and let me explain my offer yet again. If, after that, you still don’t accept, then I will kill you all and move to the next monarch.
After all, you should know that I plan to make all Monarchs my subordinates. Your fate has already been sealed, though if you are wise enough, you would know this fate is a good one."
Even if Kent was but a dragon, there was no logic as to how he was able to suppress someone like Sylvara.
However, he had, and that was already something Sylvara started to think of as she focused on the green flame around Vashara.
Kent remained calm as he observed the three kings and Niraya eyeing him.
They were angry, but also wary of Kent. So until their monarch attacked, they would hold back for now. After all, getting their asses handed to them by Kent wasn’t something they saw coming.
They could each challenge powerful humans to some degree, yet when it came to someone seven stages below them, they couldn’t even suppress them. Instead, they lost so many subordinates.
The loss was huge.
"Why do you want me to become your subordinate?" Sylvara suddenly asked.
"Very simple. I need your strength to fight a bastard who calls himself a Planet King."
When the words came from Kent’s mouth, Sylvara and her subordinates tensed.
This caught Kent off guard.
He didn’t expect that reaction, at least not from hearing the mention of someone he had clearly looked down on.
’Why do I feel like the universe has conspired against me?’ Kent said inwardly, suddenly feeling like he had walked into something extremely dangerous.
"Is there something I should know?"

chapters.title: Chapter 979: The Planet King
paragraphs: [The Enchanted Temple - The Enchantress POV]
A video of Kent’s current stance was displayed before the Enchantress.
She seemed sad, looking at the handsome face of someone she knew had given everything to the universe, yet they failed to protect someone so dear to him.
Now, they are using a loophole to reunite them.

However, this loophole was a dangerous one, and looking at Kent’s expression now, she knew he was starting to have second thoughts about the quest, specifically about being asked to kill the Planet King.
"I am sorry, Chaos. I should have done something. I should have changed something. However, I didn’t, and now, you are being forced to do everything on your own."
The Enchantress isn’t like Lady Universe. She isn’t connected to the Universe’s heart, so she is free to share her emotions.
Of course, as to how deep she can go in her emotion, she knew, so shedding a few tears wouldn’t create some cosmic black hole and kill billions.
"I can pretend and say my hands are tied, but we both know I should have done something. I should have altered her life or even protected her better.
Yet I didn’t, simply because I was afraid of what would happen if I did.
Now, you are being forced to pay the price you shouldn’t have."
She sighed, feeling a mix of shame and pain.
Kent, who had no idea his expression was making a Cosmic Enchantress cry, narrowed his gaze at Sylvara.
"Are you going to talk, or should I kill you and extract the memories myself?"
"Suit yourself. At least I will die knowing you will soon follow me." Sylvara seemed to have given up. Hearing Kent mention the Planet King broke her spirit.
Now, she would rather die than help Kent.
"Coward."
Kent smirked and activated the Soul Map, and then shared it with Sylvara.
The 80,000 km view of her domain appeared to allow her to see the thousands of beings currently afraid of what was happening in her domain.
They knew their Monarch was facing an opponent personally, so they were on high alert.

"I honestly don’t know what or who this Planet King is; however, I plan on killing him, and you are going to help me, or else all of this will burn to the ground," Kent threatened, and Sylvara smirked.
"Go ahead. After all, once all planets are under his rule, this place will be next, and I doubt he will spare any of us. So be done with it already."
Kent looked at Sylvara for a few minutes before a sigh escaped his lips.
"Can you tell me why that is? I know you are afraid, but I don’t, so you might as well use this moment to make me afraid too."
"Mind games don’t work on me, half-breed."
"Half-breed. You dare call me a half-breed?" Kent’s Chaotic aura exploded, pushing Sylvara back.
Clearly, this insult touched Kent’s dragon heart. ’This lady is getting on my nerves’
Kent gritted his teeth. However, he calmed himself down and turned back to his human form.
’I am not sure I can hold myself back much longer’
"You will do well to not repeat that again." Kent stopped himself from getting angry, but being called a half-breed seemed to have affected him deeply.
Kent turned and looked at Vashara. She was still alive, but unconscious.
All injuries on her body had healed by the Verdant Flame of Renewal. Kent snapped his finger, and the green flame around her vanished.
"She just needs to sleep for a while."
Sylvara nodded, but she still wasn’t going to tell him anything.
Kent turned to Zeroth. "Sorry for your loss."
He snapped his finger, and seventeen balls of green flames flew toward the beasts that managed to survive his onslaught.
Sylvara got one, and when she sensed the power in it, her eyes widened. She had reverted to her human form, so her reaction was genuine.
"Since you refused my offer, this is where we part ways. I will try my luck with the other six monarchs.
As for the Nirvana Flames, use them to your advantage, though I doubt it will help you much compared to what I had planned if you were to become my subordinates.
But, well, as they say, some people are just blind to see greatness."
Kent opened a portal, and the Ember Lion he tamed and named Ember appeared. He appeared in a demi-beast form, so when she saw the monarch, his body shuddered.
"Relax, Ember, she is no threat to you," Kent said, rubbing Ember’s shoulder. He had the head of a lion and the body of a man with a red lion’s tail.
"Take me to the location of the Soul Flame Tree."
Ember didn’t immediately do anything. He first turned and looked at one of the Kings who came to Zeroth’s rescue when Kent activated his bloodline.
His name is Rahven, a rather handsome fellow.
In his beast form, he is a three-headed hydra snake and also the strongest among the three kings.
Kent, who knew at this junction he wouldn’t be getting anything from the Monarch, and her subordinates didn’t even place Rahven in his eyes.
If any of them dare block him, he will just kill them.
"Take me there. If he dares block me, I will show no mercy and kill him." Perhaps knowing what he had gained, Ember nodded and transformed into his beast form, and Kent climbed on his back.
He gave the Monarch one last glance before motioning Ember to move. Soon, he was gone from the Venomous Gorges and headed to the Hydra Chasms.
Once he was gone, blood drooled from the corner of Sylvara’s mouth. She cleaned it, and Niraya cast a healing spell on her.
"My Monarch, why did you let him leave after everything he has done?" Zeroth asked, his eyes cold. Although the other kings lost subordinates, Zeroth’s loss was great.
It would take him years to recover, so he wanted Kent’s head more than anything.
Sylvara looked at him, and while in the past she would have punished him for questioning her decision, she merely looked at him now and sighed.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
"It was of no use. I could have used my trump card to kill him easily. However, that would set me back a thousand years, and I don’t have a thousand years to wait in a High World."
"Does this have something to do with the Planet King?" Rahven asked.
Sylvara stared at him meaningfully and sighed, "Yes, Rahven. Everything I and the other monarchs have been doing for the past 54,000 years was because of that bastard.
He took everything from us, and the sad part is that no matter what we did, regardless of what we used, we could never beat him. He is too strong."
All three kings and Niraya sighed, hearing their monarch speak in a broken-hearted tone. Her words caused their hearts to bleed.
Niraya waved her hand, and the green ball of flame hovering before her moved toward Sylvara. "Take it, Monarch. If this flame can help you break the 30th Limit, then take mine."
"Me too," Rahven said, sending the green flame toward Sylvara.
Zeroth did the same thing, and Iskar also followed the same trend. The other beasts gave their flames to Sylvara, who was left dumbfounded.
"You guys..."
"Don’t worry, Monarch. If you can break the limit, then take all our flames and use them. I am sure that with the 30th Limit broken, you can beat the Planet King."
Sylvara smiled, "If only it were that simple. The Planet King is unkillable simply because he is someone who has a strand of Immortal Aura in his body. Killing him is impossible"
"But how? How can he cultivate an Immortal Aura in a High World?" Niraya asked, and Sylvara sighed.
"It is because the Planet King has the bloodline of the Forsaken Race flowing through him..."
"What did you just say?" Kent appeared before Sylvara and asked, causing the pitiful monarch to jump back in fright.

I should have changed something.
However, I didn’t, and now, you are being forced to do everything on your own."
The Enchantress isn’t like Lady Universe.
She isn’t connected to the Universe’s heart, so she is free to share her emotions.
Of course, as to how deep she can go in her emotion, she knew, so shedding a few tears wouldn’t create some cosmic black hole and kill billions.
"I can pretend and say my hands are tied, but we both know I should have done something.
I should have altered her life or even protected her better.
Yet I didn’t, simply because I was afraid of what would happen if I did.
Now, you are being forced to pay the price you shouldn’t have."
She sighed, feeling a mix of shame and pain.
Kent, who had no idea his expression was making a Cosmic Enchantress cry, narrowed his gaze at Sylvara.
"Are you going to talk, or should I kill you and extract the memories myself?"
"Suit yourself.
At least I will die knowing you will soon follow me." Sylvara seemed to have given up.
Hearing Kent mention the Planet King broke her spirit.
Now, she would rather die than help Kent.
"Coward."
Kent smirked and activated the Soul Map, and then shared it with Sylvara.
The 80,000 km view of her domain appeared to allow her to see the thousands of beings currently afraid of what was happening in her domain.
They knew their Monarch was facing an opponent personally, so they were on high alert.

"I honestly don’t know what or who this Planet King is; however, I plan on killing him, and you are going to help me, or else all of this will burn to the ground," Kent threatened, and Sylvara smirked.
"Go ahead.
After all, once all planets are under his rule, this place will be next, and I doubt he will spare any of us.
So be done with it already."
Kent looked at Sylvara for a few minutes before a sigh escaped his lips.
"Can you tell me why that is?
I know you are afraid, but I don’t, so you might as well use this moment to make me afraid too."
"Mind games don’t work on me, half-breed."
"Half-breed.
You dare call me a half-breed?" Kent’s Chaotic aura exploded, pushing Sylvara back.
Clearly, this insult touched Kent’s dragon heart. ’This lady is getting on my nerves’
Kent gritted his teeth.
However, he calmed himself down and turned back to his human form.
’I am not sure I can hold myself back much longer’
"You will do well to not repeat that again." Kent stopped himself from getting angry, but being called a half-breed seemed to have affected him deeply.
Kent turned and looked at Vashara.
She was still alive, but unconscious.
All injuries on her body had healed by the Verdant Flame of Renewal.
Kent snapped his finger, and the green flame around her vanished.
"She just needs to sleep for a while."
Sylvara nodded, but she still wasn’t going to tell him anything.
Kent turned to Zeroth.
"Sorry for your loss."
He snapped his finger, and seventeen balls of green flames flew toward the beasts that managed to survive his onslaught.
Sylvara got one, and when she sensed the power in it, her eyes widened.
She had reverted to her human form, so her reaction was genuine.
"Since you refused my offer, this is where we part ways.
I will try my luck with the other six monarchs.
As for the Nirvana Flames, use them to your advantage, though I doubt it will help you much compared to what I had planned if you were to become my subordinates.
But, well, as they say, some people are just blind to see greatness."
Kent opened a portal, and the Ember Lion he tamed and named Ember appeared.
He appeared in a demi-beast form, so when she saw the monarch, his body shuddered.
"Relax, Ember, she is no threat to you," Kent said, rubbing Ember’s shoulder.
He had the head of a lion and the body of a man with a red lion’s tail.
"Take me to the location of the Soul Flame Tree."
Ember didn’t immediately do anything.
He first turned and looked at one of the Kings who came to Zeroth’s rescue when Kent activated his bloodline.
His name is Rahven, a rather handsome fellow.
In his beast form, he is a three-headed hydra snake and also the strongest among the three kings.
Kent, who knew at this junction he wouldn’t be getting anything from the Monarch, and her subordinates didn’t even place Rahven in his eyes.
If any of them dare block him, he will just kill them.
"Take me there.
If he dares block me, I will show no mercy and kill him." Perhaps knowing what he had gained, Ember nodded and transformed into his beast form, and Kent climbed on his back.
He gave the Monarch one last glance before motioning Ember to move.
Soon, he was gone from the Venomous Gorges and headed to the Hydra Chasms.
Once he was gone, blood drooled from the corner of Sylvara’s mouth.
She cleaned it, and Niraya cast a healing spell on her.
"My Monarch, why did you let him leave after everything he has done?" Zeroth asked, his eyes cold.
Although the other kings lost subordinates, Zeroth’s loss was great.
It would take him years to recover, so he wanted Kent’s head more than anything.
Sylvara looked at him, and while in the past she would have punished him for questioning her decision, she merely looked at him now and sighed.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
"It was of no use.
I could have used my trump card to kill him easily.
However, that would set me back a thousand years, and I don’t have a thousand years to wait in a High World."
"Does this have something to do with the Planet King?" Rahven asked.
Sylvara stared at him meaningfully and sighed, "Yes, Rahven.
Everything I and the other monarchs have been doing for the past 54,000 years was because of that bastard.
He took everything from us, and the sad part is that no matter what we did, regardless of what we used, we could never beat him.
He is too strong."
All three kings and Niraya sighed, hearing their monarch speak in a broken-hearted tone.
Her words caused their hearts to bleed.
Niraya waved her hand, and the green ball of flame hovering before her moved toward Sylvara.
"Take it, Monarch.
If this flame can help you break the 30th Limit, then take mine."
"Me too," Rahven said, sending the green flame toward Sylvara.
Zeroth did the same thing, and Iskar also followed the same trend.
The other beasts gave their flames to Sylvara, who was left dumbfounded.
"You guys..."
"Don’t worry, Monarch.
If you can break the limit, then take all our flames and use them.
I am sure that with the 30th Limit broken, you can beat the Planet King."
Sylvara smiled, "If only it were that simple.
The Planet King is unkillable simply because he is someone who has a strand of Immortal Aura in his body.
Killing him is impossible"
"But how?
How can he cultivate an Immortal Aura in a High World?" Niraya asked, and Sylvara sighed.
"It is because the Planet King has the bloodline of the Forsaken Race flowing through him..."
"What did you just say?" Kent appeared before Sylvara and asked, causing the pitiful monarch to jump back in fright.

chapters.title: Chapter 980: Interesting Development
paragraphs: "How... How did you get back here?" Sylvara asked, her chest rising and falling as she stared at the cold, looking eyes aimed at her.
Zeroth and the two Kings aimed their weapons at Kent but did not attack.
However, just like their Monarch, they were taken aback by how suddenly Kent appeared before them.
"That is not important," Kent said. "The most important thing should be that you repeat what you just said."
"I didn’t say anything," Sylvara said, causing Kent to narrow his cold gaze at her.
"I heard you say the Planet King has the blood of the forsaken race flowing through him. Tell me I heard wrong."

"How did you hear that? You left, and I checked the 70,000 km radius before speaking, so how did you hear me?" Sylvara was in shock, mainly because Kent had heard her, which shouldn’t have been possible.
She made sure Kent was gone before she spoke. However, the fact that Kent heard her not only shocked her, but it also pained her.

She was hoping Kent would die by facing the Planet King. That would be ideal, knowing his death would make her happy for the loss she had sustained in their clash that lasted only a couple of minutes.
However, that wouldn’t be the case anymore since the brat was standing before her, asking her questions about what she said to only her subordinates.
"Lady, there are many things in this universe that merely staying inside this planet will deprive you of the chance of learning about.
I am one of these things, and now, you will answer my questions."
"You can kill me because I won’t speak."
"Oh, you will," Kent smirked, and then his eyes turned reddish gold.
"I believe you will speak, lady, because I will command you to." Kent smiled, and then he tapped into his bloodline power.
’I hope this works, else I will be so embarrassed.’
"I command you to speak not out of duress, but out of your obedience to your saviour, the Primordial Chaos Dragon."
Sylvara’s body stiffened when Kent’s words entered her ears.
Kent smiled and then deactivated his bloodline power. The moment his eyes turned back to purple, Sylvara dropped to her knees, breaking into a cold sweat.
This sight caught her subordinates off guard, but Kent didn’t mind them. His focus was on what she did next.
Sylvara raised her head and locked gazes with Kent. A few minutes later, she frowned.
"You are still alive," she muttered, causing Kent to look at her weirdly.
"Of course I am alive..." He didn’t understand why she asked that, but Kent brushed it off and asked,
"What, are you wishing for my death?"
"No, but invoking the name of the Primordial Chaos Dragon is a death sentence. You should be dead by now."
"Ha," Kent laughed. "Are you serious?"
"Yes, I am. You should be dead now. Nobody dares invoke the name of the Primordial Chaos Dragon. The rules of the heavens prevent anyone from using the name of the Son of the Universe.
Unless you have the permission of the Primordial Chaos Dragon, using his name is a big NO. You should be dead."
Kent continued to laugh, causing Sylvara to frown. Of course, it was funny, and as someone who knew this was his chance to get what he wanted, Kent first wanted to get the laughter out of the way.
"Young lady, I don’t need anyone’s permission to invoke my own name. Or are you telling me I must first ask the permission of the heavens to use my own name?"
"Impossible. You can’t be him."
"Believe what you can, in the end, I am the Primordial Chaos Dragon, and there is nothing you can do about it.
Of course, if you were to tell me what I needed to know, I might grant you the permission to use my name once."
Kent never knew he would be meeting a fortune like this just when he thought he had hit a roadblock.
Who would have expected the one person proving stubborn would now appear docile because she recognised his greatness... well, she knew of his past self as the Primordial Chaos Dragon.
Of course, Sylvara was proving to be a nuisance, and that alone was more than enough for Kent to finally put her in her place.
"Ember, I give you permission to invoke the name of the Primordial Chaos Dragon. Now, use that power to order Zeroth to go down on his knees."
Ember, who was standing behind Kent, nodded and turned to his former master and King.
"I command you in the name of the Primordial Chaos Dragon to go down on your knees."
The heavens shook, and the entire valley felt a mighty pressure descend on everyone. They all turned pale from the mere danger they each felt in that moment.
Zeroth fell to his knees, and even his hands were touching the ground.
Kent waited for a minute, and then he snapped his finger. "Now, do you believe me?"
Sylvara was pale, shock written all over her face.
She went down on her knees and bowed toward Kent. "I am sorry, my lord. I failed to recognise your greatness and even dared to insult your magnificence. Please punish this rude servant."
The three Kings, Niraya, and all the beasts still alive went down on their knees, their foreheads touching the ground.𝚏𝐫𝚎𝗲𝕨𝐞𝐛𝕟𝚘𝐯𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝗺
If this sight was compared to the scene several minutes ago, one wouldn’t believe their eyes. Things had changed, and this change was one that even shocked Kent.
However, in a twisted kind of way, Kent felt his bloodline urge him to punish Sylvara.
He smiled and walked toward her. "Stand up."
She obeyed and stood up. Kent eyed her from head to toe. When his eyes passed her waist area, he stopped on her heavy hips, which, even from standing before him, showed she had a heavy backside.
Kent saw her ass wiggle during their battle; however, back then, he was Chaos, not Kent, so he paid no attention to it. However, now, in his true self as Kent, his mischievous side appeared.
Kent turned to Ravhen. "How many Soul Flame Fruits are mature enough for harvesting?"
Ravhen looked at the Monarch, who looked at him with a cold gaze. It was as if she meant to tell him, answer him before I gut you.
"There are 12, my lord."
"Kindly take Ember with you back to your domain, pluck all 12 safely, and give them to him."
"I will do that, my lord."
"Great." Kent laughed and then turned to Zeroth. "How about you, buddy? Do you have something worth my time?"
"I do, my lord," Zeroth replied. "I have a 50,000-year-old Nether Abyss Fruit."
’Would you look at that. I now have one of the ingredients required to make the Limit Breaker Pill,’ Kent smiled.
"Good, harvest it and wait for me in your domain. I will come for it."
"Okay, my lord." Zeroth had become so obedient that one would ask if he was the same person who wanted to kill Kent for killing his subordinates.
Of course, he was still angry, but he dared not do anything reckless, considering even the Monarch was being respectful...
"What about you, Iskar?"
"I don’t have any fruit treasure; however, I have a drop of the Nether Green Flame Essence."
"Are you sure..." Kent’s smile bloomed.
’Looks like I will be forming my core before leaving this place.’

chapters.title: Chapter 981: Punishment
paragraphs: One of the items Agni told Kent he can use in forming his core is the Nether Green Flame Essence. He told him that to form a core, he must have some of the best and most powerful resources available.
The Nether green Flame Essence is said to come from the Underworld. It is a flame essence used in purifying holy relics to imbue them with Nether energy.

Essentially, it is used to counteract divine energies. If Kent were to use it in forming his core, he would gain the essence of the Nether green flame, allowing him to have some edge over divine energies.
The Soul Flame Fruit is one that goes against the soul, and now he will be getting yet another powerful treasure.
"I will come to your domain next, after I am done with your monarch," Iskar nodded.
"You guys can leave," Kent said, and they bowed slightly and left. Kent then turned to Niraya, who was still kneeling on the ground.
"Stand."

Although she was able to regenerate her arm and leg, she still cannot use them properly. Of course, she can return to her Naga form, which, in that case, she wouldn’t need her legs, or even better, she can take her full beast form.
However, Kent understood beasts prefer their human form, which allows for easy navigation.
Kent waved his hand, and all 17 flames hovering before Sylvara moved toward her.
"Use them to heal properly."
"But-" Niraya was struck dumb, unsure of what to say.
"No need to worry about that. I will give some to your monarch later." Niraya turned to Sylvara, who nodded toward her, telling her to take the Nirvana flames.
"Thank you,"
Kent nodded and looked at the unconscious lady still on the ground
"Now, take Vashara away." She needed some more time to properly heal before waking up.
After she left, Kent turned to Sylvara and smiled, "Are you ready for your punishment?"
"Yes, my lord," Sylvara nodded, and the smile on Kent’s face widened.
"Then take me to your resting place. I need to give you an appropriate punishment."
Sylvara nodded and started flying back to her cave home.

Kent followed her, knowing that from today onwards, not only would he have a powerful Monarch who would become his subordinate willingly, but she would also become someone he could really rely on to kill the Planet King.

Of course, he is required to kill the Planet King himself, but he knew the Planet King had powerful subordinates, and relying on only himself and perhaps the powerhouses in Nictus would be inadequate.
But now, if he were to unleash the Monarchs, their guards, Kings, and Queens, the scale would be somehow balanced, giving him the chance to go for the kill without worrying about his team.
Kent now wanted to kill the Planet King more than anything. Hearing that he had the bloodline of the Forsaken race in him told him all he needed to know and what must be done.
After ten minutes, Sylvara and Kent arrived at her cave abode. Kent looked at the beautiful interior design and smiled, "You have good taste, Sylvara."
"Thanks for the compliment, my lord."
Kent laughed, "You can just call me Kent."𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
Sylvara hesitated, "I prefer to use my lord since that shows respect for someone of your nature and standing."
’What was I even expecting?’ Kent sighed, "Then you can call me my lord when we are outside, but when it is just the two of us, you can call me Kent."
This time, Sylvara nodded.
"Now, about your punishment," Kent gave her an evil smile and flexed his fingers.
’It has been a long time since I used the Divine Pervert’s Touch,’ Kent said inwardly, feeling he had neglected one of his most powerful abilities.
Back then, after he arrived in Sonox, he planned on using it to pleasure any woman he wanted to.
Of course, back then, he was planning on not marrying all the women he slept with since he knew some would just love to spend the night with him.
Alina was one of those women. However, after seeing how much his wives loved him, he decided against that and instead chose to be with them.
However, the Divine Pervert Touch was one that he knew would have allowed him to pleasure any woman he wanted.
Today, he plans on using it again.
Kent looked at Sylvara and gave her a thoughtful appraisal.
’Not bad. Both her chest and backside are majestic.’
"Sit on the bed and remove your armour. I want to give you a massage."
"What is a massage?" Sylvara asked, and Kent smiled.
"You will see in just a few minutes."
Sylvara knew she was about to be punished, but hearing she was required to remove her armour before her punishment made her sense something nefarious.
However, she obeyed and removed her armour, leaving her with only a thin white nightgown. It was one of the many things she seized from the adventurers she had killed and plundered.
’With the right pills, she will reach Alina’s level in the ass department,’ Kent smiled, looking at the round butt clinging to the white nightgown around Sylvara.
Kent moved forward and guided her to her bed.
’Damn.’
When she fell on the bed, her ass wiggled, causing the dragon rod to start gaining life. Kent, of course, willed himself to calm down.
’I will make sure she moans her heart out,’ Kent smiled and then activated his Divine Pervert Touch and slowly touched where he wanted to most, her ass.
Sylvara felt the cold hands touch her ass, sending waves of unfamiliar feelings deep into her body. She had never felt this feeling before.
"AaaahhhHH."
She moaned.
Kent smiled and then gently squeezed her butt, making sure he applied less energy to it. This time, he merely sent the feeling of relaxation through her ass.
"Mmmhhh."
Sylvara moaned again as her body calmed down considerably.
"AaaahhhhhH."

Sylvara moaned again, but this time she felt a wave of pleasure wash into her body. Kent focused his energy through her ass, as he started massaging it, feeling the softness of her ass filling his palm.
’Very soft.’
Kent smiled.
Sylvara, on the other hand, started to sense her body heating up. The more Kent massaged her ass, the more pleasure she felt.
She expected her punishment to be intense but painful.

However, this intense feeling was not painful at all. If anything, this feeling was much more desirable. She wanted to feel this; she was enjoying the feeling washing through her, and what was even worse, she wanted more.
"MmmmhhhH."
"AaaaHhhHHH."
Kent knew she was simply reacting like every woman in her place would. However, what made this even sweeter was the fact that she had never felt these emotions before.
The fact that she felt none of these feelings before, yet she was reacting so affectionately to them, made the moment even sweeter.
Kent spread her legs, and one of his hands pressed down on Sylvara’s ass. Then one hand moved and entered between her legs.
Of course, he only moved his hand closer to her nether region, but he didn’t touch her in her ladies’ area.
Instead, he used his thumb to brush closer to her nether area, which, from how high her moan had become, Kent knew she was feeling it.
"AAaaaahhhhHHHH."

Her moans were so much louder that Kent knew most of her beasts’ subordinates would hear, but none would come. Not that they would, knowing the one with their monarch was somebody they dared not offend.
"MmmhhhhhHH."
Kent added more feeling into the massage, causing Sylvara to moan even harder.
"It is coming."
Before Kent could react, her body jerked and she turned around. Her nether region was just a few inches from Kent’s face, so when she sprayed out her love juice, it landed on his face.
Of course, Kent could have evaded, but he allowed it to land on his face, letting a small smile grace his lips.

Right after adding him, he triggered 3 benefits simply because his trust level was at 15%.
Kent ignored that for a moment, just to add the others.
He knew the more he added to his Taming bracelet, the stronger he became.
However, he never expected that adding just three beasts would completely transform him into several times stronger.
"You deserve better than this Chaos.
You have done so much for this Universe, so enjoy and become stronger so that in the future, you wouldn’t lose any of these," The Enchantress said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 988: Taming Quest (2)
paragraphs: "I feel so much stronger now," Iskar, the Ember Fang King, one of the kings in the Sylvara domain, said. "What did you do to me?"
Kent smiled. "It is a secret I will only tell you when your trust level reaches 100%."
Zeroth and Rahven were also curious, but after hearing what Kent said, they could only sigh inwardly. However, they had become much stronger, and each of them awakened one innate ability.
Kent received three benefits from each of the other three beasts Sylvara brought him.
The first benefit was that he gave each of them a name. They already had a name, but it seemed the universe hadn’t recognised them, so he renamed them using the same names.
Just like with Ember, there was a 300% boost on all flame-type skills. This shows the reward is determined based on how strong the beast is and how much trust they have in him.
Each had only 15% trust in Kent.
So after activating the benefit, the beasts that use flame skills felt like they were twice as strong.
Then there was the benefit he received from creating living space for them. This time, instead of an increase in their trust level, they each received an elixir that came out of the Taming Bracelet.
After taking it, they each awakened an innate talent ability.
Then the third reward was for him to bestow a skill on them. He gave each the Flame wheel, which, to his shock, mutated when they received it.
Instead of Flame wheels on the heels, the five beasts instead got Flame wings, allowing them to move four times faster in their human form.
Vashara and Niraya also received three rewards, but their first reward gave them a 400% boost in all flame-type skills.
"You really didn’t lie to us. You indeed have the power to make us so much stronger," Vashara said, a thankful look in her eyes, though Kent could tell she felt like she owed him.
"You owe me nothing, Vashara. I merely did what I did because I needed your help. However, for now, I want you all to relax and decorate your new living spaces.
You can enter and exit as you will from anywhere.
We will be going to the human worlds soon, where I will do my best to help you all break more limits."
Kent smiled, and then an idea popped into his mind. "Of course, if you can find these ingredients here, I will be able to help each of you break at least one more limit before we leave."
Kent told them the names of the ingredients for the Soul Strengthening and Limit Breaker pills. They quickly issued orders to their subordinates to work together and look for these ingredients.
Meanwhile, after Kent made sure everything was set, he took Sylvara and the last remaining beast, a Tier 19 Burning Wyrm Serpent, to see Commander Agnes.
He had promised to give Commander Agnes a Tier 19 beast, and he intended to keep that promise.
After reviewing all the messages that appeared when he broke Sylvara’s virginity and made her his tamed beast, he found out that the one reward of the Taming Quest had been released.

He received the Ten Supreme Beast Contract, which, according to the descriptions, when used to form a contract between a person and a beast, will bestow upon them a supreme technique that grows with them as they become more familiar with each other.
Kent picked a female beast so that Commander Agnes could have a more intimate relationship with her. After all, ladies tend to share more about themselves with their fellow females.
"Is this human strong?" Sylvara asked, worried about what Kent said.
She wanted to know if Commander Agnes was stronger than she was, because Kent had told her that if he were to run away, he would die a painful death.
The only way for that to happen is if Kent’s companion is stronger than he is.
Kent smiled and cupped Sylvara’s cheek. They were seated on the back of the Burning Wyrm Serpent that he was taking to Commander Agnes.
"She is not a threat, my love. I could kill her with a slap, but because she helped after signing a blood contract, I had to uphold that.
Also, with your power, you will find out she is actually a Flame Elemental Elf, but she had disguised herself as a Flame Elemental Human. Don’t say anything when you see this."
"Okay."
Sylvara wanted to protect her man, but hearing he had everything under control made her relax a bit. Though she would keep a close eye on Commander Agnes just to be sure.
After two hours, they came to 200 meters away from the cave. Kent and Sylvara got down and started walking toward the cave.
When they were 100 meters away, he saw three Tier 14 soul spirits move toward him.
This made him smile. "Relax, Commander Agnes, it’s me."
The soul spirits came to a halt, and a voice came from the cave.
"Kent... is that you?"
"Yes, Commander."
Commander Agnes had restricted her energy from leaking, so even she couldn’t tell who was outside. Naturally, she did this to not draw attention to herself.
However, hearing Kent’s voice, she ran out of the cave only to come to a halt the next second.

Her bow appeared in her hand despite knowing death was what awaited her if she were to meet any of the two people standing beside Kent. She pulled her bowstring, showing she wouldn’t go down without a fight.
Kent laughed. "Relax, Commander. They are harmless."
Kent pulled Sylvara to his side and placed his hand on her ass while the beast meant for Commander Agnes stood in her humanoid form.
She was also beautiful, but the two horns on her forehead and the scales on her neck revealed that she was a beast.
"This is Sylvara, the monarch of this region, and your beast companion you will be naming after the contract is formed."
Commander Agnes gulped, looking at Sylvara. She was taken aback by both her beauty and the danger she represented.
’She... she is the monarch of this region... but how?’ Her mind couldn’t process just how Kent would look that intimate with one of the most dangerous beasts in the Flame Sea.
"I managed to get the Soul Flame Fruits." Commander Agnes immediately moved toward Kent, the fear of Sylvara and the other Tier 19 beast fading when she heard what Kent said.
Kent waved his hand, and 12 Soul Flame Fruits appeared.
Her eyes widened.
"As promised, you will have six, and I will take six." Kent waved his hand, and six Soul Flame Fruits vanished back into his space ring.
"But—" Commander Agnes couldn’t believe her eyes. "But this is just too much. I only want one."
"Well, you have five additional ones. That is your good fortune for meeting me. Also, take it as a down payment for your bride price."
Kent grinned.

Even in her disguise, she was a beauty. However, Kent’s praise came from the fact that, knowing her chances of living were next to none, she bravely ventured into the harrowing depths of the flame sea.
"Are you sure?" Commander Agnes asked with red cheeks. Sylvara’s eyes narrowed, seeing the familiar redness on her cheek.
Kent smiled and gave her ass a firm squeeze, telling her she should behave.
"I am sure. Also, get ready to form a soul contract with your new companion. She needs a name, so think of one."
"Okay. But I will take only three of the fruits, take the rest."

chapters.title: Chapter 989: Taming Quest (3)
paragraphs: "Now you must give her a name," Kent said, holding a golden key.
Commander Agnes nodded and focused on the beast lady, who was looking forward to having a name.
"From now onwards, I will call you Yu Lan."
The golden key shone brighter and moved toward Commander Agnes’s forehead. With one swift movement, it entered her forehead, sealing the contract.
Their bodies glowed golden for a couple of seconds, then their eyes widened in surprise.
"A...a Supreme technique." Both Commander Agnes and Yu Lan felt their backs break into a cold sweat, unsure of what to think.
Kent smiled, "Indeed, you both have a Supreme Technique now. The more you trust in each other and grow as two inseparable people, the more benefits you will receive."
"Wow. I never knew there was a method this magical for taming beasts." Commander Agnes said, feeling extremely lucky.
"That is because you are a human with limited knowledge," Sylvara said with a small smirk. "There once lived a Beast Tamer who every beast wanted to form a contract with him.
They said he had so many methods of taming beasts that every beast tamed would become a powerhouse.
In fact, in the immortal world, the legend of the Divine Beast Tamer remains to this day, inspiring many beasts to wish they had lived during his time.
If one day you make it to the immortal worlds, be sure to pay respects to his many statues. They said even his statues hold so much blessing that if you are lucky, you might just receive some.
Many had received his blessing, and now, they are powerhouses."
"Okay, Monarch." Commander Agnes knew better than to take offense at whatever Sylvara said.
Kent just smiled, though his curiosity was piqued by hearing about the Divine Beast Tamer. He certainly wanted to learn more about him, but for now, he had business to attend to.
"Take this, Yu Lan." Commander Agnes handed one of the Soul Flame Fruits to her beast companion. She then turned to Kent.
"Thank you very much, Kent. If it wasn’t because of you, I wouldn’t be here now. So thank you."
"No need to thank me. You were brave, and I like brave people." Kent gave her a look that made her heart skip a beat. "Take Yu Lan and go back. I will stay here for 3 more weeks before leaving.
Afterwards, I will come look for you on Planet Nictus."
"Okay. Just be careful."
"I will be. After all, who dares hurt me when I have a Monarch as my wife?"
Commander Agnes smiled and shook her head.
It would take her some time to digest the fact that Kent and the Monarch were actually lovers and seemed to have even crossed the line already.
"Yu Lan, let’s go." Commander Agnes pressed her forehead, and a golden key glowed, and Yu Lan vanished inside.
She then took out a return Talisman and channeled her energy into it. "Until we meet again, Kent."
"Until next time, Commander Agnes."
She transformed into a streak of light and shot upward, vanishing into the clouds.
"Next stop, domain of the Silver Flame Minotaur Monarch, Orvath."
Kent and Sylvara transformed into a streak of light and shot toward the Cinderhorn Plains, the domain ruled by Orvath.
[Moon of Planet Cosima - Commander Agnes]

Right when she vanished, she appeared on the moon, catching many people’s attention. Commander Agnes ignored all their gazes and quickly headed toward the Transfer Channel that would take her back to Planet Nictus.
Her plan now was to get back to Planet Nictus and give the Soul Flame Fruit to her general.
However, as she started making her way toward the Transfer Channel, three Beastkins blocked her path. One was a Tier 19 beast, and the other two were Tier 18.
"Look what we have here, if it isn’t Commander Agnes of the Nictus Useless Army."
From just the tone, Commander Agnes knew the three people were from the Planet King army. Naturally, she knew nobody would be coming to her aid.
Nobody was crazy enough to cross people linked to the Planet King.
"I don’t want to make things hard for you, so why don’t you empty your space ring and follow us to our dwelling? We promise not to molest you and would even let you leave after a week."
One of them, a Goatkin with two pointed goat horns, said, his eyes filled with lust. He was the Tier 19 beast.
"I know, right. With how caring we are, we wouldn’t even make you regret spreading your legs for us," the Lizardkin said, licking his lips.
"I will even heal you afterwards. This way, you wouldn’t feel any pain," the Rabbitkin said, each looking toward Commander Agnes with lustful eyes.
They knew on this side of the universe, as long as you were affiliated with the Planet King, nobody would dare resist you.
So Commander Agnes was the perfect catch.
Unfortunately for them, the current Commander Agnes was not someone they could bully. Perhaps, they would have had better luck if it were her before she met Kent.
Now, she was different.
As she raised her head and looked at the faces of the three Beastkins blocking her, a look of disgust appeared on her face.
"Even if I am hungry to spend a night with a man, I wouldn’t consider a stinky goat."
The faces of the three beasts, especially the Goatkin, twisted into an angered expression when they heard her words.
The Lizardkin lunged at her with bloodshot eyes. However, before he could lay his claws on her, a figure appeared behind Commander Agnes and grabbed the Lizardkin by the neck.
"AaarrggghhH!"
His scream was cut off as his head was burned off his body.
"What!"
The Goatkin reacted, attempting to make a run for it, but Yu Lan was much faster.
She appeared before him and then, with one quick jab, her hand went through his chest, appearing behind him with his heart in her firm grip.
Flame surged in her hand, and then, like burning paper, his heart turned to ash.
The Rabbitkin also tried to make a run for it, but unfortunately for him, Yu Lan had already marked him for death.
Before he could move, an arrow went through his head.
After killing the Goatkin, Yu Lan looked around, her eyes filled with disdain, and she issued a warning, "If you want to die, block our path."𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
After saying that, she moved and stood beside Commander Agnes, who couldn’t help feeling invincible at the moment.
"Let’s go, sister," Yu Lan said, making sure everyone heard how she addressed Commander Agnes.
The two ladies moved, and soon they booked their ticket, which was free thanks to Commander Agnes’s status.
All over, people could only look at the beautiful lady beside Commander Agnes until they left the moon.
Yu Lan was a Tier 19 beast who had broken 22 limits on her body. This made her extremely dangerous.
The Goatkin stood no chance against her.
Words spread out like fire, reaching Planet Nictus long before they even arrived. Words of a beauty walking with the infamous Commander Agnes, whom everyone thought was dead, spread like wildfire.
Many people became happy, but some felt rage. In all, when she reached home, she was welcomed by 10 Tier 19 powerhouses... not that she needed them, considering she had Yu Lan by her side.

chapters.title: Chapter 990: Taming Quest (4)
paragraphs: [Cinderhorn Plains - Domain of the Silver Flame Minotaur Monarch]
"These are flame crystals," Sylvara pointed at chunks of silvery crystals on the ground. "They are highly explosive when overloaded with flame energy.
It is one of the valuables the adventurers from your world chase after if they manage to enter the inner region of the Cinderhorn Plains."
Kent nodded, "If only they had the heart to enter the Core domain, they would have had a bountiful harvest."
Sylvara nodded, already aware of the danger people like Kent go through even in the inner regions. Entering the core region is suicide.
Kent and Sylvara had just arrived directly in the Core region of the Cinderborn Plains, a rather vast plain of burning earth where silver flames harden into jagged crystals.
The land looks like a battlefield littered with glowing silver spears rising from the soil. These silver spears, of course, are the sought-after Silver flame crystals buried in the ground.
Kent waved his hand, and a silver flame crystal flew into his hand.
"Dense flame essence. With this, a flame user can easily strengthen their flame resistance and even practice flame skills by channeling the flame qi inside it."
Kent tapped into his cultivation technique, and within ten seconds, he absorbed everything from it, turning the crystal into a mere stone.
Sylvara saw this and smiled, "Wait until you reach where Orvath stays. He has a mountain of these crystals there. In fact, his house is made from these crystals."
Just when Sylvara spoke, a presence not any weaker than her true monarch form appeared in the distance and began approaching them.
Kent held a calm expression as he looked at the flaming figure speaking toward them.
Using his enhanced eyesight, he was able to see a brutish man with black hair, whose body seemed to be lit on silver flames, flying toward them. As he moved, his hair flowed in the air like waves.
He had silver horns, and his body was wrapped in flame-forged armor. Kent can tell that the armor is pure flame condensed into a solid form.
"Sylvara, I don’t suppose we are that related for you to barge into my domain with a stranger, no less," Orvath spoke, his tone much deeper than a normal human would sound.
"Oh, please, don’t insult my intelligence, or you think I wouldn’t know you sent one of your lackeys to come spy on me?" Sylvara smirked.
"I was only concerned about your well-being, but since you are here, then I suppose I was worried for nothing."

Orvath may be a bull, but he was no idiot.
He hadn’t lived this long by relying only on his brute strength.
So without much deduction, he knew Kent was no simple human.
Even a part of him felt like the danger he sensed a couple of days ago was now staring him in the eyes.
"I didn’t come to waste your time, Orvath. I am only here to introduce Lord Kent to you. He has a proposal for you." Sylvara stepped back, indicating she was done with what she had come for.
However, using her energy, she gave Orvath one last remark.
"He is no simple person, so do well not to offend him... trust me, I learned it the hard way."
And with this, Orvath knew his suspicion was right. This made him change his tone and demeanor instantly.

Kent smiled as he gave Orvath an appraising look, "A sage body cultivator, just a step away from attaining Nirvana body, 29 limits broken, and even showing signs of breaking the first seal on your bloodline."
Kent laughed and turned to Sylvara, "You never told me there is someone with the lineage of the Ancient Demon Bull Emperor."
"I didn’t know he had such a bloodline," Sylvara smirked, but deep down, she truly had no idea.
As for Orvath, his expression changed when he heard all Kent had to say about him.
’He got all this from a mere look. Just who is this person?’
Kent’s enchanted eyes had captured more than he expected, allowing him to get into Orvath’s head before he could build defenses against him.

"You, Mr, you have some potential buried deep within you. But fear not, I will help you unlock them eventually. However, as to whether that will happen, it will depend on your answer for my visit today."
Orvath looked at Sylvara, but the latter turned away almost as if telling him, ’don’t look at me for answers, use your brute mind to figure things out yourself.’
He sighed and then turned toward Kent and asked.
"I would like to know what it will cost for this senior to help me."
Kent smiled and moved toward Orvath, placing his hand on his shoulder, "No need to call me senior. We are practically brothers."
Sylvara’s eyes widened when Kent suddenly appeared friendly toward Orvath.
She flashed Kent a look that said, ’dude, what the hell. You killed dozens of my people and even nearly killed one of my best friends.’
However, Kent just smiled and maintained his focus on Orvath, "I don’t want to make things hard for you, so I will go straight to the point.

I want you to become my subordinate. In return, I will help you break the 30th Limit, awaken your innate Beast Body, awaken a few innate talent abilities, and send you to a powerful Immortal world safely.
There are other perks which you will learn about after the contract has been signed."
"And what would be required of me?" Orvath asked. "I may be a bull, but I am no fool. I know things like this come at a cost."
"Hahaha, no need to think too hard, brother Orvath." Kent laughed. "All I want is for you to hold back or kill the subordinates of someone very powerful.
I want him dead, but I can’t kill him with his subordinates helping him.
I promise you wouldn’t be facing this person, since even I wouldn’t allow you to."
"Who is this person?"
"They call him the Planet King, but in my eyes, he is a bug with some abilities in him."
Orvath looked at Sylvara, who this time gave him a nod.
"How sure are you of defeating him?" Orvath asked, and Kent grinned.
"Let’s just say if I fight him today, I will have a 40% chance despite not knowing how strong he is. However, if I were to fight him 100 days from today, then well, he will wish he hadn’t met me."
Many people, including Orvath, may think Kent is bragging, but Sylvara, who had seen what Kent could do, knew he meant every word.
Of course, she completely trusted Kent now, so there was nowhere she wouldn’t follow him.
"Of course, if you accept my offer, I will extend it to six more subordinates under you. I am nothing if not generous."
Orvath spent a couple of minutes in deep thought before giving Kent his answer.
"I accept your offer. However, I have a request."
"Name it."
"You wouldn’t order my subordinates against their will. If you accept this, I, along with my two guards, three Rulers, and one more subordinate, as you requested, will become your tamed beast."
"I don’t mind. As long as you promise to help me in my battle against the Planet King by blocking his subordinates, you will get to live your life like you’re not even connected to me."
Orvath nodded.
"You can come to my house and stay the night. My subordinates will come around tomorrow."
Kent nodded and left with Orvath and Sylvara.
Orvath’s house was also a cave made inside a mountain of silver flame crystal.
"Woo, this place is a haven for flame cultivators." Kent sat down in lotus posture and started absorbing the flame qi in the air.
In no time, he formed over a thousand flame veins, surpassing 30,000 flame veins, though nowhere near the 500,000 estimated by Agni.
The next day, Orvath’s six subordinates arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 991: Taming Quest (5)
paragraphs: "Monarch, are you sure we can trust this human?" Korgath, King of the Bladed Plains, asked. He is a towering, burly man with white hair tipped in silver. Although not particularly handsome, his hair gave him a classic yet distinctive look.
His arms are wrapped in molten armor plates made from silver flame.
Clearly, he had all the makings of a brute. Naturally, he qualifies to be one of the three Rulers under Orvath.

"I believe he is sincere and has what it takes to indeed make us have a more pleasant life. However, I don’t completely trust him just yet," Orvath answered his subordinate, who turned and looked at Kent.
"Human, you may see us as a Bull, but we Minotaurs aren’t that easy to trick. So, if this is a trick, better stop now before I smash your head into bits."
Kent smiled, looking at the six figures standing beside Orvath. Two females and four males, each a Minotaur in their own right.
"I don’t play tricks, Korgath. This is real, so be ready to become so much better in the coming days."
Kent turned to Sylvara, "You can show them."
Sylvara, who had been waiting for this moment, nodded and transformed into her beast form, shocking Orvath and his six subordinates.
"No way," Selra, Queen of the Shattered Hooves, exclaimed, her expression showing shock. "You have awakened your innate beast body."
"Indeed. Lord Kent helped me just a day ago." Sylvara chose to address Kent formally in public in order to raise his image in the eyes of these arrogant beasts.
Hearing her words, Orvath and his subordinates started to see Kent in a different light.
"I only had one pill, so I gave it to Sylvara. However, once I get back to my home world, I will ensure every last one of you awakens your innate beast bodies."
Hearing his words and looking at Sylvara completely won them over. Kent could tell they all wanted to become his subordinates in the hope of one day awakening their innate beast bodies.
As beasts, awakening their innate beast body was like awakening their true self. It is what defines them as beasts.
Of course, for a beast to be able to reach the immortal stage, it must awaken its innate beast body.
Some say once a beast awakens their beast body, their true potential will be unlocked.
Kent knew this, and, thanks to his alchemy skills, he knew he could help them.
"I will be adding your seven to my beast army."
They nodded in agreement to Kent’s words, already aching for when Kent would help them awaken their innate beast bodies.
Like what happened with Sylvara’s subordinates, all seven newly added beasts were left dumbfounded.
Not only did they become stronger, but each had awakened an innate ability that would forever grow with them.

"This is just too much," Orvath said, looking at his glowing fist. "I have heard of minotaurs possessing a unique innate ability called Indestructible Fist. They said it can break through anything regardless of what enchantment is placed on them."
He flexed his muscles, looking more closely at his fist...
"Who would have thought I would awaken such an ability?"
He looked at Kent and bowed slightly. "Thank you."
"No need to thank me," Kent said, clearly happy. "After all, we are now a family, and a family must support each other."
The concept of family isn’t new to the beasts, so they understood Kent meant well.

Seeing that he had their attention, Kent put his next plan into action. "To make things quick, if you can use your people to gather these ingredients, awakening your innate bodies and breaking more limits wouldn’t be impossible."
Kent gave them the ingredient, and like he expected, they got right to work.
His cauldron is ready; all he needs are the ingredients.
After all that was handled, he asked Orvath to escort him and Sylvara to Lotus Inferno, where Zeraphine, the Flame Lotus Monarch, lives.
"So you plan on taming all seven of us, huh?" Orvath asked as they started their three-day journey to Zeraphine’s domain.
"Yes. Only by getting all seven monarchs can I confidently face the Planet King without worry."

"Well, Zeraphine is a menace, but she and I are on good terms, so we might just have a shot with her. However, I can’t make any promises since she can be crazy sometimes." Orvath smiled, knowing the woman they were going to could be unstable sometimes.
"Don’t worry, I have ways to tame crazy women." Kent gave Sylvara a mysterious smile. "They are the easiest to tame."
The snake lady smirked and turned away from Kent.
After awakening her innate body, she had become much more mature and more human.
Her emotions were now on point, and she seemed to have developed a keen sense of humor that Kent just couldn’t get enough of.
"Just be careful around Zeraphine. She is unpredictable," Orvath warned, and Kent took his words to heart.
Meanwhile, far in the cosmos, on a planet whose surface is made entirely of glass, stood a temple crafted from brown crystals.
The temple had the shape of an eagle.
The inside was designed with attention to detail. Everything was placed correctly, and on the walls, images of masked individuals were hung in dark glass frames.
One would wonder why images of people who could not be recognized were displayed.𝘧𝘳𝘦ℯ𝓌𝘦𝒷𝘯𝑜𝑣𝘦𝓁.𝒸𝘰𝓂
However, a closer look would reveal a mark on each mask indicating numbers carved, ranging from one to twelve.
At the moment, 12 people, each clad in dark clothes and faces hidden behind masks, were seated around a large brown table.
Their masks also bore the same markings as the images on the wall.
These markings served as a means for people to identify the leaders of the Order of Whispering Shadows.
They were said to be one of the most dangerous shadow organizations in the universe. Their legacy was one that shook the heavens and broke the earth for years.
However, they went silent many years ago when tragedy struck at their front door.
This tragedy was, of course, why these 12 masked people were meeting in the headquarters of the Whispering Shadows after millions of years.
"The shadow whispers," the one with number one on his mask said, and the others responded.
"And the night rose."
"I believe many of you are wondering why I called such an urgent meeting," Number One began, addressing the leaders of the Whispering Shadows.
He took out a feather from his space ring and placed it on the table. Right when he did, a star map appeared from the center of the table.
He pointed forward, and a lone star, dim and barely alive, magnified.
When the people around the table saw this, their bodies tensed and their auras flared, showing that all of them were Celestials.
"I believe we all recognize what we saw and know what this symbolizes."
They nodded, each seething behind their mask.

Millions, perhaps billions of years ago, a lone figure, unrecognizable even by the gods, appeared, and with him, the legacy the Order of Whispering Shadows had cultivated for years came crashing down.
He killed every last leader of the Whispering Shadow Order, setting them back many years. However, they weren’t dead, and today, they were meeting because they sensed their foe had risen.
If nothing could move them, then today, they knew a common enemy still lived; thus, they must come together to eliminate him.
"The Faceless Assassin still lives. However, this time, we must ensure his legend is cut short," Number One said, his aura filled with killing intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 992: The Fourth Floor - Church Of Destruction (6)
paragraphs: While days passed for Kent, simply because he was running on the tower’s time, back in the future, only hours had passed for his legion and wives, who were challenging the 4th floor of the Planet Killer dungeon.
They aren’t running on the tower time, so to them, it hadn’t even been a day since their battle with the Church of Destruction.
Vexthra is working around the clock to ensure Neomi is ready for her role in the upcoming battle.
This time, only she, Sylara, and Veydris will be participating.
Veydris is going because, well, he is the strongest and extremely dangerous.
Sylara will be going because of her Blood Hunger Seal, which, if she were to burn its essence, she would gain the power to fight against the followers of the demon god of destruction.
Lastly, there is Neomi, who, thanks to the Bloodvein tribe, will be harnessing the power of faith to fight.
Vexthra wanted to teach her how to harness the power of faith first before the main mission arrives. Lani and Elyndra still hadn’t reached back to them, so they are merely waiting for them.

"Listen very carefully, Neomi," Vexthra said, looking at her sister with a calm expression. Neomi nodded and started paying much closer attention. "To harness the power of faith, you must first become a god."
Neomi frowned a little, hearing something she had no business becoming until many years to come at least.
"I am just a core formation cultivator, big sister, how can I become a god with this weak cultivation?"
Vexthra smiles and then takes Neomi’s hand, "At your core, you are a god simply because you possess the power of faith.
Of course, if this were ordinary times, aside from the faith you’ve gathered protecting you indirectly, you wouldn’t even know you had it.
But once the power of the demon god descends, the rules binding you to the core formation stage will temporarily be lifted, allowing you to become a goddess.

Once that happens, all prayers ever prayed to you by your followers will fill your head. Now, under normal circumstances, I would have asked you to ignore them. However, you need strength, and the way to do that is to answer their prayers."
Vexthra turns to Sylara and Veydris. "This is where you two come in. While she is becoming a god, answering the prayers, you two must hold down the fort.
She will need a minimum of five minutes to complete answering all prayers and attain the divinity that came from those faiths.
Under no circumstances should she be interrupted. So I am afraid you would have to burn your Blood Hunger Seal, Sylara."
"It is okay, big sister," Sylara said with a smile, "If burning it will give me the power to fight against the minions of a god, then I will gladly do it."

Vexthra smiled and nodded, and then turned back to Neomi, "Once you answer their prayers and gain enough divinity, you will move to start fighting the minions, while Veydris locates and destroys the statue of the demon god.
The longer the fight progresses, the more blessings the demon god can bestow on his minions, so destroying his statue is the main target here.
There will be many statues, but the main one is mostly inside the church. Destroy it, and the connection between them and their god will be severed."
"Seems simple enough," Neomi said, already prepared for the next phase of the battle.
"Indeed," Vexthra nodded and scratched the back of her mind. Unity, who had studied her big sister and knew when she was hiding something, nudged her to spill the beans.
"You are hiding something, big sister."
"It is not important yet," Vexthra replied, pinching Unity’s ear.
"However, since you want to know, Neomi, there is a price you will have to pay for using the power of faith while still not being a god.
You see, in everything, there is cause and effect.

To use the power of faith, you must become a god first. However, because you will be taking advantage of the temporary lapse in the laws governing the power of faith, once the laws are restored, they will impose a punishment.
It wouldn’t be too harsh, like killing you or restricting you. At most, you will be out of commission for a year, maybe two."
"Out of commission as in not being able to fight for a year," Neomi asked.
"Yes. However, with the tower, you can easily pass the time there."
"I see." Clearly, the idea of not being able to fight for a year didn’t sit right with Neomi. "We all have to pay a price somehow. If this is mine, then so be it."
Luckily for her, she can tell when to be the bigger person. So she will pay this price for her sisters.
"Don’t worry, Kent will be out of seclusion soon. Once he is out, you will have some alone time with him while we are all either on this same floor exploring or on the 5th floor."
Naturally, Vexthra brought all the joy back to Neomi’s life. If spending time with Kent is the price she has to pay for not being able to fight for a year or maybe two, then so be it.
Neomi’s sisters could only sigh and wish this were them.
However, knowing these were difficult times, they could only let her have this while they waited for their turn, some other time.
A couple of hours later, Lani’s voice entered Vexthra’s head.
"Big sister, we have located the church of destruction."
"Nice work, Lani."
Vexthra called her sisters and team to gather. A couple of minutes later, everyone is gathered around, and she starts briefing them.
"The majority of the battle will be fought by Neomi, Veydris, and Sylara. However, once the god statue is down, you all can join.

Though I doubt you will be able to do anything since we have someone like Neomi on the battlefield. That said, five of you will stay here to guard the village in case there are still some hidden members we haven’t accounted for."

Vexthra let Shade King Nykali, Vaelros, Skoggr, Morne, and Varyne stay. Just one of them would have been enough, however, to prevent any unfortunate incident from happening; she decided to deploy 5 of them.
The rest used the connection of the tower to teleport to the location of Lani and Elyndra.
When they arrived, they found themselves in a valley that stretched several miles long. In the distance, they could see a black tower looming toward the sky.
The design is reminiscent of one of those buildings, where one doesn’t need any intelligence to know a lot of ominous things happen within its walls.
"Big sister, from our surveillance, there seem to be exactly 500 people within the church. However, they have guard dogs."
The guard dogs are two Alpha wolves, each at the peak of the Spirit Lord stage.
"Unity, you have been promoted to join Sylara, Veydris, and Neomi. Your job is to kill the guard dogs and retreat."
Unity grinned at her sisters and then retrieved two arrows that made everyone’s back break into a cold sweat.
When it comes to trump cards, Unity’s Primordial Spirits had done a great job crafting some of the most deadliest arrows for her before they went out of commission.
She will be using 2 of such arrows to kill the Alpha wolves.
"Good luck, we will be cheering for you."
