chapters.title: Chapter 993: The Fourth Floor - Church Of Destruction (7)
paragraphs: [Church of Destruction]
Inside the Church of Destruction, one would expect it to have some color aside from black, but no, every last thing is black, including the statues standing inside.
Clearly, they want everyone to know what they are about.
However, the 500 people gathered inside are all wearing white, which contrasts with the ominous feeling they were trying to convey.
Standing at the altar, holding a black candle, is a human figure with green eyes and deep red marks on its neck.

"I have just received words from our lord," he spoke, causing the people kneeling down to smile. "The lord said we shouldn’t worry, that he will bestow his power on us so we can fight against those who seek to end us.
He promised to allow us to feel what it is like to have faith in him, so my brothers and sisters, do not worry, for we have nothing to fear."
"All hail Lord Balmos."
"Praise be to the Demon God."
Meanwhile, 400 meters away from the church, Unity stood on a stone wearing a focused expression. Behind her stood Veydris, Sylara, and Neomi.
"Are you sure you can take the shot 400 meters away? Those are Tier 18 beasts," Neomi asked, placing her hand on Unity’s shoulder.
"You insult my experience as an archer, sister," Unity responded with a grin.

Neomi smirked and said... "Just saying. I know you and Kaizo are like rivals, and killing Tier 18 beasts while 400 meters away feels like a brag that Kaizo would definitely have a hard time surpassing.
However, you seem to forget that our safety counts on you killing those two in less than 3 seconds. Just don’t get in over your head, sister."
Unity smiles and turns to Neomi, "Relax, sis, I have everything under control."
Unity looked past her, and 100 meters away, she gave Alina a slight nod. Alina also returned her nod before opening a formation.
’Nice doing business with you, Alina.’
Alina smiled, ’Likewise. Just don’t go back on your word. I will take a week of your time with Kent as payment for helping you.’
’I am a person with integrity, sister. I wouldn’t go back on my word,’ Unity smiled, and then placed one arrow in her bow and held the other in her quiver strapped to her back.
"Time to move, guys."
Neomi and Sylara moved while Veydris entered the void.
Unity waited for five seconds before activating a skill that allowed her to see the weak points on the two beasts.
With the formation boosting her range and power, she was ready.
"Peace out, punks." One arrow vanished from her bow, and a second later, a second arrow was also released.
Four hundred meters away, the two Alpha Wolves sensed something approaching that could endanger their lives. However, just when they sensed the danger, it vanished.
But the next second, something lethal went through their hearts, preventing them from even howling.
Right when the arrow went through their chests, the door leading to the church was struck by Veydris, who came out of the void.
However, his attack merely made it shudder but couldn’t break it.
Veydris entered the void the next second, already aware of this outcome.
"They are here," the priest shouted, lifting the black candle, which turned into a staff. He then stabbed it on the ground, and the entire church trembled.
"Oh, Great Demon God Balmos. I call on you in times of need, seeking salvation and strength. Bestow on your follower the power to defeat their foe.
Bestow on us the power to defend your honor and protect your sacred altar."
"All hail Lord Balmos."
"Praise be to the Demon God."
On the outside, a beam of light descended from the heavens and landed on the church.
"All hail Lord Balmos."
"Praise be to the Demon God."
Every last member inside the church felt their strength rise by several levels. The majority of them were Spirit Sovereigns.
However, when the light descended on them, most broke through to the Spirit Lord stage, with five reaching the Heavenly Ascension stage.
In all, there were 100 Spirit Sovereigns, 395 Spirit Lords, and five Heavenly Ascension stage warriors filled with the power of a god.
A rather powerful lineup.
"Kill them all."
"For Lord Balmos, the Demon God of Destruction."
The door leading to the church opened, and powerful warriors clad in white surged out.
When the last of them walked out, Veydris appeared from the void and unleashed a powerful sword strike that cleaved through five warriors, ending them instantly.
He retreated the next second. That one attack was to test their strength, which he did, and knew what had to be done.
Veydris raised his sword, and in an instant, a formation appeared. Then, the void cracked, opening a red inner darkness.
From within, a mask appeared.
Veydris grabbed it and placed it on his face. A faint red energy came from the mask and surrounded his body.
His body morphed, and then, instead of a 2-meter-tall figure, a 4-meter-tall metallic man appeared, holding a red sword.
Veydris took on his true form, and with that, he moved.
Meanwhile, Sylara slowly approached the battlefield with her eyes closed.
As she moved, her strength started to surge. She wasn’t breaking through her Core Formation cultivation stage. That was impossible; however, her aura was surging, moving past even Spirit Monarch.
By the time she appeared within 30 meters of the battlefield, her strength had surged to the peak of the Spirit Lord stage.
’I have 12 minutes before I run out. I’d better make good use of these 12 minutes then.’

"Veydris, handle the small fries; I will hold back the big ones." Sylara’s claws appeared, and like the vampire she was, she clashed with three Heavenly Ascension stage warriors while two stood guard at the only entrance leading to the church.
[Neomi’s POV]
Right when the power of the demon god descended, Neomi felt a seal within her break.
Right when the seal broke, she felt a terrifying power surge into her, instantly changing her into that of Shara, the Mother of Killers.
In that instant, she started to hear the voices of people praying to her.
"Mother of Killers, give me the strength to protect my family."
"Mother of Killers, please save my child."
"Mother of Killers, please let me become worthy in the eyes of my in-laws."

Thousands of prayers flooded her mind, some funny, some extremely important. However, as she looked through a couple of prayers—or, more importantly, the voice behind those prayers—she recognized one.
"Mother of Killers, please save my mother."
"Mother of Killers, please take me instead and let my mother live. If she dies, my father will be devastated."

"Mother of Killers, I know you are just and know what to do and when to do it. I don’t blame you for my mother’s death. I still believe in you and know one day, you will answer my prayers and let me meet my mother again."
Tears fell from Neomi’s eyes when she recognized her sister’s voice.

"Velyra, I am so sorry. I never knew you were counting on me. I really am sorry. However, now that I can do something, even if it costs me my life, I will ensure you are reunited with your mother again."
Neomi pressed her hands together and was about to answer her prayers when somebody tapped her on the shoulder.
When she turned around, she saw her red-skinned sister, Velyra, smiling at her, tears falling from her eyes.
"It is okay, my sister. You have long answered my prayer by sending Kent to me. That is enough. Don’t hurt yourself over something like this."
"But—"
"No, my dear sister. Perhaps in the future, when you become a god, you can then answer my prayers, but for now, prioritize your safety."
Neomi nodded and hugged her sister, shedding more tears.
Vexthra sighed, watching the two sisters from a distance...
’Kent, you must return soon. Your wives need you.’

chapters.title: Chapter 994: The Fourth Floor - Church Of Destruction (8)
paragraphs: "Weaklings"
Sylara’s claw dug into the throat of one of the minions of the demon god of destruction, tearing and pulling his oesophagus out.
"Maybe you are not weak. Maybe it is your god that is weak."

Sylara planned on battling the three Heavenly Ascension stage warriors, but a couple of seconds into their clash, they sensed that Veydris was dangerous, so they ignored her, making the Vampire demoness pissed.
So tapping into her anger, the Spirit Lords and those below were now at her mercy. They outnumbered her by hundreds, but she wasn’t in any way worried.
Sylara’s nature allows her to become her strongest in the presence of blood.
As long as there is blood, she will become nearly invincible. So with blood flowing all around her, both her speed and strength had been amplified.
And with the Blood Hunger seal burning, she was practically burning her life force for strength.
Naturally, she was now several times stronger, and looking at how fast she was moving, by the time her 12-minute power-up runs out, she will kill her fair share.
Veydris, however, was blocked, but as a metallic warrior, no one could read his expression and know how he was faring.

However, one thing was certain: Veydris was out of his league against the three Heavenly Ascension stage warriors facing him. However, he had created the situation where killing him would take considerable time.
Naturally, none of the demon god’s followers knew what was happening to Neomi, and it had already been four minutes since the start of the battle.
Of course, their god could not tell them anything until after 10 minutes. So despite him sensing the presence of a god, he was helpless at the moment.
Neomi sat, and Velyra stood guard behind her, waiting for her goddess to finish with what she was doing.
In the past, she was the saintess of their tribe. She was the one who saw to it that prayers and sacrifices were offered to their goddess, the mother of killers.
Even now, she still believed in her and would forever believe in her.
So standing guard for her was an honour.
Exactly five minutes into the awakening, Neomi opened her eyes, and a wave of divine energy exploded out of her body.
"Praise to Shara, the mother of killers."
Velyra said this with a respectful look on her face.
"You know you don’t have to do that, right? You are my sister."

"I know." Velyra smiled, "However, I want to. Even though I don’t know how, you have helped me on many occasions in the past, and as such, my faith in you has deepened to the point I cannot change who I am just because we are now sisters."
Neomi felt touched hearing such deep words from her sister. She could tell Velyra had complete trust in her, and that alone opened a feeling she never knew she could have for a female.
She walked close to Velyra and gently kissed her forehead.
When she pulled back, a tattoo of two daggers crossed appeared on Velyra’s forehead. Neomi then pressed her finger on Velyra’s forehead and muttered a couple of words.
"For your trust and belief in me, and your dedication to walking the road of killers, I hereby bestow my power on you. Take it and use it to protect those you care about."
In an instant, Velyra felt like she could crush stars with a mere snap of her fingers.
However, a second later, the feeling reduced to her now feeling like she could kill a Spirit King with a mere slap.
"I have given you 80% of my power, but because it is too much for you, I sealed it. You will have access to it when you reach the Spirit King stage.
Use it whenever you want, but don’t use more than 1% within 48 hours, else you will explode."
"This-" Velyra was in shock, unsure of how to handle her new power-up. Tears fell down her face.
Neomi wiped away her tears, then, planting another kiss on her forehead, before looking toward the battlefield.
"Why don’t we fight together while I am still the Mother of Killers?"
"Mmm," Velyra nodded like a little girl meeting Santa for the first time.
Neomi pulled out her two daggers, and Velyra pulled out her sword and charged toward the battlefield.
"Nicely done, Neomi. Though the price you will be paying now will be much steeper," Vexthra said, but she seemed happy about how Neomi handled Velyra.
The two ladies soon arrived on the battlefield, changing the scene.
"Veydris, get on with your task quickly," Neomi ordered, and Veydris vanished into the void. Neomi took his place.

"Killing Circle." She threw her dagger, which circled around her and the three Heavenly Ascension warriors. A red circle formed, and with that, she was locked in with them, only coming out either when she died or she killed them all.
Velyra, however, moved and was soon in front of the church.

The two Heavenly Ascension stage warriors standing guard moved to step toward her. However, before they could reach her, she activated a movement technique that utilized the power of blood, something abundant on the battlefield.
"Swap."

She and Sylara swapped places, and with that, she willed the blood on the ground to fight for her.
"Blood Bullets."
Screams of pain filled the space as thousands of bullets began drawing holes in the demon god’s followers.
Five minutes later, Vexthra smiled.
"This battle is as good as done." She looked up at the sky as if staring at someone. "Oh, what wouldn’t I give to see the constipated look on Balmos’ face right now."𝙛𝓻𝒆𝒆𝒘𝙚𝓫𝙣𝙤𝒗𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
Veydris entered the church and, while he was instructed to destroy the main statue, he started destroying them all.
Soon, however, he arrived before the main target.
In that moment, thunder rocked the heavens, but before it could descend, Veydris severed the head of the statue, cutting off the lightning.
Balmos was a second too late.
It was a coincidence, but Veydris sure made sure the strike happened when Balmos had hope of turning things around.

"I want you to spread this image. Whoever can identify and point us in the right direction will receive 1 million God Crystals and a God-Grade technique of their choice.

Sylara’s claw dug into the throat of one of the minions of the demon god of destruction, tearing and pulling his oesophagus out.
"Maybe you are not weak.
Maybe it is your god that is weak."

Sylara planned on battling the three Heavenly Ascension stage warriors, but a couple of seconds into their clash, they sensed that Veydris was dangerous, so they ignored her, making the Vampire demoness pissed.
So tapping into her anger, the Spirit Lords and those below were now at her mercy.
They outnumbered her by hundreds, but she wasn’t in any way worried.
Sylara’s nature allows her to become her strongest in the presence of blood.
As long as there is blood, she will become nearly invincible.
So with blood flowing all around her, both her speed and strength had been amplified.
And with the Blood Hunger seal burning, she was practically burning her life force for strength.
Naturally, she was now several times stronger, and looking at how fast she was moving, by the time her 12-minute power-up runs out, she will kill her fair share.
Veydris, however, was blocked, but as a metallic warrior, no one could read his expression and know how he was faring.
However, one thing was certain: Veydris was out of his league against the three Heavenly Ascension stage warriors facing him.
However, he had created the situation where killing him would take considerable time.

Of course, their god could not tell them anything until after 10 minutes.
So despite him sensing the presence of a god, he was helpless at the moment.

In the past, she was the saintess of their tribe.

Even now, she still believed in her and would forever believe in her.
So standing guard for her was an honour.

"Praise to Shara, the mother of killers."
Velyra said this with a respectful look on her face.

You are my sister."

Use it whenever you want, but don’t use more than 1% within 48 hours, else you will explode."

chapters.title: Chapter 995: Taming Quest (6)
paragraphs: "Great job, everyone," Vexthra said, walking toward the church of destruction that had now lost its value thanks to her team killing every last member.
"You all have performed remarkably well despite the odds we came against. That is especially true for Neomi, Sylara, and Veydris."
Everyone nodded, knowing the second phase of the battle was won thanks to the three Vexthra mentioned.
Veydris didn’t require these forms of praise simply because he was incapable of feeling emotions or expressing them.
However, Irina seemed to have some ways of making him appear human. So perhaps she would thank him better later.
Vexthra reached into the tower storage and retrieved a set of keys.
Kent gave her permission to do that, so she was able to access the tower storage. The keys she retrieved were the rewards for completing the quest.
They couldn’t use the tower points or the soul essence, so the only thing they were eligible to use was the Limit Breaker Key, which each of them would receive, including Vexthra.
Kent’s wives had already broken nine limits. This meant they were still too far from breaking the 30 limits required of someone in a high world.
There was no limit in a medium world, but considering all factors, the highest a person could achieve in a medium world was 18.
However, with the Limit Breaker Key, they would each move one step closer to that.

The Undead and Eternal Wrath Legion had only broken six each, with Lady Enzi breaking seven and Lady Liora breaking twelve, simply because she was from a high world and had only been suppressed by the rules of a medium world.
"These are Limit Breaker Keys. Just press them against your forehead, and a limit will be broken for you."
To Kent’s wives and his legion, this was normal to them, but to Lady Enzi and Liora, it felt like they had just heard something very ridiculous.
Vexthra saw their expressions and smiled, "Welcome to Kent’s world, where the impossible is just a normal word for us."
The two ladies smiled, unsure of how to handle this. In the end, they each swore to never leave Kent’s side.
Naturally, Vexthra saw this and knew they were cooked.
’Lucky bastard. Even without opening his mouth, he had locked down two beauties.’ Vexthra smirked.
Sneeze
’Somebody clearly is annoyed with me at the moment,’ Kent said inwardly as he flew beside Sylvara and Orvath.
’If I didn’t know better, I would say Vexthra is plotting against me. I’d better reward her well when I go back.’
After saying that, Kent drew his attention to the vast lava lake that had appeared in the distance. Its surface was covered in blooming violet flames, almost like lotus flowers.
"Beautiful," Kent muttered, and Sylvara smirked.

"The Inferno Lake is indeed beautiful. Too bad the owner is a bitch," Sylvara said, making sure Kent knew she had no plans on playing nice with Zeraphine, who she knew was already aware they were coming.
Kent laughed and then assured her that nothing would happen between him and this Lotus Empress.
Orvath didn’t say much, but even with his bull mind, he could tell the relationship between Kent and Sylvara was more than that of a master and his tamed beast.
To him, getting to awaken his Innate Beast Body one day was the goal; what Sylvara does with her body is none of his business.
After three hours, they finally entered the Inferno Lake.
However, they came to a stop as soon as they entered the area. A person was blocking their path with a smug smile on her face.
Kent raised his brow, seeing the ethereal beauty with violet hair cascading like flame petals. She had lotus markings glowing on her skin, almost like tattoos.
She wore a smug smile as she hovered before them.
"Orvath darling, why did you bring these two to my domain?" Zeraphine asked, her violet eyes gleaming with mischief.
Kent instantly felt something was amiss. However, he remained cool and prepared inwardly for anything.
Orvath looked at the Lotus Empress and sighed, "This is Lord Kent. He had me escort him here because he has something to discuss with you."
"Oh, I never expected the great Orvath to address a mere human as a Lord." Zeraphine smirked, "Makes me wonder what this bitch calls him."
Sylvara’s gaze turned cold, hearing the plain disrespect. However, before she could snap, Kent placed his hand on her shoulder and smiled.
"She is not worth it, dear. She thinks positioning Kaelith 20 kilometers away would make any difference."
Zeraphine’s gaze turned cold when she heard what Kent said.
"Kill him."
Before Orvath and Sylvara could react, a streak of blue light flashed and appeared before Kent.
"No."
They reached out, but the light moved and slammed into the violet sea, and Kent was gone.
"KENT!"
Sylvara’s aura exploded, pushing Orvath and Zeraphine several kilometers back. She transformed into her beast form and dove into the sea of flames.
"What?"
Zeraphine’s eyes widened when she saw Sylvara’s beast form. However, before she could do anything, Orvath blocked her path.
"You may have just cost yourself a chance to awaken your Innate Beast Body."
Zeraphine’s heartbeat slowed down as a regretful expression appeared on her face. However, it was already too late to take any action.
Meanwhile, deep underground, Kaelith held Kent by the throat as they moved several feet down.
A couple of days ago, when Kent used his bloodline, Kaelith, who was rather infatuated with Zeraphine, decided to come and make sure she was alright.
In the past, whenever he visited Zeraphine’s domain, he would either leave with flame attacks coming at him or Zeraphine would outright ignore him.

However, this time, when he arrived, Zeraphine gave him an offer he couldn’t resist. With Zeraphine’s power, she knew the danger that she felt would soon come to her, so she asked Kaelith to kill Kent for her, and in return, she would allow him to visit her domain once every year.
The simp Kaelith accepted her offer, and so he lay in wait for when Kent would arrive.
Now, he had gotten his hand on the person who would secure him a chance to spend a full day with the one he loved.
However, as they moved deeper into the lava pool, Kaelith couldn’t help feeling like Kent was mocking him. After all, a smirk tugged on the corner of Kent’s lips.
Even by beast standards, that was clear provocation.
"What is funny, human?" Kaelith asked.
"Nothing," Kent replied, still maintaining his smirk.
"Then why do you have the smirk on your face?"
"Oh, this," Kent pointed at his smirk, and then he pointed behind Kaelith, "It is because of that."
Kaelith turned his back only to see a magnificent snake speeding toward him.
He had no time to react before a hand slapped him across the face.
Sylvara, who used her beast form to close the distance much faster, transformed into her human form and landed a slap that sent Kaelith flying several miles away.
Kent was yanked from his grip when the slap landed on his face, so Sylvara caught him.
"Are you okay? Are you hurt? Did he do something to you..."
Sylvara asked a series of questions, a worried look on her face as she examined to see if Kent was hurt in any way.
Kent could only smile and kiss her to tell her he was fine. However, seeing how overprotective Sylvara had become, his heart melted.
"I am fine, my love... I knew you would come to my rescue, so I wasn’t worried."
Sylvara smiles cutely, and a blush appears on her cheek...

chapters.title: Chapter 996: Taming Quest (7) [Bonus]
paragraphs: BOOM
The lotus flame lake exploded, and two people appeared.
Kent was seated on Sylvara’s crowded head as they appeared from the lake.
Right when they appeared, Sylvara turned back to her human form and held Kent by the hand as they walked toward Orvath, still blocking Zeraphine.
BOOM
The sea of flames exploded again, and Kaelith, with a handprint on his face, appeared, his bloodshot eyes locked on Sylvara.
However, that changed when he met Kent’s gaze.
In an instant, his demeanor shifted from anger to fear.
"You will do well to not try that ever again. Trust me, if I want you dead, you will be dead by now," Kent said, his tone cold.
Zeraphine felt her spine shudder at the sound of such cold words. Even though Kent wasn’t talking to her, she felt like the warning concerned her, too.

"I am sorry, Lord Kent, I was stupid and didn’t recognise your greatness, causing me to do the stupid thing I did," Zeraphine said, her expression calm, though one could tell she meant every last word she said.
"I was stupid for looking down on you. Please forgive me and my companion."
She was the one who dragged Kaelith into this mess after all. However, even Kaelith held his head down, not daring to look Kent in the eyes.

Kent hadn’t yet absorbed the Blood essence he gathered; however, he had already formed 33,000 flame veins. That alone was enough to exert a pressure that made even the two monarchs feel like they were being gazed at by a predator.

"Under normal circumstances, I wouldn’t have easily forgiven you two; however, today I am in a good mood and also here to ask for your help, so I will let this slide. However, there will be no next time."
Of course, there will be no next time. After all, once they have been tamed, rebelling is something they will never be able to do again.
"Thank you for your generosity, Lord Kent," Zeraphine said, and Kaelith bowed toward Kent.
This time, they had escaped a grave danger.
"If Lord Kent has something he needs, he can tell us. We will do our very best to help him with it," Kaelith said, not daring to sound arrogant.
Of course, he managed to catch Kent simply because even with Kent’s speed, he was too slow to react.
The Azure Flame Roc Monarch is the fastest in the flame sea, so it will be a disgrace if he can’t even catch Kent when he had the advantage.
Zeraphine’s plan was for Kent to be taken away and killed by Kaelith, while she would handle Sylvara.
However, she failed to put Orvath in the equation. If she had made provisions for him, perhaps things would have been different.
However, now that they saw the danger both Kent and Sylvara posed, both of them could only thank their lucky stars for delivering them from grave danger this time.

"I came here today to take you two in as my subordinates. In return, I will awaken your Innate Beast Bodies, some other innate abilities, send you to a good Immortal world suitable for beasts, and so much more.
All that is required of you is to help hold back the subordinates of the Planet King while I attack and kill him."
Kaelith looked at Zeraphine, who also stared at him before turning to Kent...
Kent is already aware of what is running through their mind. They want to know if he can really kill the planet king.

"You two shouldn’t worry about whether or not I can kill the planet king. I already have a plan to contain and kill him. The only thing I need is for you to hold back the planet King’s subordinates, and I will handle the rest.
However, for that to work, your two guards and three rulers must also become my subordinates."

If there is anything preventing them from accepting this offer, then the fact that they both saw Sylvara had awakened her innate beast body was already enough to tell them Kent had helped her, and so he can also help them.
However, the idea of becoming Kent’s subordinates just to help him fight against someone they have been hiding from all these years made them hesitate for a moment.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝚠𝚎𝚋𝗻𝗼𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝚘𝐦
’Since he only needs us to fight the subordinates of the Planet King, then there is no need to fear. At best, I can always run if he deceives us,’ Kaelith said inwardly.
His speed is the fastest among the seven monarchs, so running is his strongest ability.
After a few internal struggles, Kent added two more monarchs to his Taming bracelet and activated the three benefits.
This instantly changed the way the two monarchs saw Kent.
Awakening Innate Talent ability, each from just forming a soul contract with him, had awarded them with something many beasts go their entire lifetime without ever awakening half of it.
Their trust level moved from the initial 5% to 20% after receiving the boosts and the Innate Talent Ability.
"Gather your subordinates; I will be adding them too."
"Lord Kent, my domain is just 1 day from here. However, if I were to carry you, we would get there within 6 hours," Kaelith said, and Kent nodded.
"Then, after adding Zeraphine’s subordinates, we will head to your domain."
"Okay."
Ten hours later, Kent was done adding the five subordinates under Zeraphine. He gave them the task of gathering the ingredients for the Soul Strengthening and Limit Breaker Pills.
After that was done, along with Zeraphine, Sylvara, and Orvath, they left and headed to Kaelith’s domain.
Along the way, a message appeared before Kent’s vision telling him something he had been waiting for...
⟪You can form your flame core after reaching 35,000 flame veins. Current Flame veins: 33,800⟫
’I am almost there.’ Kent smiled.
He knew forming the core was the next objective, since it was one of the reasons he had come to the past.
’Once the core is formed, I will leave this place and go to Planet Solaryn, where the Pill Ascension trial will take place.
That will take a month. Once back, I will find a place where I can kill more beasts and earn enough blood essence and blood itself to form my blood core gate.’
Kent sighed, then an idea popped into his mind. He turns to Sylvara, Orvath, and Zeraphine and asks.

However, the reason why it is a place even beasts like me would love to go is because of the Primordial Flames."
"Primordial flames?" Kent was stunned.

He had heard of this flame before. It was during one of his vacations with Elina during the Primordial Era. However, back then, he only heard that two empires were at war because of a primordial flame.

This time, he wanted to learn more, and thankfully, Zeraphine wouldn’t be able to lie to him.
"Tell me all you know."

chapters.title: Chapter 997: Taming Quest (8) [Bonus]
paragraphs: Zeraphine became excited.
She knew helping Kent would earn her some brownie points.
After all, their first meeting wasn’t exactly ideal.
So this is her chance to atone for her sins.
Thankfully, although Sylvara knew something about Primordial Flames, she chose to let the Lotus Empress have her moment.
Kent had already said this is now one big family, and as such, she knew she and Zeraphine would be fighting on the same side, so becoming friends was the best move now.
She also recognised Zeraphine’s ability to gather information.

Because of her nature as a plant, the plants around her are her eyes and ears. So, provided she wanted to, with her strength level, listening or spying on people 100,000 km away wouldn’t be too hard for her.

She is a valuable asset, and, as someone who wants to ensure her man has all he needs, Sylvara chose to be the bigger person and let Zeraphine win Kent’s trust, cementing her position as the spy in their family.
"Primordial Flames are the True Flames of existence," Zeraphine began. "It is said that when the universe was created, they came with it.

Of course, you already know we have four other flames, namely Elemental Flame, like my Violet Lotus Flame." She lit her flame, showing it to Kent. He was already aware of this since Sylvara had already shown him hers.
"The second being Soul Flames. These flames are, in a way, Elemental Flames, so in most cases, we combine the two and call it Elemental Soul Flame.

The third being the Flame Spirits, which, at a fundamental level, can be called Living Flames. Of course, if a flame, regardless of its nature, had lived for long, it could gain sentience and become a living flame.

However, we both know the easiest way to attain flame is to absorb a flame spirit. The moment one absorbs a flame spirit, they can no longer increase in tiers. Unless, of course, they get a much higher-tier flame spirit and absorb that too.
However, as for the fourth flame, many say it exists, but I have never seen it before.
Of course, from what I know, there are only nine of them. They are called the Nine Nirvana Flames."
Kent and Sylvara smiled, causing Zeraphine to wonder just what the two were smiling about.
However, she chose not to say anything and instead focused on her work, which involved informing Kent of everything there was to know about the Primordial Flame.

"As for the Primordial Flames, they are said to have given birth to the Elemental Flames, Soul Flames, and Flame Spirits, meaning absorbing them will not only strengthen these three flames but will also evolve them into a stronger form, which, from what I know, will enable one to own a Primordial Flame.
This means absorbing it into your Soul Flames turns it into Primordial Soul Flame.
Of course, you can choose to absorb it as a new flame, which, from what I know, requires one to have the foundation to absorb a second flame."
"How about absorbing it into Nirvana Flames?" Kent asked, and Zeraphine smiled.
"Unfortunately, I don’t know that. However, know that Nirvana Flames can’t be tampered with, so adding a Primordial Flame might be a disaster."
Zeraphine paused and asked, "Does Lord Kent have Nirvana Flames?"
"My answer will depend on what you can tell me about the Primordial Flames. I believe you still haven’t said everything."
"Indeed," Zeraphine didn’t even hide anything. However, because of the connection between them, Kent knew she was holding something back.
"Primordial Flames come in many forms. Some come as beasts, some as humans, some as weapons. There are some that even come as an entire planet.
However, from what I know of the Pill Ascension Realm, most of these Primordial Spirits are dormant, meaning they pose no threat.
However, they are guarded by powerful beasts that even we monarchs can’t confidently say we will be able to contend with.
However, these flames are the easiest to get since killing the beast guardian will be enough to take them, and absorbing them is also simple since they are dormant.
However, most dormant Primordial Flames are only low-grade."
"How many grades do we have?" Kent asked.
"There are five grades, or at least that is what I know. We have: Low, Medium, High, Supreme, and Celestial."
"I see." Kent processed the information he had just received, and a look of determination appeared on his face.
’If I form my core using even a sliver of Primordial Flame, then who knows what will become of my flame core.’
Kent felt his Nirvana Flames grow excited when he thought of this.
’I have made up my mind. I will add a Primordial Flame to the core formation process. Hopefully, I don’t explode from the sheer power I will be loading into my core.’
"Lord Kent should know that even a low-grade Primordial Flame can cause an entire planet to chase after you, so for your safety, allow us to accompany you."
"No need to sugarcoat it, Zeraphine. Naturally, I plan on taking you all along. If you can obtain a Primordial Flame, then I believe your strength will skyrocket."
Zeraphine smiled, wearing a guilty expression. However, hearing Kent’s words, she became extremely happy. Even Sylvara, Orvath, and Kaelith were the same.
Obtaining a Primordial Flame is something they wouldn’t pass up on.
Kent then asked a new question.

"Aside from the Flame Sea, are there other places with beasts that I can go hunting?" Although Kent could go ahead and hunt the beasts in the Flame Sea, he knew they were subordinates of his newly tamed beasts, so he wouldn’t do that.
This meant the next best option was to find a new place for hunting.
"There is indeed a place which, from what I know, even rivals this place," Zeraphine said. "It is called Savage Region. It is smaller than this place, but it has some of the savage beasts out there.
There are no regions there, so once you enter, you will be surrounded on all sides."
Zeraphine sighed, turning toward Sylvara, who nodded toward her. "Tell him."
"Also, there is an existence hidden in the Savage Region that even we wouldn’t dare offend. To tell you the truth, the most dangerous place is the Savage Region, not the Flame Sea.
Every last beast there is a danger that I wouldn’t recommend you to hunt."
"Sounds like the perfect place to form my core gate." Kent smiled, causing his new subordinates to shake their heads, feeling like their new boss was about to put them in danger.
However, Kent’s next words wiped away their worry and replaced it with a new concern: worrying about him.
"I plan on going there alone, so don’t worry about facing dangers beyond you."
"I will go with you whether you like it or not," Sylvara said, holding his hand against her chest.
Kent just smiled but said nothing. He knew that with the Pill Ascension secret now in his grasp, completing the quest of killing the Planet King would be easy enough.
’I really hope there are more Primordial Flames for all 50 beasts I will be taming, and even some for Lilian, who is waiting for me back in the future.’
After 6 hours, they arrived in Kaelith’s domain, and 4 hours later, he added the beasts to his taming bracelet, and they left for their next destination, which was ruled by the 3rd strongest monarch.
Balrion, the Crimson Flame Titan Monarch.
He is the overlord of the Molten Abyss.

chapters.title: Chapter 998: Taming Quest (9) [Bonus]
paragraphs: BOOM
Kent was hurled like a rag doll, slamming into a mountain 3 miles away.
ROAR

A towering giant of molten rock, with rivers of lava flowing across its body, roars, shaking the very ground beneath it. Its body seems to have been formed from the ground; however, that is not the case.
Just like with Orvath, whose flame can turn solid and form into armor, Balrion can also solidify his flame using it to augment his beast form.
But that isn’t all: aside from solidifying his flame, he can also increase the weight, making his fist a deadly armament.
Kent, along with Sylvara, Kaelith, Zeraphine, and Orvath, had just arrived in the Molten Abyss, and as they expected, Balrion was waiting for them.
Kent, of course, tried to reason with him, but Balrion said that if he could last 20 minutes with him, he would willingly become his subordinate.
Naturally, Kent knew he was on his own, so he faced him only to be sent flying like a doll.
"Damn, you punch like a mountain," Kent burst out of the mountain, his clothes torn to shreds. Thankfully, it is a soul item, so it started to repair itself.
"However, I am no pushover."
34,000 flame veins activated, and Kent’s strength rose severalfold.
"Again."
He moved, his tiny fist armed at Balrion’s own large fist.
"BOOM"
This time, instead of being sent flying, Kent was only pushed back 400 meters, and Balrion moved back 3 steps.
"Interesting. You managed to push me back." Balrion seemed to recognise Kent’s strength, making him happy.
"I am no weakling, Balrion." Kent wiped a trace of blood from the corner of his mouth and looked at Balrion, who gave him a nod of recognition.
"In that case, why don’t we have a good battle?" At once, his 16-meter height was reduced to just 2 meters.
"I have compressed my height, which in no way has affected my strength. So be ready; things will become more lively now."
Kent laughed. "In that case, let me also get ready." The gauntlet Kent bought when he was preparing to assassinate the members of the Blue Flame Pill Palace appeared, and he put it on.
"I am ready," he said.
"Then let’s have a good battle."

Kent moved, and Balrion also moved, clashing in the air. The void cracked where the first impact happened, but it closed the next second as they started moving at top speed, landing devastating blows on each other.
"Hahahaha... I have never been this alive in the thousands of years I have lived," Balrion’s voice boomed as he landed a punch on Kent’s chest, only for Kent’s fist to also connect with his ribcage.
Both were pushed back, but they clashed again the next second.
"I also feel alive, though I have only lived for 21 years..." Kent’s laughter filled the air as he was sent slamming into the ground.
A large crater was formed, but the next second, he shot back up, and the duel between brutes only seemed to intensify.
"Brutes, they never know when to stop," Sylvara muttered, watching as Kent’s body started getting injured in many places, yet he showed no sign of backing down.
Balrion also had some cuts, but because his skin was made of stone, no blood seemed to be coming out. However, molten lava seemed to be seeping out from where he was being hurt.
Orvath looked at Sylvara and shook his head. "You are not a brute, so you wouldn’t understand. But we brutes actually see this as training. The more we are pounded, the stronger we become."
"Even worse, why would one wish to go through this just for strength?" Clearly, Sylvara was worried about Kent, who wasn’t using his dragon bloodline.
This limited his strength, making him weaker than Balrion. However, she also knew this was what Kent wanted, and as such, she could only hope he walked out safely in the end.
’Then again, on the brighter side, with him hurt, I would have to take care of him.’
With this thought, she saw that perhaps the brutes aren’t muscle-headed after all.
Thirty minutes later, Kent and Balrion were injured to the point they needed to relax and heal.
"Hahahahahaha..." Balrion and Kent burst out laughing, almost like they had known each other for years now.
"Best day of my life," Balrion said, sitting down to heal.
"Me too," Kent said, also sitting down. "I never expected to meet someone whose dedication to the path of Body Cultivation runs this deep."
"I am still a tad behind you, who has already attained the Nirvana Body."

"True, but I never really paid much attention to my body cultivation. However, today, you have enlightened me." Kent waved his hand, and green flames surrounded his body. He then did the same, and it surrounded Balrion.
When Zeraphine saw this, her eyes narrowed.
"Is that..." She turned to Sylvara, who smiled at her before speaking.
"That is indeed Nirvana flames."
"No way," she said, her eyes sparkling as she finally saw a Nirvana flame for the first time ever.
"Trust me, he is much more impressive than you think," Sylvara said, making sure her man’s image was further painted bright in Zeraphine and the two other monarchs listening to her.
"I guess attempting to kill him was my mistake."
"That was indeed stupid. Trust me, if he wanted, he would have killed you before you realised what happened," Sylvara said, causing Orvath and Kaelith to focus more on her.
"Was it him we felt days ago?" Kaelith asked, and Sylvara nodded.
"He came asking me to become his tame beast. However, I attacked him with over 40 Tier 19 beasts only to lose almost half of my force, and I was completely suppressed.
Even in my beast form, I couldn’t do anything."
The three Monarchs turned and looked at Kent, who was laughing with Balrion.
"Maybe he can indeed kill that abomination," Orvath said, and the rest nodded.
"So you really believe you can kill that bastard?" Balrion asked, having now heard why Kent sought his help.
"I am. I just want you and the others to hold back his subordinates for at least an hour."
"Don’t worry, we will do more than hold them back."
Kent smiled, feeling like he had just found his long-lost brother. Their spirit level was the same, showing just how much they were getting along.
’Kaizo is going to have a blast with him.’

Five hours later, all wounds, both internal and external, were healed. He went ahead and added six subordinates from Balrion, and then, with his newly gained allies, he sent them to look for the ingredients for the pills.
He had already received reports from the others that they had found some of the ingredients. Not all had been found yet, but they were still searching, so it was only a matter of time.
"Fascinating," Balrion observed Sylvara’s innate beast body with a smile on his face. "Once I awaken my innate beast body, not even Ignarok can match me physically."
"That is true," Kent said. "After all, you are a true Body Cultivator. It is only a matter of time before you reach a level only a few immortals could measure up to."
After spending some time handling some minor business, Balrion joined the voyage and began heading to the Eternal Nest, where Vey, the phoenix queen, lives.

"However, I am no pushover."
34,000 flame veins activated, and Kent’s strength rose severalfold.
"Again."
He moved, his tiny fist armed at Balrion’s own large fist.
"BOOM"
This time, instead of being sent flying, Kent was only pushed back 400 meters, and Balrion moved back 3 steps.
"Interesting.
You managed to push me back." Balrion seemed to recognise Kent’s strength, making him happy.
"I am no weakling, Balrion." Kent wiped a trace of blood from the corner of his mouth and looked at Balrion, who gave him a nod of recognition.
"In that case, why don’t we have a good battle?" At once, his 16-meter height was reduced to just 2 meters.
"I have compressed my height, which in no way has affected my strength.
So be ready; things will become more lively now."
Kent laughed.
"In that case, let me also get ready." The gauntlet Kent bought when he was preparing to assassinate the members of the Blue Flame Pill Palace appeared, and he put it on.
"I am ready," he said.
"Then let’s have a good battle."
Kent moved, and Balrion also moved, clashing in the air.
The void cracked where the first impact happened, but it closed the next second as they started moving at top speed, landing devastating blows on each other.
"Hahahaha...
I have never been this alive in the thousands of years I have lived," Balrion’s voice boomed as he landed a punch on Kent’s chest, only for Kent’s fist to also connect with his ribcage.
Both were pushed back, but they clashed again the next second.
"I also feel alive, though I have only lived for 21 years..." Kent’s laughter filled the air as he was sent slamming into the ground.
A large crater was formed, but the next second, he shot back up, and the duel between brutes only seemed to intensify.
"Brutes, they never know when to stop," Sylvara muttered, watching as Kent’s body started getting injured in many places, yet he showed no sign of backing down.
Balrion also had some cuts, but because his skin was made of stone, no blood seemed to be coming out.
However, molten lava seemed to be seeping out from where he was being hurt.
Orvath looked at Sylvara and shook his head.
"You are not a brute, so you wouldn’t understand.
But we brutes actually see this as training.
The more we are pounded, the stronger we become."
"Even worse, why would one wish to go through this just for strength?" Clearly, Sylvara was worried about Kent, who wasn’t using his dragon bloodline.
This limited his strength, making him weaker than Balrion.
However, she also knew this was what Kent wanted, and as such, she could only hope he walked out safely in the end.
’Then again, on the brighter side, with him hurt, I would have to take care of him.’
With this thought, she saw that perhaps the brutes aren’t muscle-headed after all.
Thirty minutes later, Kent and Balrion were injured to the point they needed to relax and heal.
"Hahahahahaha..." Balrion and Kent burst out laughing, almost like they had known each other for years now.
"Best day of my life," Balrion said, sitting down to heal.
"Me too," Kent said, also sitting down.
"I never expected to meet someone whose dedication to the path of Body Cultivation runs this deep."
"I am still a tad behind you, who has already attained the Nirvana Body."
"True, but I never really paid much attention to my body cultivation.
However, today, you have enlightened me." Kent waved his hand, and green flames surrounded his body.
He then did the same, and it surrounded Balrion.
When Zeraphine saw this, her eyes narrowed.
"Is that..." She turned to Sylvara, who smiled at her before speaking.
"That is indeed Nirvana flames."
"No way," she said, her eyes sparkling as she finally saw a Nirvana flame for the first time ever.
"Trust me, he is much more impressive than you think," Sylvara said, making sure her man’s image was further painted bright in Zeraphine and the two other monarchs listening to her.
"I guess attempting to kill him was my mistake."
"That was indeed stupid.
Trust me, if he wanted, he would have killed you before you realised what happened," Sylvara said, causing Orvath and Kaelith to focus more on her.
"Was it him we felt days ago?" Kaelith asked, and Sylvara nodded.
"He came asking me to become his tame beast.
However, I attacked him with over 40 Tier 19 beasts only to lose almost half of my force, and I was completely suppressed.
Even in my beast form, I couldn’t do anything."
The three Monarchs turned and looked at Kent, who was laughing with Balrion.
"Maybe he can indeed kill that abomination," Orvath said, and the rest nodded.
"So you really believe you can kill that bastard?" Balrion asked, having now heard why Kent sought his help.
"I am.
I just want you and the others to hold back his subordinates for at least an hour."
"Don’t worry, we will do more than hold them back."
Kent smiled, feeling like he had just found his long-lost brother.
Their spirit level was the same, showing just how much they were getting along.
’Kaizo is going to have a blast with him.’
Five hours later, all wounds, both internal and external, were healed.
He went ahead and added six subordinates from Balrion, and then, with his newly gained allies, he sent them to look for the ingredients for the pills.
He had already received reports from the others that they had found some of the ingredients.
Not all had been found yet, but they were still searching, so it was only a matter of time.
"Fascinating," Balrion observed Sylvara’s innate beast body with a smile on his face.
"Once I awaken my innate beast body, not even Ignarok can match me physically."
"That is true," Kent said.
"After all, you are a true Body Cultivator.
It is only a matter of time before you reach a level only a few immortals could measure up to."
After spending some time handling some minor business, Balrion joined the voyage and began heading to the Eternal Nest, where Vey, the phoenix queen, lives.

chapters.title: Chapter 999: Taming Quest (10)
paragraphs: "Balrion, I was told you are the only Monarch who has some form of relationship with the Phoenix Queen. Care to share some pointers on her behaviour?"
Kent asked, sitting on Kaelith’s back as they headed toward Vey’s domain.
Balrion had now taken on his human form, which was that of a bronze-skinned warrior with volcanic eyes. He has rather solid muscles and a completely bald head.
However, he was not that scary for a beast whose entire form was made of rocks.
In his human form, he wields a warhammer that can split almost anything. Kent was quite impressed with how robust his human form is.
"I wouldn’t say I have a relationship with her, since she is just dislikable," Balrion smiled. "However, I have interacted with her in the past and can say she is a feisty one.
Also, among us seven, she is the only one who can go to the human worlds without worry, so she has more knowledge of your worlds than any of us.
This means convincing her will be impossible unless you have something that can even make a prideful phoenix like Vey impressed or extremely afraid."
Kent smirked, already aware of how annoying phoenixes can be.
He himself is a dragon, or even if he wasn’t a full dragon yet, he had once been a dragon and knew how his kind hated phoenixes.

Kent knew things wouldn’t go well if he showed his dragon form, so he planned to use his knowledge of the human world to entice her. However, learning that she could go to the human world made him change his plans.
"Do you have any idea how she manages to go to the human world without the humans noticing?"
Kent had already asked Sylvara why she and her kind never tried leaving the Flame Sea, considering they could take on near-perfect human form.

He found out that a formation had been placed around the entirety of the Cosima, which not only dampens their cultivation by one level if they try to leave but also transforms them back into their beast form.
Of course, beastkins from outside the flame sea can come and go without any issue; however, this formation was coded specifically to affect her kind, making it nearly impossible to leave.
All beasts in the flame sea cannot leave.
It was also one of the many reasons why they were hostile to humans and other adventurers who came to their world.
They also had a way of identifying outsiders, just as humans can do to them, unless, of course, they were tamed by humans.
However, Vey could come and go as she pleased. This piqued Kent’s interest, so he wanted to learn more about it.
Balrion rubbed his bald head. "I am not sure how she was able to achieve that. However, Vey has an ability that allows her to take on the appearance of those she kills.

Though her aura will still be that of a phoenix, I am sure the formation wouldn’t be able to flag her. She may have other means, but I am sure this also contributes to her uncanny ability to come and go as she pleases."
"I see." Kent could already see that what Balrion said was the case. However, with his knowledge in disguise, he knew there was more to what he said, and he intended to find out.
Five days later, a canyon of cracked volcanic ridges appeared in their view. Kent could see golden flames rising from nests of molten stone and falling in a cataclysmic display of beauty and danger.
"Vey has one of the most dangerous domains in the Flame Sea," Sylvara said, "however, if you have the heart and will to venture there, then your gains will be bountiful."
"How so?" Kent asked.
"The flame in this region is for healing. Also, it is for destroying. Those who can cultivate here can gain either a healing aspect or a destruction aspect from the flame. Some even both.
However, due to these aspects, both Vey and her subordinates are almost immortal. Some, including Vey, even have the ability to rise from the ashes after you kill them.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝙚𝔀𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝒐𝒎
This is mostly why, when they sense they are near death, they choose to explode their core, mainly to take their opponents with them," Sylvara smirked.
"Nasty birds, if you ask me," Zeraphine added, causing Kent to laugh. He could already tell why Vey was the second strongest.
Exploding her core can kill any of them, Kent included. But because of her unique flame, she will rise back from the ashes, only losing a stage on her cultivation base.
Kent was quite impressed by all he heard about the next Monarch on his list.
"Looks like she is expecting us," Kent said, gesturing for Kaelith to slow down.
Even from a distance, Kent could see how gorgeous she looked. Sylvara’s eyes narrowed when she saw the slender woman staring at them from afar.
"How I want to punch her face right now."
Kent smiled, "Relax, Sylvara, she is going to be your sister soon, so learn to accept her as one of you."
"Tch, as if anyone wants her in their family." She turned her back on Vey, who, thanks to her enhanced eyesight, could clearly see Sylvara.
"My dear Sylvy, why are you turning your back on me?"
Vey asked, her golden hair flowing in the air. Thanks to her clothing choice, Kent could see her slender legs and round butt showing from her not-too-large but extremely attractive hips.
Her chest was also bouncy, with nipples clearly showing in her leather tank top. Her flat tummy was bare, and her thighs were fully exposed.
Even her cameltoe was on full display in her tight leather jeans, causing Kent to narrow his eyes when he saw that.
Kent placed his hand on Sylvara’s waist and pulled her closer to himself. Then, allowing Vey to see, he gave her ass a firm squeeze.
Vey’s eyes narrowed, and golden flames rose from behind her, forming into a bow.
"I wouldn’t do that, lady," Kent said, also raising his hand.
A black flame instantly appeared, causing the monarchs around to feel a sense of dread. They stepped back despite knowing Kent wasn’t aiming at them.
The flame solidified, forming a spear.
Vey’s eyes narrowed further, a cold sweat forming on her forehead.
"Nirvana flames," she muttered, but every last monarch heard. They turned and looked at the black spear.
"Just a mere drop of it, but yes, it is indeed a Nirvana flame. The Umbral Flame of Oblivion, which I think we both know, if I attack with it, your death will be slow and agonizing."

Kent waved his hand, and the spear dissolved, taking away the dreadful feeling. "So why don’t you invite us to your home and listen to what I am here for first before you decide on dying this hot afternoon?"
Being threatened by a flame of Nirvana, and the Umbral Flame of Oblivion at that, only a fool would dare challenge it.
Vey was no idiot. She might have been arrogant, prideful, and annoying, but she was no fool. She recognized the danger and decided not to throw her life away.
’Mother said the Umbral Flame of Oblivion is a counter for Golden Life and Death Flame. If I were to die from its attack, there would be no rebirth for me.’
Vey gulped and then waved her bow out of existence.
Kent smiled and then, holding Sylvara’s hands, he told Kaelith to move. Soon, they entered Vey’s domain. She led them to her home, which was a huge mansion made from golden stones tempered in flames.
"Luxurious, huh?"
Right when they stepped in, Kent could feel dozens of Flame Veins forming. Also, he received a rather interesting message that instantly put a smile on his face.
⟪Your Verdant Flame of Renewal is absorbing a tremendously large sum of Flame Essence⟫

chapters.title: Chapter 1000: Taming Quest (11)
paragraphs: Kent cracked his brain on how to handle Vey, the Phoenix queen.
Initially, he wanted to use his knowledge of the outside world to win her over.
Everybody knows the Phoenix Race prides themselves when it comes to their good looks. They are creatures who focus more on their appearance than on correcting their foul character.
So he planned to use beauty products from the human world to win her over. Sadly, he found out she can travel to the human world and back, meaning she already has those.
Naturally, that was a low blow to Kent.
The most harmless way possible, which he wanted to use to get what he wanted, turned out to be useless.
However, that doesn’t mean he couldn’t use other means too.
One method he wanted to use was asking Sylvara to display her Beast body. However, he wiped that idea, knowing Sylvara hated Vey for one of two reasons.
Vey has a crush on her.

This was like an insult to Sylvara, who is a serpent. Her nature compels her to resist such things. Perhaps it is genetic, but serpents are known to be sexually active beasts who like to be pampered by their mate.
Being hit on by a lady insulted her ego, so Kent chose not to put her through that torture. With the last harmless option gone, Kent began to think.
All his options that guaranteed both safety and peace were gone; however, it also forced him to think creatively.
His creativity led him to understand something about Vey’s flame.
The Golden Flame of Life and Death is similar to the Verdant Flame of Renewal. They both heal, just that the death aspect of the Golden Flame is bad for the Verdant Flame of Renewal.
So Kent thought, what if he also found a way to cancel both the life and death aspects of her Golden Flame?
That was when the answer he sought came to him in the form of another nirvana flame. The Umbral Flame of Oblivion is the answer, and with that, he was able to suppress Vey.
The Umbral Flame of Oblivion is dangerous and very destructive. It burns slowly and inflicts agonizing pain, so he knew that was the answer.
Now, Kent could only smile as he sat in a lotus posture, feeling his Verdant Flame of Renewal grow stronger by the second.
’Turns out the healing factor of the flame in this domain is like food to my Nirvana Flames,’ Kent said inwardly.
’Makes me wonder what will become of my Nirvana Flames once I locate the true seeds and absorb them.’
Even now, without knowing how or when, he could tell the Nirvana Flames were a part of him in his past life as Chaos.
So he could only bide his time and slowly rise until he could get to them yet again and continue from where they left off.
Vey held a close look at Kent, who remained still, feeling his strength surge.
After an hour, he looked at Vey and asked, "When did you come into contact with a Nirvana Flame?"
"I didn’t," Vey answered, feeling annoyed that she couldn’t bring herself to act arrogant. If she isn’t afraid of the monarch glaring at her, then two people are making her restless.
One of them is, of course, Kent, who, despite being a Core Formation brat, the danger coming from him keeps making her feel like death was staring at her.
The second being Sylvara, whom she just couldn’t wrap her mind around, how that was possible.
The Sylvara she knew wasn’t weak, but she wasn’t strong to the point that she could make her hair stand on end. In that case, then why is she feeling this restless?
Kent smiled, hearing her answer, "I am no idiot, Vey. I have nine Nirvana Flames, so I know I can smell the Radiant Flame of Purity on you."
"I really haven’t been in contact with a Nirvana Flame until today. However, I once came into contact with something that had traces of Nirvana Flames."
"Oh." Kent’s interest was piqued. "Do tell."
Vey decided to spill the beans, after all, she had already invited the annoying human, and hearing he had all nine Nirvana Flames piqued her interest too.
"When I was young, my mother won a map in an auction. According to her, this map leads to the location of a Nirvana Flame seed. Now I know it is the Radiant Flame of Purity.
I only came into contact with it when my mom, in an attempt to locate this place, vanished without a trace."
"Wait... She went looking without the map?" Sylvara suddenly asked, and Vey shook her head.
"The map was too valuable, so she made a copy, leaving the real one behind." Vey turned to Kent and said, "The aura you felt came from this."

A leather that doesn’t seem to be a leather but more like a soft metallic material appeared in her hand. The moment Kent saw it, his eyes turned white, causing the Radiant Flame of Purity to ooze from his eyes.
Everyone around Kent felt their bodies lighten, almost as if they were being cleansed. The feeling was rather pleasant; however, it vanished when Kent’s eyes returned to their unusual purple hue.
He waved his hand, and the map flew into his hand.
"It’s indeed a map leading to a Nirvana Flame. I can sense it," Kent muttered, causing Vey’s eyes to brighten.
"Mother thinks so, too. However, she went missing before she could find it. Not that I had any hopes of returning to myself."
"Why did you say that?" Kent asked, and Vey sighed.
"It is because to get to the gateway leading to the location of the Nirvana Flame seed, one must cross the Sea of Calamities.
This sea is said to only allow those below the Demigod stage to enter, but rumour has it that there are even Demigod-grade beasts hidden within, called the Calamities.
Mother was an Immortal Lord with 58 limits broken on her body and a medium-grade Primordial Flame as her core flame when she embarked on her journey, but even she fell.
And it wasn’t just her; many others like her, some even more powerful than her, also fell. So you tell me, how can she return to me if she hadn’t already turned into piles of bones under the sea?"
Kent didn’t know what to say, so he just sighed.
However, he was certain about one thing, and that was, he had just discovered a map that led to one of his Nirvana Flames.
This means he was already one step closer to reclaiming what is rightfully his.
However, he must first handle his business.

"No need to worry, Vey. If she is alive, then naturally she will find her way back to you. However, I am here today to ask you to become my subordinate and help me handle someone I believe you would love to see dead."
"I am listening."

Kent smiled, "In exchange for your service, which involves holding back the minions of the Planet King, I will help you awaken your innate beast body, breach the 30th limit, leave this damn place, and even help you ascend to a great immortal world.
All I ask is for your loyalty and help in my battle against the Planet King."
"I am in," Vey said, shocking everyone except Kent.

The second being Sylvara, whom she just couldn’t wrap her mind around, how that was possible.
The Sylvara she knew wasn’t weak, but she wasn’t strong to the point that she could make her hair stand on end.
In that case, then why is she feeling this restless?
Kent smiled, hearing her answer, "I am no idiot, Vey.
I have nine Nirvana Flames, so I know I can smell the Radiant Flame of Purity on you."
"I really haven’t been in contact with a Nirvana Flame until today.
However, I once came into contact with something that had traces of Nirvana Flames."
"Oh." Kent’s interest was piqued.
"Do tell."
Vey decided to spill the beans, after all, she had already invited the annoying human, and hearing he had all nine Nirvana Flames piqued her interest too.
"When I was young, my mother won a map in an auction.
According to her, this map leads to the location of a Nirvana Flame seed.
Now I know it is the Radiant Flame of Purity.
I only came into contact with it when my mom, in an attempt to locate this place, vanished without a trace."
"Wait...
She went looking without the map?" Sylvara suddenly asked, and Vey shook her head.
"The map was too valuable, so she made a copy, leaving the real one behind." Vey turned to Kent and said, "The aura you felt came from this."
A leather that doesn’t seem to be a leather but more like a soft metallic material appeared in her hand.
The moment Kent saw it, his eyes turned white, causing the Radiant Flame of Purity to ooze from his eyes.
Everyone around Kent felt their bodies lighten, almost as if they were being cleansed.
The feeling was rather pleasant; however, it vanished when Kent’s eyes returned to their unusual purple hue.
He waved his hand, and the map flew into his hand.
"It’s indeed a map leading to a Nirvana Flame.
I can sense it," Kent muttered, causing Vey’s eyes to brighten.
"Mother thinks so, too.
However, she went missing before she could find it.
Not that I had any hopes of returning to myself."
"Why did you say that?" Kent asked, and Vey sighed.
"It is because to get to the gateway leading to the location of the Nirvana Flame seed, one must cross the Sea of Calamities.
This sea is said to only allow those below the Demigod stage to enter, but rumour has it that there are even Demigod-grade beasts hidden within, called the Calamities.
Mother was an Immortal Lord with 58 limits broken on her body and a medium-grade Primordial Flame as her core flame when she embarked on her journey, but even she fell.
And it wasn’t just her; many others like her, some even more powerful than her, also fell.
So you tell me, how can she return to me if she hadn’t already turned into piles of bones under the sea?"
Kent didn’t know what to say, so he just sighed.
However, he was certain about one thing, and that was, he had just discovered a map that led to one of his Nirvana Flames.
This means he was already one step closer to reclaiming what is rightfully his.
However, he must first handle his business.
"No need to worry, Vey.
If she is alive, then naturally she will find her way back to you.
However, I am here today to ask you to become my subordinate and help me handle someone I believe you would love to see dead."
"I am listening."

Kent smiled, "In exchange for your service, which involves holding back the minions of the Planet King, I will help you awaken your innate beast body, breach the 30th limit, leave this damn place, and even help you ascend to a great immortal world.
All I ask is for your loyalty and help in my battle against the Planet King."
"I am in," Vey said, shocking everyone except Kent.
